This internship offers a flexible schedule to accommodate academic commitments, and the duration will be limited to a specific period to ensure valuable learning without displacement of paid roles. There is no expectation of compensation or a job offer after the internship. Instead, the focus is on providing the intern with practical, educational experience aligned with their academic studies.

About the Role

  • 20 hrs/week

  • Unpaid, 6 month leadership program

  • Fully remote

  • Marketing team

  • OPT/CPT eligible

  • Able to commit to weekly 60-minute meetings (PST); Monday & Friday @10am Company Program Meeting, Monday @9am Team Meeting, Tuesday @10am Content Sync, Thursday @10am Team Deepwork, and several 1:1 coachings

Company Overview

PROJXON is a Business Optimization Consulting Company that focuses on empowering High-Impact organizations in the Tech, E-Commerce, Health + Wellness, and nonprofit industries. We provide tailored holistic business solutions to combat chaos, turning failure into opportunities for growth. Our commitment to sustainable and scalable consulting plans drive growth, productivity and market value for our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Edit and assemble raw footage into polished, engaging video content aligned with brand and project goals.

  • Collaborate with creative teams, marketing, and stakeholders to understand project vision and deliver compelling visual stories.

  • Cut, trim, and sequence video clips, adding transitions, effects, and motion graphics as needed.

  • Enhance video quality through color correction, sound design, and audio balancing.

  • Incorporate graphics, captions, music, and branding elements to elevate viewer engagement.

  • Manage multiple video projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and quality standards.

  • Adapt content for various platforms (social media, web, internal use) with attention to formatting and audience preferences.

  • Review and revise edits based on feedback from stakeholders and performance insights.

  • Organize and maintain video assets, project files, and media libraries efficiently.

  • Stay current with video editing trends, tools, and storytelling techniques.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Production, Video Editing, Multimedia, Communications, or related field (or currently pursuing).

  • Proficiency in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).

  • Strong understanding of video composition, pacing, and storytelling techniques.

  • Ability to transform raw footage into cohesive and engaging narratives.

  • Experience working with digital media formats and exporting for multiple platforms.

  • Strong attention to detail in editing, timing, and visual continuity.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, creative environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with motion graphics and animation tools (e.g., Adobe After Effects).

  • Familiarity with color grading and audio editing techniques.

  • Knowledge of social media trends and video optimization strategies (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).

  • Basic understanding of cinematography principles (lighting, framing, shot composition).

  • Experience working with branded content, marketing campaigns, or storytelling projects.

  • Ability to incorporate feedback and iterate quickly on edits.

  • Portfolio demonstrating a range of video editing projects and styles.

  • Understanding of content strategy and audience engagement metrics.

  • Experience with collaborative tools and workflows in creative teams.

Benefits of Joining PROJXON

  • Experience with working within a full (HR, IT, Bus, Ops, Marketing) team.

  • Opportunity to attend professional development workshops, weekly coaching sessions, LinkedIn, resume, and portfolio building.

  • Opportunity to design and implement scalable systems within a consulting environment.

  • Flexible schedule and fully remote work environment.

  • Participant-first approach which diversifies skillsets through cross-functional projects and collaboration

raw.description:
About Simply.TV

At Simply.TV, we believe that finding the right show or game to watch should feel effortless — and behind that seamless experience is a passionate team making sure every title, every match, and every piece of content is accurate, rich, and ready to shine. We're a global company of 400+ people on a mission to build the world's best TV, movie, and sports data — powering content discovery for millions of viewers across the globe. If that sounds like something you'd love to be part of, we'd love to meet you.

What you will do

As a Sports Data Editor, you'll help make sure the sports information our customers rely on is accurate, complete, and up to date.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Researching and verifying information about sports events, competitions, leagues, teams, players, schedules, and results.
  • Creating, updating, and maintaining sports records in our database.
  • Reviewing metadata related to fixtures, competitions, teams, venues, participants, and event details.
  • Identifying and correcting missing, inaccurate, duplicated, or inconsistent sports data.
  • Using reliable sports sources to validate and enrich information.
  • Monitoring schedule changes, postponements, cancellations, and other updates that may affect event data.
  • Following internal editorial guidelines and quality standards to ensure consistency across our database.
  • Working quickly and accurately with large volumes of sports data, especially when information changes close to or during live events.
  • Collaborating with colleagues and other teams when information needs clarification or further investigation.
  • Learning new tools, processes, sports structures, and content standards as projects and customer needs evolve.


This is not an open position — but it could be your foot in the door!

We're building a community of talented, detail-driven people who are passionate about TV, movies, streaming content, and working with data.

While there isn't an open position right now, joining our TV & Streaming Editorial Talent Pool gives us the opportunity to get to know you before a new project or position becomes available. If your profile matches what we're looking for, we'll invite you to complete a short skills test followed by a screening interview with one of our recruiters.

You'll then become part of our Talent Pool and be among the first people we contact when a relevant opportunity opens at Simply.TV.

How it works

There's no open role right now, but we believe great people shouldn't have to wait for a job posting.

If you're passionate about movies, TV series, streaming platforms, entertainment content, and working with data — and you want to work with a global team that powers content discovery for millions of viewers — we'd love to get to know you early.

Here's what to expect:

  1. You apply and we review your profile.
  2. If there's a match, we'll invite you to complete a short skills test.
  3. You'll then have a screening interview with one of our recruiters.
  4. Once a relevant new project or position becomes available, you'll be among the first people we contact.

Requirements

Must Haves

  • Location: Pakistan
  • Strong knowledge of European football leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1) and broader international sports coverage would be an advantage
  • Able to recognize major teams, leagues, competitions, common abbreviations, and season structures.
  • Genuine interest in sports and habit of following sports news/results regularly.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with large amounts of sports data.
  • Comfortable researching and verifying information using reliable online sources.
  • Good written English and ability to understand sports terminology in English.
  • Able to work independently, follow detailed guidelines, and consistently meet quality standards.
  • Comfortable with repetitive/data-heavy work and working across multiple sports or competitions.

Nice to Haves

  • Broader knowledge of international football, tennis, motorsport, combat sports, golf, or other major global sports.
  • Previous experience with: sports data; sports media; TV metadata; editorial/data-entry work; statistics or sports databases.
  • Experience working with databases, spreadsheets, or internal data tools.
  • Understanding of sports scheduling, fixtures, tournaments, playoffs, conferences/divisions, and event formats.
  • Experience working in an international or remote team.

Please note - we can only accept CVs in English!

Benefits

Collaboration based on a freelancer set-up is up to 450€ per month on a full-time allocation basis (40 hours per week).

raw.description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages.

Our CRAs work with a manageable study portfolio, allowing them to build deep protocol and site knowledge rather than spreading their focus across too many studies. With reasonable travel expectations, accessible line management and a smaller CRO environment, experienced CRAs have the autonomy to make decisions, influence how studies are delivered and see the impact of their work.

Precision for Medicine is recruiting a Clinical Research Associate II /Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our full-service team in Poland.

** This position is fully home based **

About you:

  • You are an experienced independent monitor who takes ownership of your sites and does not wait to be told what needs attention.
  • You understand what really matters for patient safety, data integrity and study delivery, and can distinguish critical risks from administrative noise.
  • You build credible relationships with investigators and site teams while remaining confident in addressing difficult or sensitive issues.
  • You identify emerging risks early, escalate appropriately and come with solutions, not just problems.
  • You are organized and well prepared, able to manage competing priorities across your sites without compromising quality.
  • You communicate clearly with CTMs and study teams and can confidently represent the site perspective in project discussions.
  • You take responsibility for the quality and outcomes of your work.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

You will independently manage and monitor investigative sites, taking ownership of site performance, quality and risk identification from site initiation through close-out.

You will partner closely with CTMs and study teams to anticipate issues, drive timely resolution and ensure studies are conducted, recorded and reported in accordance with the protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP and applicable regulatory requirements.

You may also interact directly with clients and support site payment activities.

Depending on your experience, you may have the opportunity to mentor less experienced CRAs and contribute your expertise to study-level discussions and process improvements.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • 3+ years of independent monitoring experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry
  • Independent monitoring experience in oncology clinical trials

Other Required:

  • Availability for domestic travel, including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50–60% travel commitment; occasional international travel may be required
  • Fluency in Polish and English

Preferred:

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree with a concentration in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Experience monitoring complex early-phase oncology studies, including Phase I and/or CAR-T trials

Why Precision for Medicine?

Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

Precision for Medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer—and we are passionate about helping you harness its power. We strike tumors on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway.

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching groundbreaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day. You will provide input and have your ideas valued and nurtured, impacting positive changes for the company.

Please, apply in English.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at .

Location:Remote — work from home in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, or Utah

Employment type: Full-time

Base salary range: $80,000 - $88,000 per year, plus performance-based incentives

The opportunity

Sensibly Sprouted is hiring a Registered Dietitian Manager to build and lead a team of dietitians providing outpatient Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT). You’ll play a central role in interviewing and selecting team members, coach their development, and shape how your team delivers care.

This is a developmental management role for dietitians ready to move into formal people leadership. Prior management experience is not required.

Internally, this position is called Junior Lead. You’ll report to the Chief Dietetics Officer and have management authority from day one. The broader leadership team will support you as you handle increasingly complex team, financial, and operational decisions. Your focus is team leadership; you may provide patient care when needed, but the role has no fixed caseload.

What you’ll do

  • Take a lead role in interviewing, selecting, and onboarding dietitians as you build your team.
  • Coach and develop team members, set expectations, give feedback, and address performance concerns.
  • Own team revenue, profitability, retention, and productive capacity; use performance data to identify risks and take action.
  • Reinforce clinical, documentation, scheduling, and operational standards, partnering with Clinical Excellence on training needs.
  • Manage team workflows and priorities, involving senior leadership when decisions require their input.

What you’ll bring

  • A Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential.
  • Applicable state licensure, or eligibility to obtain required licensure.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach others, lead initiatives, and improve team performance. A prior manager title is not required.
  • Sound judgment, clear communication, dependable follow-through, and comfort using performance data to guide decisions.
  • Residence in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, or Utah, or willingness to relocate to one of these states.
  • Authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

Your growth

Junior Lead provides support and feedback as you gain experience with increasingly complex leadership situations. Advancement to Lead is the expected next step after at least four quarters, once you demonstrate sustained Lead-level capability and performance. When you advance, your base pay moves into the Lead salary range.

Benefits

Eligible team members receive medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer healthcare contributions; a 401(k) with a 3% employer non-matching contribution; paid time off and holidays; and professional development support. Sensibly Sprouted also pays required professional liability insurance, state licensure fees, and CDR registration and renewal fees where applicable.

About Sensibly Sprouted

We are a team of registered dietitians providing personalized, evidence-based nutrition counseling and Medical Nutrition Therapy. Our care emphasizes ongoing patient relationships and practical changes that fit real life.

Sensibly Sprouted is an equal opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants.

Salary: $80,000 - $88,000 per year

raw.description:
• Lead long-term infrastructure assessments and sequencing to support Auckland's growth and development
    • Build a robust, evidence-based understanding of infrastructure requirements to support housing and employment growth.
    • Coordinate across Council, CCOs, and external stakeholders to align infrastructure responses to growth.

He angitūtanga: The opportunity

Auckland Council's Development Programmes team is seeking a Senior Programme Manager for a 12-month fixed-term opportunity to lead infrastructure assessments and coordinate Infrastructure Investment and Phasing (IIP) activities across a range of locations in Auckland.

This role sits within a growing programme of work to build a comprehensive, long-term understanding of infrastructure requirements across Auckland. The team focuses on long-term infrastructure planning, assessment, sequencing, and investment prioritisation. Rather than delivering physical infrastructure projects, the team develops the evidence base and strategic direction that helps shape where, when, and how infrastructure investment is needed to support growth.

You will play a critical role in developing a long-term view of infrastructure requirements, aligning infrastructure providers across multiple organisations and mandates, and informing sequencing to support housing, employment, and broader strategic outcomes. This is a strategic planning and coordination role focused on influencing future infrastructure investment decisions, rather than delivering infrastructure projects or overseeing construction programmes.

This includes responding to both planned and unplanned growth in a dynamic and evolving planning environment. You will often work with incomplete information, requiring sound judgement to develop a clear and credible view of infrastructure needs.

Your work will contribute to a robust and defensible evidence base that supports infrastructure planning, investment prioritisation, and funding decisions across Auckland. Working at the intersection of growth, infrastructure, and strategic planning, you will help ensure Auckland is well-positioned to respond to future development opportunities and challenges.

 

Day-to-day you could expect to work on:

  • Leading infrastructure assessment programmes across a range of locations in Auckland
    • Advising on infrastructure sequencing and priority infrastructure requirements to support growth, rather than delivering physical infrastructure projects
    • Lead cross-council assessments of unanticipated development proposals, identifying cumulative infrastructure impacts, service gaps, and choices about when infrastructure should be provided.
    • Develop evidence and advice on how infrastructure costs arising from unanticipated growth could be funded or recovered, working with Council teams and infrastructure providers.
    • Coordinating across Council teams, CCOs, developers, and other stakeholders with differing priorities
    • Informing Auckland’s Spatial Plan, Infrastructure Strategy, and related planning frameworks
    • Managing budgets, reporting, risks, and programme governance

He kōrero mōu: About you

raw.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.

The Difference You Will Make:

The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.

If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.

A Typical Day:

  • Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze
  • Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others
  • Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business
  • Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders
  • Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards
  • Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting
  • Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb
  • Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field
  • Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis
  • Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access
  • Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit
  • Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact
  • Experience working with large practical datasets

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$180,000—$210,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ or @ email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Who You Are:

As the you Vice President, Regional External Affairs you are responsible for developing and executing QTS's external affairs strategy across an assigned multi-state region. You oversee government relations, public policy, legislative advocacy, economic development, permitting and zoning, community engagement, stakeholder relations, and public affairs activities that support QTS's growth, development, operations, and long-term reputation. Reporting directly to the Chief External Affairs Officer, the Vice President serves as a key member of the External Affairs leadership team and leads a regional organization of approximately 10-12 team members. You will partner closely with leaders across Communications, Marketing, Legal, Development, Energy Strategy, Operations, and the Executive Team to advance business priorities, support market expansion, and drive strategic advocacy initiatives. You will build and maintain trusted relationships with elected officials, policymakers, economic development partners, community leaders, industry stakeholders, and internal business partners. Success in the role requires a campaign-oriented mindset, combining strategic planning, disciplined execution, stakeholder engagement, and coalition-building to advance QTS's business objectives and strengthen its position as a trusted community and industry partner.

What You Will Do: (Job Responsibilities)

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive regional external affairs strategy aligned with QTS's growth, development, operational, and public policy objectives.
  • Lead and coordinate integrated advocacy campaigns at the state and local levels to advance business priorities and support market expansion efforts.
  • Direct and develop a high-performing regional team, establishing clear priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and professional development opportunities.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional leaders to align external affairs strategies with corporate objectives and operational priorities.

Lead and develop a high-performing regional external affairs organization. Drive accountability, operational excellence, resource stewardship, and measurable business outcomes across the region.

Title: Legal Counsel (6 months FTC, Maternity Leave Cover)

Target location: Europe / UK

Moodle with us!

At Moodle, we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. As the world’s most customisable and trusted open-source LMS, we partner with schools, universities, and organisations to create better learning experiences for millions. If you’re ready to make a real impact and be part of a global movement shaping the future of learning, join us — let’s transform education together!

About the Role

Moodle is looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team on a 6-month maternity leave cover contract starting in mid-December. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting Moodle’s global operations — drafting and negotiating contracts, advising on privacy and IP matters, and helping the business navigate a complex multi-jurisdictional legal landscape.

What You’ll Do

Most days in this role usually involve a mix of:

  • Reviewing and drafting a broad range of commercial contracts, software licence agreements, NDAs, and website terms
  • Advising on data privacy obligations with a focus on GDPR, and acting as point of contact for our external DPO on EU time zone
  • Supporting M&A activities including due diligence and drafting of share and asset acquisition agreements
  • Managing and maintaining IP and trademark registrations (including Madrid-based and USPTO) in coordination with WIPO
  • Monitoring contract compliance and maintaining records in the CRM and Google Drive
  • Assisting the General Counsel with ad hoc legal research across multiple jurisdictions
  • Keeping across developments in cybersecurity law affecting software development and sale
  • Being a sounding board for the General Counsel before escalating to external counsel

We’d love to meet you

Especially if you can tell us about your:

  • Minimum 7 years’ experience as a Legal Counsel, with a strong track record in commercial contract management
  • Legal qualifications obtained in Europe/UK or USA, or equivalent experience gained within the Europe/UK or USA legal system
  • Hands-on in-house experience within a technology or SaaS company
  • Experience with Contract Lifecycle Management systems
  • Proven ability to draft and negotiate contracts across multiple jurisdictions
  • Excellent communication skills and an enthusiastic, approachable style
  • Ability to work flexibly across Europe and USA time zones when required

What's in it for you?

Moodle has a globally diverse team with over 280 team members in more than 25 countries around the world. We’ve built a passionate team of hard-working, driven and diverse people from all over the world, united by a shared belief in the ability of our platform to make a positive difference to our world. We respect our colleagues and value an open and innovative workplace, filled with integrity and of course a strong focus on education (yes, these are our company values!)

In addition to this you can expect:

  • Taking on a genuinely flexible, distributed role, working from anywhere in the world
  • A fantastic range of benefits, focusing on work-life balance, wellbeing and ‘choosing your own adventure.’
  • Working with a global team on a worldwide platform and make a real difference.
  • As a certified B Corp, we are proud to be part of a global community of mission-driven companies dedicated to using business as a force for good.

Learn more about Moodle

Moodle is the world’s most trusted online learning solution, with a growing ecosystem of products and services, including Moodle Workplace, Moodle App, MoodleCloud, and more. The engine of our ecosystem is Moodle LMS, the secure and customisable open source learning management platform used by well over 300 million learners worldwide.

Find out more about us on our website.

At Moodle we are an equal opportunity employer that actively supports diversity and inclusion in the workplace and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to fair recruitment and selection practices, ensuring we are drawing from a diverse range of sources to attract and select the very best person for the job. Learn more in our Diversity & Inclusion Charter.

ETL Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: ETL Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $115,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced ETL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise-scale data integration solutions supporting business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, and cloud data modernization initiatives. This role focuses on building high-performance ETL pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse operational systems into enterprise data warehouses and cloud-based analytics platforms.
You will collaborate with data architects, data engineers, business analysts, cloud engineers, and BI developers to develop scalable data integration frameworks, automate complex workflows, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, trusted data across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong ETL development expertise with advanced SQL skills, cloud data platform experience, and a deep understanding of data warehousing and enterprise data governance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data integration projects.
  • Build scalable data ingestion workflows that extract data from relational databases, cloud applications, APIs, flat files, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop transformation logic for cleansing, standardizing, validating, and enriching large datasets.
  • Design and optimize batch and near real-time data processing pipelines supporting business-critical reporting and analytics.
  • Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), Change Data Capture (CDC), incremental loading strategies, and data reconciliation processes.
  • Develop reusable ETL frameworks, metadata-driven workflows, and parameterized jobs to improve maintainability.
  • Perform source-to-target mapping, data profiling, and data quality analysis during project implementation.
  • Optimize ETL job performance by improving SQL queries, partitioning strategies, indexing, and parallel processing.
  • Monitor ETL workflows, troubleshoot production failures, and implement proactive alerting and recovery mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers to migrate legacy ETL workloads to Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Participate in data architecture discussions, code reviews, deployment planning, and production support.
  • Ensure data security, governance, auditability, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data pipelines.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional experience developing enterprise ETL solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ETL platforms such as Informatica PowerCenter, SSIS, Talend, IBM DataStage, or Pentaho.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Teradata.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and data warehousing principles.
  • Experience designing ETL workflows involving complex transformations, joins, aggregations, lookups, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Change Data Capture (CDC), Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 & Type 2), and incremental loading techniques.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms including Azure Data Factory (ADF), AWS Glue, or Google Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Experience integrating structured and semi-structured data formats including JSON, XML, CSV, Parquet, and Avro.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting for ETL automation.
  • Experience scheduling workflows using Control-M, Autosys, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or enterprise schedulers.
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools for ETL deployments.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and ETL performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working with Agile Scrum teams and enterprise SDLC processes.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses including Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
  • Knowledge of Apache Spark, Databricks, PySpark, or distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Experience implementing enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Quality solutions.
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies including Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hub, or Amazon Kinesis.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven ETL frameworks and reusable integration components.
  • Knowledge of Data Vault 2.0 architecture and modern data lakehouse concepts.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices for data engineering and automated ETL deployments.
  • Experience with BI platforms including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik for downstream reporting integration.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Informatica are highly desirable.

Project Environment

You will be joining an enterprise data engineering team responsible for modernizing data integration and analytics platforms supporting multiple business units across financial services, healthcare, insurance, and retail industries. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise data warehouse modernization to Snowflake and Azure Synapse
  • Cloud-based ETL migration from legacy on-premises platforms
  • Real-time data ingestion and analytics pipelines
  • Customer 360 and Master Data Management initiatives
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data solutions
  • Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture implementation
  • Enterprise reporting platforms supporting executive dashboards and operational analytics
  • High-volume data pipelines processing billions of records from ERP, CRM, HR, and financial systems

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to data architecture, ETL development, cloud migration, performance optimization, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration solutions.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

About the Role

A US-based medical practice is seeking a Medical Patient Representative to join its patient access team. This is a front-line role that serves as many patients' first point of contact with the practice — by phone, voicemail, and messaging. The ideal candidate brings healthcare call center experience, a clear and empathetic communication style, and the ability to work accurately across multiple systems in a fast-moving environment.

Training will be provided on all systems. The practice is looking for someone who can be ready to contribute by November 1, 2026.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer inbound calls promptly across patient queues and route callers to the appropriate team when needed
  • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm new and returning patient appointments for both in-office and telehealth visits
  • Verify and update patient demographic and insurance information accurately at each point of contact
  • Return voicemails and respond to patient messages via the practice messaging platform within the same business day
  • Warm-transfer billing and insurance inquiries to the appropriate internal team
  • Maintain a professional, patient, and empathetic manner across all patient interactions regardless of call volume or complexity

Systems

The practice uses Athena (EHR and scheduling), Klara (patient messaging), and Phreesia (patient intake). Prior experience with any of these platforms is a plus; full training will be provided.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 1 year of call center experience, preferably within a medical practice or healthcare setting
  • Working knowledge of US health insurance, including commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and TRICARE
  • Clear, professional, and empathetic phone manner — patients may be anxious, in pain, or frustrated, and composure matters
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately capture and update patient information while managing an active call
  • Comfortable working simultaneously across multiple platforms and systems
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, dedicated home workspace suitable for patient calls

Preferred

  • Experience with Athena, Klara, or Phreesia
  • Prior experience scheduling telehealth appointments in addition to in-office visits
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and patient privacy standards in a remote work context

Schedule and Start Date

  • Full-time: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time
  • Fully remote
  • Target start date: November 1, 2026

What We Are Looking For

Patients calling a medical practice are not calling because everything is going well. The Medical Patient Representative is often the first voice a patient hears, and the tone of that interaction sets the tone for their entire experience with the practice. The right candidate understands this and approaches every call with care, accuracy, and professionalism — whether it is a routine appointment confirmation or a frustrated patient with an unresolved concern.

You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable. You follow through on messages the same day, you document what you do, and you make sure patients leave the interaction feeling heard and taken care of. Healthcare experience is important here — not just because of the systems, but because of the stakes.

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $6/hr

Design the future of intelligent cloud commerce at Pax8 as a Senior Engineer, leading mission-critical systems that shape how our platform evolves across the United States and beyond.

🌟 Why This Role Matters

This is not a traditional senior engineering position.

As a Senior Engineer, you'll operate at the intersection of architecture, platform evolution, AI-enabled engineering, and business impact. You'll shape foundational systems that influence multiple products, teams, and strategic initiatives across Pax8. You'll have the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges, define engineering standards, and help guide how AI and intelligent automation are responsibly integrated into our technology ecosystem.

At Pax8, we're embracing the AI era. New team members join an environment where innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning are embedded into everyday work, creating opportunities to grow alongside rapidly evolving technologies.

Pax8 is the leading cloud commerce marketplace, supporting more than 39,000 partners and connecting over 130 technology vendors with hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. raw.description:
Bright!Tax is hiring a Tax Senior specialising in Business Entities, to anchor our US business entity work. You will prepare, review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for American entrepreneurs living outside the United States. You will handle most of that work end to end, and you will also review returns prepared by others so our team can learn from you. Between entity deadlines you will carry individual expat returns and the international forms that sit alongside them, so the year stays balanced. You will also mentor the preparers on our team who want to grow into entity work. This is a fully remote independent contractor role, open on location, working the US filing calendar. It will suit someone who is confident making their own judgment calls and comfortable working the way a small, fully remote firm works.

Key responsibilities

  • Review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for expat-owned businesses, and prepare them end to end where that is the better fit.
  • Grow into the international layer that sits on top of entity work, including Forms 5471, 8865, and 8858, GILTI and subpart F, and foreign trust reporting. Experience here is welcome, and we will teach it if you have not done it.
  • Talk directly with clients by phone and video: explain positions, walk them through their entity returns, deliver completed work, and flag where their facts call for filings beyond the current scope. No selling or business development.
  • Mentor and upskill Tax Team members toward independent entity preparation, in partnership with Learning and Development.
  • Carry individual expat returns and international filings in the months between entity deadlines.
  • Document entity standards, review checklists, and common fact patterns so the work is repeatable, reviewable, and teachable.

Must-have qualifications

  • Years of experience: Roughly four to eight years in US tax with substantial entity work, enough to make a judgment call without escalating it. We care more about whether you have owned client relationships and made judgment calls yourself than about the number. We will hire at either Tax Senior or Tax Manager level, based on depth of experience and the technical authority you are ready to carry. At Tax Senior level this seat carries no direct reports.   • Languages (if any): Professional fluency in English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in a small firm or your own practice rather than a large firm environment, so you are calibrated to what a client of our size actually needs. If you run your own practice, this cannot be a side engagement alongside it. We need committed capacity across the filing calendar.
  • Experience serving US owners living abroad, or time in a firm with an international or expat client base.
  • Experience building technical training or running upskilling for a team.

Senior QA Engineer

Full-Time | Remote (Europe / CET-Compatible Time Zones)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based, independent video game development company focused on building unforgettable, player-first experiences driven by clear artistic direction, state-of-the-art tools and a strong visual identity. Our work is guided by a culture of innovation, creativity and close collaboration, allowing us to pursue our vision of bringing back the fun in video games and creating experiences that feel engaging, rewarding and memorable for players. We operate as a fully remote studio with a globally distributed team of experienced developers, artists and designers. Prism is structured around trust, accountability and clear communication, enabling us to collaborate efficiently across time zones while maintaining a consistent standard of quality and execution.

The studio is currently developing its first PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter, Heptic Arena, with the aim of standing out within the genre and leaving a lasting impression on players. Join us on our exciting journey as we continue to build cutting-edge games, push the boundaries of what’s possible in the gaming world, and provide unparalleled entertainment and compelling experiences for players around the globe!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to play a hands-on role in maintaining and raising the quality of our games throughout development.

Working closely with engineering, design, art and production, you will help apply a structured and proactive approach to testing across game features. You will be responsible for creating detailed test plans, identifying and investigating complex issues, executing testing workflows, and ensuring problems are communicated clearly and resolved effectively.

This role goes beyond surface-level testing. We are looking for someone who understands game development from a technical perspective and can think critically about how systems interact, where they may fail, and how quality can be verified early in the development process. As we develop Heptic Arena, you will play an important role in ensuring that gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality, performance, and the overall player experience meet the standard we want to deliver.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute test coverage across features, systems, and game builds throughout development.
  • Create detailed test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical and gameplay requirements.
  • Test new features and systems across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility scenarios.
  • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and relevant technical information.
  • Work directly with engineers, designers, and other disciplines to investigate issues, determine severity, and validate fixes.
  • Test gameplay systems within Unreal Engine 5, using your technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behaviour.
  • Support testing of multiplayer and networked gameplay, identifying issues relating to replication, connectivity, latency, synchronisation, and player interactions.
  • Coordinate and support internal playtests, turning observations and player feedback into clear, actionable findings.
  • Maintain bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and reporting within Jira.
  • Monitor defect trends and testing data to identify recurring issues and areas requiring additional test coverage.
  • Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.
  • Work closely with production and QA leadership to prioritise defects against development milestones and release requirements.
  • Help the wider team identify technical and gameplay risks early rather than relying on testing at the very end of production.

About You

  • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a senior QA, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality role.
  • Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine 5, with proven commercial experience on a shipped title or game currently in active production.
  • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the relationship between engineering, design, art, production, and QA.
  • Experience creating and maintaining structured test plans, test cases, and regression coverage.
  • Strong bug investigation and reproduction skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and precisely.
  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant scripting or programming technologies, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.
  • Experience with QA and bug-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration/delivery workflows.
  • Experience analysing QA data, defect trends, and testing results to identify patterns and areas of risk.
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and discussing issues directly with engineers.
  • Highly organised and capable of independently managing priorities across multiple features and areas of development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A proactive approach to quality, with the ability to identify potential issues before they become larger production problems.
  • Genuine interest in games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay feel polished, responsive, and enjoyable.
  • Must be based in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in daily collaboration, meetings, and team syncs.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter titles.
  • Experience testing networked gameplay and debugging issues involving replication, latency, matchmaking, or online services.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, scripts, or QA tools.
  • Experience with performance, load, or stress testing.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.
  • Experience testing across multiple platforms.
  • AAA game development experience.
  • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.
  • Experience contributing to a title through multiple stages of production, from early development through launch.
  • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer games.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplinary team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

Position: Journalist Position Type: Full Time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy) Location: Remote in Fredericton, NB

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

Working remotely in New Brunswick with one of Postmedia’s news teams, ideal candidates are graduating students or recent graduates. Enterprising self-starters and team players, they have a sense for stories that resonate with a diverse readership. A key asset is the ability to use digital tools to break and develop stories and ideas. Successful candidates will work to tight deadlines covering a wide range of news and other subjects.

This full-time reporting position under the collective agreement will be assigned to the Fredericton Daily Gleaner.

Provision may be made by mutual agreement for assignment to other of Postmedia’s newsrooms. Some weekend and statutory holiday work may be included.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop content to engage audiences across several platforms tailored to meet the varying needs of web and mobile audiences.
  • Have story ideas daily, a job essential along with the flexibility to quickly pivot to other newsroom priorities to meet changing needs.
  • Use social media and other digital tools to uncover what’s breaking and what readers in real time are talking about which quickly needs attention.
  • Cultivate sources to break stories and help set the news agenda.
  • Work with digital teams to create interactive content, including text, photo, video and other multimedia elements that both engage and enrich readers.

Who you are:

  • A graduating journalism school student or graduate, or a candidate from a related field. Newsroom experience is an asset, but you have the ability to quickly layer and prioritize what needs to be done to quickly move up the job learning curve.
  • Flexible to work effectively in breaking news, features and short form, along with non-traditional story formats.
  • Hungry to make the most of a chance to work in a daily newsroom with top-notch journalists and eager to show what you can do to help by collaborating with colleagues.
  • A digger with natural curiosity, not satisfied with pat answers; always looking for hidden story angles and with a talent, or developing one, for explanatory journalism.
  • A reporter interested not just in what happened or is happening, but also why and how, with the ability to concisely convey that added meaning to readers.
  • Experience and strength in video, podcast presentation and other digital tools is an asset.
  • A valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle are also assets.
  • Bilingualism in English/French is an asset

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply with the following information in one document.

  • A cover letter explaining why you are the best candidate.
  • A résumé.
  • Three samples of your best published work, if any (samples should show a range of work and an ability to handle complex subjects).
  • At least two signed references, to be included in your application (please do not send separately as we cannot guarantee that they will be matched with your file).
  • We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please.

Compensation:

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Union start rate: $16.82/hour, up to $33.64 based on experience

This is a unionized position subject to the terms and conditions of the collective agreement. The starting salary listed in this job posting is based on the Year 1 rate outlined in the collective agreement. Offers will be made based on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates under consideration will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in all areas of the hiring process. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please make your needs known in advance. Accommodation requests will be provided on an individual basis.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to employment equity and an inclusive barrier-free selection process and work environment. Postmedia Network Inc. encourages applications from women, indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities.

Position Summary:

The EC/TCTO Developer plays a crucial role in ensuring the effective implementation of engineering changes (ECs) and Time Compliance Technical Orders (TCTOs) and Draftsman Services for the U.S. Coast Guard’s Command, Control, Communications, Computer, and Intelligence Service Center (C5ISC). They are responsible for managing the configuration and documentation processes, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and internal policies. The EC/TCTO Developer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to facilitate seamless integration of ECs and TCTOs. They are proficient in utilizing specialized software tools and systems to track changes, maintain accurate technical documentation, and ensure smooth coordination of change control processes. The EC/TCTO Developer's attention to detail, analytical skills, and strong communication abilities are vital in managing the complex lifecycle of ECs and TCTOs, driving efficiency and continuous improvement within the organization.

Compensation & Benefits:

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

raw.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

As a Claims Adjudication Specialist, you will play a critical role within our Operations Department, focused on evaluating and servicing claims related to our Product and Shipping Protection plans, which are offered by over 1,000+ Merchant Partners. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert, supporting our Customer Support and Service Technician partners to ensure accurate and timely service of complex claims that require deeper investigation.

This position requires strong analytical skills, critical thinking, and the ability to interpret multiple policies across a wide range of product categories. On a daily basis, you’ll review complex claim submissions, manage escalations, and investigate unusual claim patterns. Success in this role relies on meticulous attention to detail, evidence-based decision-making and ability to adapt to frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment.

You'll collaborate closely with customers, service partners, and internal teams to deliver accurate claim decisions while ensuring an exceptional customer experience. The role involves inbound and outbound calls, as well as written communications with customers, service providers, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the escalation point of contact from outsourced partners, customer support teams and service technician partners.
  • Investigate and resolve complex claim situations, ensuring decisions align with contract terms and internal policies.
  • Troubleshoot delays in claims processing, ensuring timely resolutions and enhanced customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate service technician dispatching and parts ordering when necessary to support claim resolution.
  • Resolve escalated customer issues by proposing fair resolutions within policy guidelines and clearly communicating outcomes to the customer.
  • Maintain detailed and organized documentation of all customer and partner interactions.
  • Investigate suspected fraudulent claims and report findings as needed.
  • Recommend process improvements and opportunities to automate routine tasks.
  • Provide timely responses to claim inquiries via phone and email, in line with established SLAs.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and escalate unresolved claim issues.
  • Stay up to date on product offerings, service workflows, and policy updates to better support customers.
  • Identify and communicate training needs for front-line support teams to improve service quality.
  • Keep internal systems current with relevant technical issues, customer feedback, and insights.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge:

  • Active adjuster licenses (preferred).
  • 3-5 years of technical customer service, claims management/adjudication, insurance adjusting, or contact center experience. Claims adjudication preferably in a protection plan environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written with the ability to convey complex claim details and supporting rationale for decisioning in a clear and concise way both to customers and internal system notations.
  • Embraces frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in managing evolving challenges.
  • Experienced with claims management systems, contact center platforms, and Google suites of products.
  • Proven ability to to navigate and work effectively across various software systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, identify solutions, and make decisions efficiently.
  • Thrive in environments of high claim volumes with exponential company growth while maintaining excellent performance and accuracy.

Estimated Pay Range: $45,000 - $55,000 per year salaried*

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, work location and job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

raw.title: Director, Labeling and Nutrition Compliance
raw.excerpt: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
raw.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

The Food Safety and Quality Assurance team helps ensure CookUnity’s meals meet food safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Working across Culinary, Supply Chain, Procurement, Nutrition & Standards, Food Science Lab, Legal, Marketing, Design, Product, Engineering, and Operations, the team supports accurate product information and consistent execution across our markets.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Director of Labeling and Nutrition Compliance to lead labeling and nutrition compliance across our meals, ingredient data, product claims, and customer-facing information.

You will own the overall source-to-label process, including governance, performance metrics, third-party laboratory validation, and approval of product and nutrition claims. You will establish technical acceptance criteria, verify data suitability, coordinate cross-functional deliverables, and manage the label and content release process, withholding approval when supporting evidence is insufficient.

This role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to lead within a cross-functional organization. You will establish clear accountability, verify nutrition and labeling information, and ensure teams have practical controls for maintaining compliance as ingredients, recipes, suppliers, systems, and markets evolve.

Within your first 90 days, you will establish technical acceptance criteria and a risk-ranked review baseline, verify a representative set of supplier and market substitutions delivered by Supply Chain, and demonstrate an independently reviewed, controlled release pilot that includes label-to-website reconciliation. You will also align ongoing verification and escalation measures with functional owners, while Supply Chain retains ownership of the data remediation plan and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Lead CookUnity’s labeling and nutrition compliance program. Establish practical standards consistent with applicable Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA) requirements for ingredient declarations, allergens, Nutrition Facts, serving sizes, net quantity, claims, required statements, and market-specific labeling, in partnership with Nutrition & Standards.

  • Own the create, review, approve, and distribute (CRAD) labeling process, governance, and consolidated KPI dashboard. Define functional accountability, independent review requirements, approval records, version controls, release criteria, escalation paths, and corrective-action follow-through.

  • Define regulatory and technical requirements for ingredient master data owned by Supply Chain Operations. Lead the specification approval and stakeholder sign-off process, including supplier-item and market specificity, source evidence, approved substitutions, and acceptance criteria.

  • Review and approve ingredient data eligibility for labeling and claims, tracking and escalating unresolved dependencies.

  • Own third-party laboratory validation, including lab qualification, risk-based representative sampling across suppliers and markets, appropriate testing methods, and comparison against approved recipes, portions, declared nutrition, and claim criteria.

  • Investigate laboratory discrepancies and drive verified corrections through the accountable data, recipe, or execution owner.

  • Approve product, nutrition, standards, ingredient, and dietary claims before publication across channels. Require substantiation, approved wording, applicability and conditions, review dates, and change control.

  • Obtain documented Food Science Lab approval of the nutritional basis for claims, required Legal concurrence, and appropriately qualified clinical approval of medically tailored meal criteria.

  • Set risk-based technical review priorities for estimated and generic legacy records. Partner with Supply Chain, which owns data remediation and maintenance, to verify corrections, assess supplier and market equivalence, and confirm impacts on recipes, nutrition values, allergens, and claims.

  • Manage the compliance impact of supplier, ingredient, recipe, process, portion, packaging, and system changes. Require affected products and claims to be reassessed before release, including substitutions and market-specific variants.

  • Establish technical acceptance criteria for labeling and data systems. Partner with Engineering to verify source-to-label and website field mappings, controlled synchronization, and automated completeness, calculation, rounding, and version checks.

  • Require production first-article checks and ongoing label-to-meal verification. Partner with Operations and Supply Chain on approved masters, effective dates, acknowledgment of changes, and removal of obsolete labels and templates.

  • Verify consistency between approved label master data and customer-facing channels, including the CookUnity website, for ingredients, allergens, nutrition values, serving details, and claims.

  • Define website reconciliation criteria and verify publication and correction evidence. Partner with Growth Marketing/SEO, which owns website accuracy, publishing, discrepancy correction, and the website parity KPI, and escalate safety or compliance discrepancies through the incident process.

  • Exercise delegated authority to hold or reject nonconforming label and content releases. Ensure independent review of technical work you prepare and escalate product holds, disposition decisions, and unresolved safety or compliance issues to the VP of FSQA under established procedures.

  • Maintain inspection-ready records and train cross-functional teams on labeling requirements, approval workflows, and operating controls.

  • Maintain the overall CRAD KPI dashboard covering technical data acceptance, Culinary recipe and portion conformity, laboratory-versus-declared accuracy, claims compliance, release performance, defects, and corrective actions. Incorporate Growth Marketing/SEO’s website parity and coverage results, coordinate functional delivery, and escalate gaps while each function owns its evidence, results, and corrective actions.

  • Drive a consistent process in which released products have traceable inputs, supported claims, documented independent review, approved market-specific labels, consistent website content, and verified production execution.

Qualifications

  • Deep, practical experience in food-labeling regulations, nutrition, and standards compliance, including hands-on technical review of packaged food labels, ingredient and allergen declarations, nutrition calculations, and claim substantiation.

  • Strong working knowledge of applicable U.S. FDA food-labeling requirements and the ability to determine when USDA FSIS or other market requirements apply, with qualified specialist support as needed.

  • Experience connecting supplier specifications, ingredient databases, formulations, recipe systems, nutrition analysis, artwork, and production execution through controlled workflows.

  • Sound technical judgment regarding ingredient variability, cooking yields, portioning, laboratory results, and the limitations of calculated nutrition.

  • Ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into clear acceptance criteria and practical operating controls.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional programs, resolving ownership gaps, and implementing change without relying solely on direct reporting authority.

  • Clear written communication, careful documentation, and confidence holding a release when supporting evidence is incomplete.

  • A degree in food science, nutrition, regulatory science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in multi-site prepared meal operations.

  • Experience with recipe-management systems and supplier-data platforms.

  • Familiarity with Canadian food-labeling requirements.

  • Registered Dietitian credentials. Clinical standards and medically tailored meal criteria require appropriately qualified expertise.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

The incumbent is responsible for delivering high-quality course content within agreed scope and timelines, and for ensuring that their work meets the required curriculum, quality and learning design standards.

Key responsibilities

Curriculum, Learning & Assessment Design

  • Use the relevant curriculum, subject and assessment requirements to ensure that course content is accurate, appropriately scoped and aligned to the required NSC and SACAI standards.
  • Conduct planning and analysis in subject area to recommend appropriate design solutions and strategies for online delivery.
  • Use Valenture’s learning management system and available learning technologies to make appropriate design decisions for online learning.
  • Design appropriate formative learning, practice and mastery activities that help learners build and demonstrate understanding as they progress through the course.
  • Design and develop curriculum-aligned summative assessments, including the associated marking guidelines and assessment materials, in accordance with CAPS, NSC, SACAI and Valenture assessment requirements.

Content development & production

  • Develop and adapt curriculum-aligned source material into engaging, pedagogically sound online learning experiences using Valenture’s approved development tools and formats.
  • Research and source appropriate reference materials to support course development.
  • Collaborate with relevant Product, Learning Technology and production specialists to create supporting media and interactive learning elements where required.
