  • Perform auxiliary tasks, including, but not limited to briefing in graphics, and tracking the use of external assets.
  • Develop content in accordance with Valenture’s agreed learning design principles, development processes, templates, SOPs and quality standards.

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Review and quality assure their own work against agreed curriculum, learning design and quality requirements before submission for review.
  • Participate in peer review and quality assurance activities across courses, and implement feedback arising from review.Perform peer reviews across subjects and qualifications.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Must be comfortable working remotely and independently

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a leader in open networking for organizations that need secure, scalable, automated operations across bare metal, cloud and edge. Our product, VyOS, is an enterprise-grade networking platform for consistent operations and automation at scale, delivering full control and high performance with zero vendor lock-in. More than 1,500 organizations run VyOS in production, from service providers and cloud providers to enterprises and public institutions. Our goal is to restore ownership of network infrastructure to our users through transparent, vendor-neutral networking. Your network, your rules.

Job description

The Business Development Representative generates new sales opportunities for VyOS through outbound prospecting. The job is to find the right companies and people in the assigned territory, reach them with personalised outreach, qualify their interest and book meetings for the sales team.

  • Build target account and contact lists in the assigned territory that match the VyOS ideal customer profile: network and infrastructure teams at service providers, cloud and hosting providers, MSPs and enterprises.
  • Run outbound outreach every day: cold calls, personalised email sequences and LinkedIn messages.
  • Qualify prospects against the ideal customer profile: company fit, use case, timing, and whether the contact is the decision maker or a technical influencer.
  • Book discovery meetings for the account executive or the CRO, confirm attendance, and join the first call to hand over context.

If you can talk to a network team in their own language and want to learn outbound sales, we will teach you the sales part.

VyOS is an enterprise-grade network operating system that combines routing, firewall, VPN and core network services in one system with one configuration. It runs on standard x86-64 hardware, on every major hypervisor and in every major public cloud, so one design runs anywhere. raw.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Purpose

We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer with an analytical mindset and a product-oriented perspective to join our multidisciplinary teams. At BetWarrior, we are evolving toward a Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and Given-When-Then / Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) model.

We are not simply looking for a developer who turns designs into code, but rather an engineer who takes end-to-end ownership of the problem: from refining and technically specifying requirements (state diagrams, API contracts, Markdown/Gherkin specs) to delivering robust and scalable solutions.

In this role, you'll

  • Lead technical analysis based on initial Product/UX Acceptance Criteria. Define sequence/state diagrams, API contracts, and write functional specifications (MD/Gherkin) before writing code.
  • Model complex state flows and design resilient interface architectures capable of operating in high-traffic, low-latency environments.
  • Work closely with Product and UX teams in small, autonomous squads, acting as the technical bridge between business ideas and viable architectures.
  • Translate business scenarios into clear acceptance criteria and well-structured system behaviors, actively collaborating with the Automation QA team.
  • Design components and abstractions with long-term maintainability in mind, anticipating edge cases, critical bugs, and bottlenecks

What we look for in an exceptional candidate

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, providing the foundation needed to have worked through the level of complexity required for problem-solving.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience managing critical state flows in web applications or concurrent platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to create technical documentation prior to development (OpenAPI/Swagger specs, UML/sequence diagrams, Markdown technical specs).
  • Familiarity with defining business-oriented scenarios using Given-When-Then / Gherkin.
  • Strong foundations in computer science or software engineering (design patterns, data structures, browser performance), beyond narrow expertise in a particular library.
  • Experience or working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, UI libraries/frameworks such as React, and Node.js environments.

Bonus points if you also have

  • Experience working on high-traffic, high-concurrency, or real-time data platforms.
  • Experience going through complex production incidents or post-mortems that have shaped your approach to preventing errors through clear specifications.
  • Knowledge of event-driven architecture or real-time API technologies (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events)

How we do things

BetWarrior is a company in expansion. The team is fast-moving, collaborative, and demanding — with high standards for quality and a genuine commitment to building something that lasts. We are looking for people who want to grow with the company, take ownership of their work, and be part of building a regional team that operates at a high level across multiple markets.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at a stage where your contribution is visible, your growth is real, and the path forward is defined by what you deliver — not by time in role.

Accountability & Ownership –Take charge, own your craft

Reliability –Deliver with quality and consistency

Teamwork –Collaborate, challenge, and grow together

Winner Spirit –Compete with purpose and grit

Wellbeing –Build a career that energizes you

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

raw.description:
About The Role

KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.

This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.
  • Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.
  • Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.
  • Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.
  • Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.
  • Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.
  • Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.
  • Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.
  • Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.
  • Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.
  • Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.
  • Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.
  • Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.
  • The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

  • Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.
  • Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.
  • CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

  • Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG.
  • A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.
  • A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.
  • Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.
  • European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

Professional Competencies

Collaborative Spirit | Results Above All | Innovation as a Habit | Creative Freedom | Financial Prudence | Eternal Learner | Daring Adventures | Open Feedback | Integrity in Action | Embrace Change | Accountability

The position of UM Outpatient Review Nurse is part of the Case Management team and is responsible for clinical, quality, and patient outcomes. This position is expected to implement the effectiveness and best practices of Utilization Review and will provide high quality medical review by appropriately applying the State, Federal, health plan and clinical guidelines used to determine medical necessity.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Director, Services Technology RiskWho is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview:

The Services Technology Risk team is looking for a Director, Service Technology Risk professional to help maintain secure, resilient, and trusted technology environments while enabling innovation and growth.
The ideal candidate is analytical, collaborative, and proactive, with a passion for identifying and managing risks, strengthening controls, and partnering with Engineering, Product, Security, and Business teams. This role will focus on improving risk management and assurance practices through automation, analytics, and scalable solutions while supporting regulatory, audit, and customer expectations.

Role:
The Director, Services Technology Risk will lead the identification, assessment, prioritization, monitoring, and escalation of technology and operational risks across Services. This role will develop risk management strategies and frameworks, including risk registers, product risk assessments, and risk and control self-assessments, providing leadership with clear insights to support informed decisions.
The role will partner with Product, Engineering, and Security teams to embed risk management into business and technology processes, strengthen accountability, and ensure risks are effectively managed. The ideal candidate brings deep technology risk expertise, strong business judgment, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, translate complex risks into business impact, and build scalable capabilities that support secure innovation and growth.
The Director, Technology Risk Identification & Assessment will:
• Lead the Risk Identification and Assessment for Services, establishing the strategy, operating model, governance, and capabilities required to consistently identify, assess, prioritize, monitor, and manage technology and operational risk.
• Establish and mature standardized risk management practices across Services, including risk registers, product risk assessments, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), and risk acceptance and escalation.
• Modernize and scale risk identification and assessment through automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities that improve the quality, timeliness, and efficiency of risk management.
• Maintain a consolidated view of material risks across Services products, platforms, and programs, ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and visibility into risk exposure, treatment, and status.
• Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to embed risk identification and assessment into business and technology processes, reinforcing their accountability for managing risks throughout the risk lifecycle.
• Provide effective risk challenge and judgment on material and emerging risks, including cybersecurity, resilience, regulatory, operational, and risks introduced by emerging technologies such as AI/ML and generative AI.
• Establish governance for residual risk acceptance and escalation, ensuring decisions are transparent, appropriately approved, aligned with established risk appetite and tolerance, and supported by clear ownership and rationale.
• Translate complex technology risks into clear business impact, tradeoffs, and actionable insights to support leadership decision-making, prioritization, investment, and remediation.
• Provide Services leadership with an integrated view of the risk profile, including material exposures, emerging risks, accepted risks, trends, and areas requiring management attention.
• Partner across Engineering, Product, Security, Business, and enterprise risk functions to drive consistent risk practices, reduce fragmentation and duplication, and strengthen overall risk management across Services.
• Lead and develop a team of technology risk professionals, fostering strong risk judgment, constructive challenge, accountability, and trusted partnerships across the organization.

All About You:
• Significant experience in technology risk management, operational risk, information security risk, technology audit, technology controls, or a related discipline.
• Strong experience leading and maturing technology risk management practices across complex products, platforms, and business environments, such as risk register management, product risk Assessments, RCSAs, and other risk identification and assessment activities.
• Comfortable navigating ambiguity, resolving competing priorities, and establishing structure where processes are not yet mature.
• Strong interest in automation, analytics, and AI-enabled approaches to modernizing risk management.
• Strong understanding of technology risks across areas such as cybersecurity, data protection, software development, cloud services, identity and access management, vulnerability management, change management, third-party risk, and operational resilience.
• Ability to understand complex technology architectures and translate technical risks into clear business impact and decision points.
• Familiarity with regulatory expectations and data-residency requirements as they apply to technology controls, and with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and COBIT.
• Strong business judgment, with the ability to assess risk, challenge assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide practical recommendations.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior Product, Engineering, Business, Security, and risk stakeholders.
• Ability to build practical and scalable operating models in complex or evolving environments.
• Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex risk matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bachelor’s degree required.
• Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or equivalent are preferred but not required.Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 01/18/2027. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible.

raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

Position is salary-based + commission.

  • Must provide prompt & accurate price quoting to customers & follow up on each quote to determine final result.
  • Must be able to handle high call volume and produce quotes in an expedited fashion.

  • Foster & develop relationships with customers & industry personnel to promote goodwill & generate new business.
  • Must remain current on company & competitor product offerings, aircraft, regional charter pricing, & travel trends.

  • Ensure the consistent performance of sales objectives each month by meeting required sales quotas.

  • Must be willing to carry a mobile phone or other similar communications & be accessible 24/7 as needed.
  • Demonstrate customer service skills with the ability to multitask in a high-pressure environment.
  • Must be able to negotiate & close.
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills.
  • Professional appearance, excellent phone demeanor, with ability to set priorities. Not afraid to be on the phone all day.
  • Must possess effective communication, organization, presentation, & administrative skills.
  • Must have an energetic, friendly & outgoing personality.
  • Ability to multi-task, collect & analyze data, define problems, establish facts & draw valid conclusions in a timely manner.
  • Ability to generate/write reports & business correspondence.
  • Punctual, regular & consistent attendance is a must.
  • Intermediate computer skills with Microsoft Office Suite.

Solairus is a private aviation services company assisting aircraft owners with the safe, reliable, and efficient management and operation of their aircraft. Headquartered in the beautiful California Wine Country, Solairus Aviation is a destination employer offering nationwide operating bases, a stimulating work environment, and an array of modern benefits to employees. We are seeking an experienced SAP Security and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Engineer to design, implement, and operate security and access-control frameworks for complex SAP landscapes, including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, and SuccessFactors.   • Strong hands-on experience with SAP authorization concepts and role design.
  • Deep experience operating SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM).
  • Experience supporting SAP audits and remediation activities.
  • Hands-on experience securing Fiori, BTP, and cloud SAP applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP IDM or third-party IGA tooling.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Process Control.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GxP, and PCI.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP-certified Security or GRC credentials.
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity services (IAS, IPS) and SCIM-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with HANA security and analytic privileges.
  • Experience with continuous controls monitoring frameworks.
  • Exposure to SAP RISE / Grow security operating models.

raw.excerpt: About KaseyaKaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide.
raw.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

We compete in one of the most dynamic and consolidating markets in software, and we're looking for a leader to make sure we see it more clearly than anyone else.

As Director, Market & Competitive Intelligence, you'll report directly to the CMO and build a world-class intelligence function serving Product Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership. You'll create a unified understanding of our customers, markets, competitors, buyer behavior, growth opportunities, and turn that understanding into decisions that shape how Kaseya positions, prices, sells, and wins.

This is a high-visibility role with regular exposure to the executive team, real influence over strategy, and the opportunity to build a function — and a team — from a strong foundation.

You'll answer questions that matter: Which customer segments create the highest long-term value? Why do customers buy, expand, renew, or churn? Which competitors represent the biggest threat, and how do we beat them? Where should Kaseya invest next?

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own Kaseya's competitive intelligence program; competitor profiles, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and early-warning systems for competitor product launches, pricing moves, and M&A activity
  • Lead market intelligence: TAM analysis, market landscape assessments, industry trend analysis, and emerging category evaluation across the MSP and SMB IT landscape
  • Build the enterprise Voice of Customer capability, including customer research, buyer journey analysis, and a best-in-class win/loss program
  • Design and maintain Kaseya's customer segmentation framework and ensure all go-to-market teams operate against a common methodology
  • Own the measurement framework for marketing effectiveness - pipeline influence, revenue contribution, campaign performance, and funnel conversion, moving marketing from descriptive reporting toward predictive intelligence
  • Partner with Data Science and Revenue Operations on AI-enabled models for churn prediction, expansion propensity, and customer lifetime value
  • Serve as a trusted intelligence advisor to executive leadership, producing regular Executive Intelligence Reviews on market movements, competitive threats, customer sentiment, and growth opportunities
  • Embed competitive and market insight into sales onboarding, training, and live deal support and measure its impact on win rates
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of analysts and researchers, grounded in curiosity, rigor, and commercial impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, insights, analytics, product marketing, or corporate strategy
  • 3+ years leading intelligence, insights, analytics, research, or strategy teams or programs
  • B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred; experience in IT management, cybersecurity, MSP/channel, or infrastructure software is a plus
  • Demonstrated success building or significantly scaling an intelligence, insights, or analytics function
  • Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, Voice of Customer programs, competitive intelligence, and win/loss analysis
  • Exceptional analytical and synthesis skills; you move from fragmented data to a clear, defensible point of view, and translate analytics into executive decisions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to C-level executives and large sales audiences
  • Strong cross-functional leadership; able to influence without authority across product, sales, marketing, and corporate development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in private equity-backed or high-growth, acquisitive software environments
  • Familiarity with the MSP ecosystem and its competitive landscape
  • Experience with CI platforms (e.g., Klue, Crayon), analyst research (Gartner, Forrester, Canalys), and AI/ML analytics initiatives
  • Experience in subscription and retention-based businesses
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Additional information

The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable data solutions for the Manufacturing BI team, including data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, databases, APIs, data models, and Power BI reporting solutions. The role works closely with business and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Python, SQL, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Design and develop solutions using Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, databases, and data models.
  • Build data integrations and APIs across multiple enterprise data sources.
  • Develop and support Power BI reports, semantic models, and dashboards.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines, database performance, and data quality.
  • Work with Manufacturing and technical teams to define requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
  • 5+ years of experience with SQL, data engineering, ETL/ELT, and data warehouse solutions.
  • Strong SQL Server, T-SQL, data modeling, and performance-tuning skills.
  • Programming experience with Python, Java, C#, Rust, or similar languages.
  • Experience with APIs, JSON, flat files, Excel, and relational databases.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
  • Manufacturing data and Microsoft Fabric experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and AI developer tools such as Codex CLI, Claude Code, or Gemini CLI is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, or a related field.

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $7 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

About Atari

Founded in 1972, Atari is one of the world’s most iconic consumer brands and a pioneer in the video game industry, recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.

The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide. Today, Atari Inc. continues to build on its legacy by developing games, hardware, and experiences that honor the past while driving innovation for the future.

Over the past two years, we've been building Atari India, a growing team that plays a critical role in supporting our global operations. We're proud of the team we've assembled so far, and we’re just getting started. As part of a lean, high-impact organization, the team in India works closely with colleagues in North America and Europe on projects that move the company forward. Whether you're helping launch a new game, keeping our infrastructure secure, or supporting day-to-day operations, your work here matters. raw.description:
Lead Client Care Specialist (Remote Lead Receptionist) | Work for a U.S. Law Firm | Fully Remote

Lead the Voice That Makes a Difference

PJI Law, PLC is a fast-growing boutique law firm headquartered in the Washington, DC area. Every day, people contact us during some of the most stressful moments of their lives. Our Client Care team is often the very first group they speak with, and the first impression they have of our firm.

We're looking for a leader who sets the standard on every call, coaches others to meet it, and takes pride in building a team that delivers an exceptional client experience.

This is far more than managing a phone queue. You'll lead a high-performing remote team while answering calls alongside them, owning the results, and growing the people who deliver them.

No legal experience is required. We provide comprehensive training; we're looking for proven leadership, the right attitude, and a commitment to excellence.

Monthly Compensation

$1,050 USD Base Salary + Uncapped Monthly Bonus Opportunities

Your salary is paid in USD, providing stability and competitive earning potential while working remotely from South Africa. Bonus opportunities are based on your own results and your team's performance.

What You'll Be Doing

As the Lead Client Care Specialist, you'll be a player-coach: answering calls alongside your team while making sure every person who contacts our firm is greeted promptly, warmly, and professionally.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading, training, and coaching a fully remote team of Client Care Specialists, including 1:1s, team meetings, and performance reviews
  • Managing live phone coverage by scheduling breaks, lunches, and absences so no call goes unanswered between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM ET
  • Monitoring team performance daily and addressing gaps in real time
  • Assigning each team member a specialty area and holding them accountable for its results
  • Auditing call recordings and data entry daily for quality and compliance
  • Answering calls and leading by example on call quality and speed of answer
  • Partnering with the Intake Manager on hiring, onboarding, and team development
  • Ensuring the team maximizes outbound calls, 5-star reviews, and client referrals

We're Looking For Someone Who:

  • Has experience leading, supervising, or coaching a customer service or call center team
  • Holds themselves and others acountable to high standards
  • Gives direct, kind feedback and welcomes it in return
  • Has outstanding communication skills and excellent phone etiquette
  • Is fluent in spoken and written U.S. English
  • Has exceptional grammar, spelling, and attention to detail
  • Learns new technology quickly
  • Takes ownership of their team's results
  • Desires career growth and a work environment that promotes from within

This role is built for someone wired a specific way. If a missed call on your team's watch makes you twitch, if "someone else will handle it" isn't in your vocabulary, and if you'd rather coach a teammate than cover for them, we should talk.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time remote position working U.S. Eastern Time business hours, Monday – Friday.

  • Working hours will generally fall between 7:00 AM and 8:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), depending on your assigned shift.

Technology Requirements

Prior to your start date, you'll need:

  • Computer with:
  • Windows 11 or newer
  • 16 GB RAM minimum
  • 500 GB SSD or larger
  • Intel Core i5 10th Generation processor (or equivalent) minimum
  • External mouse
  • Webcam
  • Quality headset with microphone
  • UPS or inverter for uninterrupted power
  • Fiber (or equivalent) internet connection with:
  • Minimum 100 Mbps
  • Uncapped service
  • Ethernet connection (Wi-Fi is not acceptable)

Benefits

  • $1,050 USD monthly salary
  • Uncapped bonus opportunities
  • 8 Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Comprehensive training
  • Ongoing leadership development
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Supportive international team
  • Fully remote work
  • Fun team events
  • Team-oriented culture and positive work environment

Why PJI Law?

We're proud to have been recognized as a Great Place to Work® every year since 2022. We believe exceptional client experiences begin with exceptional leaders, and we invest heavily in helping our people grow and succeed.

If you're looking for a long-term remote career leading a team that values excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply

To be considered, please carefully follow the instructions below. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

Step 1

Upload your resume as a PDF.

(Please do not use Indeed's resume builder.)

Step 2

Indeed will ask:

"Anything you would like to add?"

Please respond with only the spelling mistake you found in this job posting.

Step 3

You'll then be prompted to provide a video link.

Please upload a 4–5 minute Zoom video introducing yourself and answering the following questions:

  1. Tell us about a time you coached a team member who was underperforming. What did you do, and what was the outcome?
  2. Tell us about a time your team fell short of a goal or service standard. How did you identify the problem, and what did you change?
  3. How do you balance handling your own calls while making sure your team is supported and performing?

We are looking for candidates who are prepared, thoughtful, and genuine. We'd rather hear authentic answers than perfectly rehearsed ones.

We know exceptional client experiences begin with exceptional leaders.

If you're professional, dependable, and committed to developing a team that delivers outstanding service every day, we'd love to meet you.

Salary: $1,050 USD Base Salary + Uncapped Monthly Bonus Opportunities

Location(s)

Birmingham, Alabama, CORP-Randolph-Chicago-IL, P&C-3400 N Central Expwy-Richardson-TX, P&C-N Stephanie Street-Henderson-NV, Remote-TX

Details

Kemper is one of the nation’s leading specialized insurers. Our success is a direct reflection of the talented and diverse people who make a positive difference in the lives of our customers every day. We believe a high-performing culture, valuable opportunities for personal development and professional challenge, and a healthy work-life balance can be highly motivating and productive. Kemper’s products and services are making a real difference to our customers, who have unique and evolving needs. By joining our team, you are helping to provide an experience to our stakeholders that delivers on our promises.


The AVP, Strategy & Executive Operations serves as Chief of Staff and trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution and as a member of the Distribution Executive Leadership Team. The role enhances executive effectiveness, facilitates strategic planning, coordinates cross-functional priorities, and manages the leadership operating cadence across Exclusive Agency, Personal Auto, Commercial Auto, Lead Generation, Direct to Consumer, Marketing, and Distribution Enablement.


The Chief of Staff serves as a strategic advisor and force multiplier to the Head of Distribution, shaping the leadership processes through which executive leaders align on strategy, priorities, business performance, and enterprise decisions. The role creates organizational leverage by connecting priorities across functions, anticipating risks and dependencies, improving decision quality, and ensuring leaders have the insights and alignment needed to drive business outcomes. The Head of Distribution and functional executives retain accountability for strategic choices, resource decisions, operational execution, and business results. Acting as a strategic extension of the Head of Distribution, this role synthesizes information, frames complex issues anticipates and surfaces risks and opportunities, facilitates alignment, and ensures executive commitments receive appropriate follow-through and enables effective executive decision-making across a highly matrixed organization.


The Chief of Staff does not assume accountability for business results, functional execution, project delivery, or organizational decision rights. Functional leaders remain accountable for strategy execution and outcomes. The Chief of Staff creates value through strategic insight, organizational alignment, executive decision support, and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:


Executive partnership and leadership effectiveness: Serve as a trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution; anticipate leadership needs, prepare executive briefings and decision materials, coordinate sensitive cross-functional matters, and facilitate follow-through on executive commitments and help focus leadership attention on the highest value opportunities, risks, and decisions.


Strategic planning process: Design and facilitate the annual and ongoing strategic planning process. Coordinate inputs from executive leaders, structure planning discussions, document strategic choices, and integrate functional plans into a coherent Distribution agenda while leaders retain ownership of strategy and execution.


Executive governance and operating cadence: Establish and manage leadership meetings, business reviews, planning forums, agendas, decision logs, escalation paths, and accountability tracking that enable organizational alignment, transparency, and effective execution. Coordinate executive committee, CEO, and Board materials as requested.

Cross-functional alignment: Facilitate coordination across Exclusive Agency, Personal Auto, Commercial Auto, Lead Generation, Direct to Consumer, Marketing, and Distribution Enablement, as well as Finance, Product, Underwriting, Claims, Operations, Technology, and other enterprise partners by connecting priorities, resolving ambiguity, identifying dependencies, and ensuring critical decisions and information flow effectively across organizational boundaries.


Performance insights and decision support: Coordinate executive scorecards and business performance reviews; synthesize financial, operational, customer, and distribution information; identify trends, emerging risks, opportunities, trade-offs, and strategic implications requiring leadership attention.


Strategic portfolio visibility: Maintains an integrated view of major initiatives, strategic priorities, critical dependencies, organizational friction points, and emerging risks. Proactively identify potential collisions, surface issues early, and facilitate executive dialogue to enable timely decisions and course correction.


Executive communication: Support consistent communication of Distribution priorities and leadership decisions across functions and enterprise stakeholders; prepare executive narratives, updates, and presentations.


Organizational effectiveness: Creates organizational leverage for the Head of Distribution by connecting priorities, aligning stakeholders, reducing complexity, accelerating decision-making, and ensuring leadership attention remains focused on the issues most critical to business performance and growth.


Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant experience supporting senior executives and complex business priorities, with progressive experience in strategy facilitation, executive operations, distribution, marketing, or program/portfolio governance.
  • Experience influencing multidisciplinary teams and senior leaders in a matrixed organization; direct line authority over functional execution is not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect business performance, financial outcomes, customer insights, and market dynamics into actionable executive recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive-level briefings and materials for senior management, executive committees, and Boards.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, analytical judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, and ability to synthesize complex information into actionable decisions.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, relationship-building, and organizational skills; experience in insurance, financial services, or another multichannel consumer business preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

The range for this position is $152,000 to $253,500. When determining candidate offers, we consider expereince, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location among other factors. This job is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and Kemper benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, 401K, etc.)

Kemper is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We are committed to supporting diversity and equality across our organization and we work diligently to maintain a workplace free from discrimination.  

Kemper does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Kemper and Kemper will not be obligated to pay a placement fee. 

Kemper will never request personal information, such as your social security number or banking information, via text or email. Additionally, Kemper does not use external messaging applications like WireApp or Skype to communicate with candidates. If you receive such a message, delete it.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (U.S. and globally) or in-person at ELAW’s office in Eugene, Oregon USA.

Candidates should indicate whether they intend to work remotely, or from ELAW’s Eugene office. The Eugene office is a historic building. In-person internships may include additional opportunities to interact with visiting lawyers.

Timing: 10 weeks between late May and September 2027 (full-time, ~40 hours/week). We are open to considering a different timeframe to accommodate other academic schedules. If you need a different timeframe, please clearly describe that in your application materials.

Eligibility: Open to students enrolled in or who have recently completed a graduate-level studies in environmental science. International applicants with equivalent science education are welcome to apply and should describe how their academic or professional background prepares them to succeed in this role.

The Science internship with the ELAW Science Program team involves communication in English. For applicants from non-English speaking countries, we will work with applicants to identify the best method of establishing proof of English language proficiency (including but not limited to TOEFL or IELTS scores, or enrollment in an English-speaking LLM, as proof of English language proficiency). Spanish or French as a first language or proficiency is a welcome asset.

Compensation: While applicants are encouraged to seek funding through school grants or external scholarships, financial aid status is never considered during candidate selection. ELAW will supplement external funding to guarantee that all interns receive a total rate of $17.50 per hour for 10 weeks of full-time work (up to $7,000 total).

Who We Are

Environmental Law Alliance Worldwide (ELAW) is an international NGO, registered in Oregon as a nonprofit. At ELAW, we believe that environmental protection and human rights are inseparable—and that the best solutions come from those closest to the problem. That’s why we support a global network of public interest lawyers and scientists in 80+ countries working to protect communities and ecosystems through law.

The Science & Economics team delivers timely scientific and economic expertise to global public interest advocates in pursuit of environmental justice. We respond to individual requests from public interest environmental lawyers on a broad range of topics, including public health, ecology, air and water quality, marine environments, natural resources, and climate science.

As a Science & Economics Intern, you’ll directly support these efforts—gaining hands-on experience, dedicated mentorship, and global exposure while empowering communities with science-backed arguments for systemic change. Learn more at .

What You’ll Do

Over the course of your internship, you will:

  • Conduct science research and draft memos on a wide range of scientific topics.
  • Analyze and summarize studies in the peer-reviewed scientific literature.
  • Assist with drafting of memos that answer questions pertaining to environmental science for use in submissions to courts and administrative agencies. briefs, regulatory analyses, or resource updates;
  • Participate as a collaborative member of a science team that supports interns through meaningful mentorship; and
  • Observe strategic and information gathering meetings with local lawyer partners;

Recent intern projects have included:

  • Evaluation of environmental impact assessments to identify deficiencies that might be grounds for rejecting approval of environmentally harmful projects.
  • Interpretation of air and water quality data to identify levels that pose risks to human health of wildlife and that might exceed health-based and ecological-based environmental standards

Who Thrives in This Internship

Successful interns tend to be:

  • Deeply committed to public interest environmental justice, and human rights;
  • Curious, meticulous researchers who write clearly and think critically;
  • Collaborative and communicative, but self-directed in managing time and projects;
  • Adaptable and open-minded, eager to learn across legal systems and cultures; and
  • Multilingual or bring lived experience from frontline or underrepresented communities (preferred but not required)

What Success Looks Like

  • Meaningful Scientific Contribution: You complete high-quality research and writing that directly supports frontline legal partners.
  • Strong Mentorship Relationships: You build supportive, lasting connections with ELAW scientists who care deeply about your growth.
  • Clarity on Career Path: You leave with insight into your values, your place in the global environmental justice movement, and what comes next.
  • Positive Community Impact: Your work contributes to legal tools to better protect those defending the environment.

What Makes This Internship Unique

  • Global Exposure: Interns engage with the use of scientific information in environmental advocacy with partners in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and beyond.
  • Hands-On Experience: This is not a siloed research position—you’ll work on live issues and real-world advocacy.
  • Movement-Aligned Mentorship: Interns receive clear supervision, collaborative feedback, and intentional support.
  • A Mission-Driven Team: Our team is collaborative, inclusive, and grounded in shared values—not just expertise.
  • Remote Flexibility with Real Connection: Whether remote or in Eugene, interns are included in meetings, team communications, and one-on-one check-ins.

How to Apply

Please submit one PDF file that includes the following documents in this order:

  1. Cover letter (1 page) describing your interest in ELAW and this opportunity, what you hope to gain from the internship, and relevant experiences or skills
  2. Resume or CV
  3. Legal writing sample (10 pages max)

Apply by October 23, 2026

Note: We may send updates via BambooHR. Please monitor your inbox (including spam/junk folders) for messages from us.

Our Commitment to Equity

We actively seek interns from diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from those historically underrepresented in the legal field.

We recognize that unpaid or underfunded internships create barriers for many students. To expand access, ELAW offers fully remote, 10-week full-time internships compensated at $17.50 per hour (up to $7,000 total).

We do not expect all candidates to follow the same academic or professional path. If your experience doesn't match our eligibility criteria exactly but you’ve completed rigorous science education that you believe is equivalent to two years of graduate-level science education — we encourage you to explain in your cover letter how your background prepares you to succeed in this internship.

ELAW is committed to equity, inclusion, and justice in our work and in our workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, immigration status, sexual orientation, or any other protected identity.

raw.description:
The Leidos Health and Services Sector Chief Product Office has an opening for a Backend Software Engineer to support the Health Data Extraction (HDE) product effort.

The successful candidate will design, develop, test, and maintain cloud-based backend services that process healthcare documents and data. This role combines strong software engineering skills with practical experience integrating artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, and document-processing capabilities into production applications.


The engineer will work within a cross-functional product team to transform structured and unstructured healthcare information into reliable, standards-based data products. This is primarily a software engineering and product development role, rather than a research-focused data science position.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data-processing workflows supporting the HDE product.
  • Develop production-quality Python software for document ingestion, processing, clinical data extraction, validation, enrichment, and delivery.
  • Integrate generative AI, NLP, OCR, and other machine-learning services into secure and reliable backend applications.
  • Convert product requirements, technical specifications, and data contracts into maintainable software components.
  • Build and support RESTful APIs and event-driven processing workflows.
  • Process structured and unstructured healthcare data and produce consistent, standards-based outputs.
  • Implement automated unit, integration, and regression tests to protect product quality and prevent defects.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, data, performance, and integration issues across distributed cloud services.
  • Improve application reliability through structured logging, monitoring, error handling, retries, and operational metrics.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted extraction results and help implement validation, grounding, confidence scoring, and quality-control mechanisms.
  • Optimize services for performance, scalability, resilience, and cost.
  • Protect sensitive healthcare information by following applicable security, privacy, and data-handling requirements.
  • Participate in design discussions, code reviews, estimation, sprint planning, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Work independently on moderately complex assignments while coordinating with software engineers, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, product managers, and domain specialists.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous improvement of the development process.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, with 4+ years of relevant professional experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Professional software development experience using Python or a comparable backend programming language.
  • Experience developing and supporting production backend services, APIs, or data-processing applications.
  • Understanding of object-oriented and modular software design, data structures, error handling, and maintainable coding practices.
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON-based data contracts, and asynchronous or event-driven processing.

raw.description:
Overview

Do you enjoy using research and insight to shape strategies that move complex government health opportunities forward? BerryDunn is seeking a Healthcare Capture and Opportunity Management Specialist to join our growing and evolving Business Development team.

In this role, you will help shape and advance consulting opportunities with state health and human services and Medicaid agencies, as well as other health-related entities—supporting BerryDunn in securing meaningful work that benefits communities our clients serve.

Working at the intersection of strategy, research, relationship development, and proposal development, you will bring clarity, insight, and momentum to complex pursuits. You will guide opportunities from early identification and qualification through capture planning, pursuit decisions, and transition to the proposal team. Along the way, you will collaborate with leaders to sharpen priorities, strengthen competitive positioning, and increase the likelihood of winning work that matters.

This opportunity is well suited for someone who understands how state government health opportunities develop, how public-sector purchasing decisions are made, and how to turn research and competitive intelligence into practical strategy. You will thrive here if you enjoy bringing structure to complex pursuits, identifying meaningful connections across multiple sources, building stakeholder alignment, and helping teams take purposeful action that strengthens both capture strategy and proposal content.

You Will

  • Monitor our government health pipelines and help leaders assess opportunity priorities, requirements, and strategic fit.
  • Lead day-to-day opportunity and capture management for a portfolio of state governmental health and human services, Medicaid, and other health entity-related opportunities.
  • Partner with government health leaders and subject matter experts to understand services, clients, procurement environments, and emerging needs.
  • Partner with proposal managers, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to develop pursuit and go-to-market strategies to drive growth
  • Research state agencies, Medicaid programs, health and human services priorities, procurement environments, competitors, contract vehicles, and relevant market developments.
  • Translate research and competitive intelligence into concise, decision-ready recommendations and practical pursuit actions.
  • Guide opportunities through early business development stages, including identification, qualification, capture planning, pursuit decision-making, and transition to proposal development.
  • Contribute to qualification, pursuit planning, and go/no-go conversations that consider client needs, competitive positioning, relationship strength, delivery capabilities, and pursuit viability.
  • Develop capture plans for strategic, high-value, and priority incumbent opportunities, identifying client drivers, competitors, risks, differentiators, win themes, action plans, and ownership.
  • Support proposal writing through strategic storytelling and win theme integration.
  • Develop or coordinate pre-solicitation and sales enablement materials, including opportunity briefs, capture plans, requests for information, introductory materials, and presentations.
  • Work closely with proposal professionals to help ensure that capture insights, client priorities, competitive considerations, and opportunity strategies carry into proposal development.
  • Lead or support win/loss reviews and pursuit debriefs, translating findings into recommendations for future opportunities.
  • Help business partners and Business Development team members effectively use established opportunity management and capture frameworks, tools, and processes.
  • Support go-to-market and growth planning by identifying patterns across opportunities, clients, competitors, procurement activity, and pursuit outcomes.
  • Coordinate next steps, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent opportunities and cross-functional teams.

You Have

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, public administration, political science, public health, healthcare administration, English, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least five years of progressively responsible experience in business development, capture management, opportunity management, proposal management, government contracting, consulting, complex sales, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting proposals or business development efforts for state government clients, preferably involving Medicaid, public health, behavioral health, human services, healthcare policy, or government health technology.
  • Demonstrated experience with opportunity qualification, capture planning, pursuit strategy, pipeline facilitation, or complex government proposal development.
  • Knowledge of government procurement processes, preferably state-level, and the ability to interpret public-sector solicitations, purchasing mechanisms, evaluation considerations, and procurement timelines.
  • The ability to research and synthesize client, market, procurement, and competitive information into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, including the ability to guide consequential discussions, ask productive questions, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment.
  • Sound strategic judgment and the ability to distinguish decision-critical information from background detail.
  • Experience coordinating multiple complex pursuits, stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create concise opportunity briefs, capture plans, executive summaries, and decision-ready materials.
  • The ability to build trusted relationships and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • The ability to effectively operate in an environment that may bring ambiguity, evolving priorities, and organizational change.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, procurement sites, market research platforms, and Microsoft 365 applications.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

  • Direct experience supporting business development, capture, or proposal efforts for state Medicaid agencies or state health and human services departments.
  • Familiarity with one or more governmental health areas, such as:
    • Medicaid policy, program design, or managed care
    • Medicaid enterprise systems or technology modernization
    • Public health programs and operations
    • Behavioral health or human services
    • Healthcare data, analytics, interoperability, or health information technology
    • Organizational development, training, or change management in a governmental health environment
  • Experience working in a professional services, consulting, or government contracting organization.
  • Experience with incumbent capture, recompetes, task orders, master service agreements, or other public-sector contract vehicles.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders, technical subject matter experts, proposal teams, and cross-functional business partners.
  • Professional development or certification related to capture management, proposal management, business development, or project management.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $80,000 - $95,000. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on factors such as company and personal performance. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.
