Reporting to the Director of Advocacy, this role provides direct supervision, accountability, guidance, and operational support to State Directors while helping build consistent, high-functioning advocacy programs across the region.

State Chapter Management & Supervision

Development and Onboarding of New State Chapters

Operational Coordination & Communication

Travel Requirement

This position requires regular travel within the assigned region and occasional national travel for organizational convenings, trainings, conferences, and strategic meetings.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in grassroots advocacy, community organizing, public affairs, political campaigns, nonprofit leadership, or related work.
  • 2+ years of direct people management, team leadership, or supervision experience, including coaching, performance management, and supporting professional development.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, teams, regions, or stakeholders simultaneously in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience developing and implementing grassroots advocacy or community engagement strategies.
  • Familiarity with state legislative processes, coalition engagement, and volunteer-driven advocacy efforts.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to coach, motivate, and build trust with staff, volunteers, and partners.

Preferred Skills (not required)

  • Experience managing staff or volunteers across multiple states, regions, or distributed teams.
  • Background in public health advocacy, healthcare policy, nonprofit advocacy, or issue-based grassroots campaigns.
  • Experience working with volunteer-led organizations or chapter-based organizational structures.
  • Strong facilitation, training, and leadership development skills.

Vice-Président Opérations (VPO) – unité d’affaires ERP


Présentation du poste

À la tête de l'unité d'affaires, vous êtes responsable de l'élaboration et de la mise en œuvre du plan stratégique couvrant les ventes, le support, le développement produit et les services professionnels. Le VPO est seul responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs financiers de l'unité. Avec le reste de l'équipe de direction de l'unité d'affaires, vous devez définir et exécuter les stratégies nécessaires pour atteindre vos objectifs opérationnels.


Lieu : les candidats qualifiés pourront travailler à distance / depuis un bureau à domicile au Québec.


Déplacements : nombreux déplacements à prévoir.


Responsabilités principales

  • Diriger et inspirer une équipe de direction composée des directeurs principaux des Ventes, du Support et des Services professionnels;
  • Atteindre les objectifs de revenus nets, de prises de commandes (bookings) et d'EBITA fixés par le chef de groupe et le Chef des opérations;
  • Supporter l’équipe de ventes et de services professionnels dans le processus entourant la vente à des nouveaux clients, notamment au niveau des cahiers de charges demandés par les consultants ou les clients potentiels.
  • Élaborer une stratégie claire pour l’adoption de l’AI dans l’unité d’affaires;
  • S’assurer de l’adoption de l’AI dans l’unité d’affaires en fonction des objectifs reçus et en faire le suivi et la présentation à votre chef de groupe sur une base hebdomadaire;
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre un plan triennal de croissance organique de l'unité d'affaires;
  • Présenter chaque trimestre à votre chef de groupe des bilans détaillés sur les résultats et les perspectives de l'unité d’affaires;
  • S’assurer de la préparation et du suivi du budget annuel de l’unité d’affaires;
  • Avec l'équipe de direction, fournir des points mensuels (BURC) sur l'activité à votre chef de groupe
  • Collaborer avec l'équipe de direction pour établir des plans de développement à long terme pour toutes les gammes de produits;
  • Travailler avec le portefolio leader pour identifier des cibles d'acquisition potentielles;
  • Coordonner l'intégration des acquisitions complémentaires avec l’équipe de M
  • Présenter l'actualité de l'entreprise aux employés des bureaux distants;
  • Rendre visite aux clients, partenaires et prospects lors de salons professionnels ou dans leurs locaux, sur une base régulière;
  • Entretenir la relation avec le partenaire Acumatica et s’assurer, en collaboration avec le département des finances, des versements conformes des dividendes à ce partenaire, en fonction des types de clients;

Profil recherché

  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication orale et écrite
  • Bilingue (Français et Anglais)
  • Passion de la réussite et engagement à diriger par l'exemple
  • Rigueur exceptionnelle dans la gestion des ressources financières
  • Minimum de cinq ans d'expérience en direction générale, de préférence dans une entreprise de logiciels verticaux
  • Expérience de la direction d'un groupe pluridisciplinaire d'au moins 25 personnes
  • Expérience de la gestion d'un compte de résultat (P&L) complet


*Seul les candidats retenus seront contactés.

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et les candidatures des membres des groupes visés à savoir les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les personnes autochtones et les minorités visibles sont encouragées à soumettre leur candidature. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L'équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris n'a pas recours aux messages texte pour entrer en communication avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler sur des postes publiés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe de recrutement de talents pour un entretien, dès lors que les critères requis sont satisfaits.

Position Summary

BeLoved Hospice is seeking a compassionate, experienced, and clinically skilled On-Call Overnight Registered Nurse (RN) to provide remote after-hours triage and support for hospice patients and families across multiple states, including Oregon and Nevada. This fully remote position serves as the primary overnight clinical resource, responding to patient and caregiver concerns, performing telephonic assessments, coordinating interventions, and supporting field clinicians to ensure exceptional end-of-life care.

The ideal candidate is an experienced hospice nurse who can work independently, make sound clinical decisions, and provide calm, compassionate guidance during urgent and emotionally sensitive situations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary overnight clinical contact for hospice patients, families, caregivers, facilities, and referral sources.
  • Perform comprehensive telephonic triage assessments and determine appropriate interventions based on patient needs.
  • Provide symptom management guidance and education related to pain, respiratory distress, anxiety, nausea, agitation, and other end-of-life conditions.
  • Collaborate with field nurses, hospice physicians, nurse practitioners, and interdisciplinary team members to coordinate patient care.
  • Determine the need for and coordinate emergent or routine nursing visits when appropriate.
  • Document all patient interactions, assessments, recommendations, and interventions accurately and timely within the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Support and advise field staff who are providing in-person care during overnight hours.
  • Ensure compliance with hospice regulations, organizational policies, and standards of practice across multiple states.
  • Participate in clinical handoff communication to ensure continuity of care between overnight and daytime teams.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements.

Qualifications Required

  • Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain licensure in Oregon, Nevada, and potentially more states in the future.
  • Minimum of 2 years of hospice, palliative care, home health, or related nursing experience.
  • Strong clinical assessment and critical-thinking skills.
  • Experience conducting telephonic or remote patient triage.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and customer service skills.
  • Proficiency with electronic medical records and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated remote workspace.

Preferred

  • Multi-state nursing licensure or eligibility.
  • Compact nursing license (NLC) where applicable.
  • Previous after-hours or on-call hospice experience.
  • Knowledge of hospice regulations and standards in multiple states.
  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed clinical teams.

Work Schedule

  • Overnight on-call coverage on Friday-Monday or Monday-Thurs.
  • Fully remote position.
  • May include weekdays, weekends, and holidays as assigned.
  • Must be available to respond promptly to calls and clinical concerns throughout scheduled shifts.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.
  • Ability to communicate effectively by telephone and video conferencing platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain focus in a fast-paced environment.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients and families during critical moments of care.
  • Collaborative interdisciplinary team culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package (if applicable).

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

raw.title: Software Engineer, Integrations (US + Calgary)
raw.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
raw.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the Role:

We are seeking a Software Engineer to build, maintain, and manage our integration platforms, ensuring scalable, reliable, and secure data flows across systems. This role is crucial as integrations become central to our service delivery. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing workflows, managing connectors and APIs, and providing ongoing support for integration performance.

At its core, this role is about transforming how data flows at Syndio and building the future of all data ingestion across the company.

Why this job is exciting:

  • Build the front door to Syndio — Data Hub is where every customer starts and the foundation every analysis runs on, so you'll decide how they connect a system, map their fields, and see exactly what came through.
  • Keep it fast at scale — customer datasets run to hundreds of thousands of employees across dozens of sources, and holding refresh times as that grows is a standing engineering problem, not a one-time fix.
  • Integrate against HRIS, ATS, and payroll APIs, building the platform's native connections and handling the real-world mess of auth flows, pagination, rate limits, schema drift, and partial failures.
  • Make failures legible by turning opaque sync errors into clear, actionable feedback so customers and Customer Success can resolve issues without an engineer in the loop.
  • Improve the implementation platform, collaborating with Forward Deployed Engineering and Implementation to understand what customers need and grow the platform's capabilities to meet more of it out of the box.
  • Work across a real distributed system spanning a Go API, Temporal workflows, a Python transformation engine, and a customer-facing frontend, following problems wherever they lead instead of stopping at a service boundary.
  • Raise the standards by establishing the patterns, documentation, and error-handling conventions that let integrations scale past what any one person can hold in their head.

Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years building and shipping production software, with solid backend fundamentals. Python and/or Go preferred.
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining integrations against third-party APIs — REST/SOAP, webhooks, OAuth and API-key auth, pagination, rate limiting, and handling upstream schema changes.
  • Experience with data pipelines and orchestration: scheduling, retries, sequencing, and monitoring workflows across systems.
  • Solid SQL and the ability to reason about data models and transformations.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, CRM, or ERP systems and their data models.
  • Strong documentation habits and a bias toward making your work legible to others.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams — you'll work directly with Customer Success and Implementation.

Nice to have:

  • Frontend experience (TypeScript/React or equivalent) and interest in building the product surface customers use to connect their systems.
  • Experience with iPaaS tools (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Tray.io, Celigo) and a point of view on when to build versus buy an integration.
  • Workflow orchestration engines (Temporal, Airflow)
  • File-based ingestion at scale — SFTP, CSV, flat-file pipelines and the validation they demand.
  • Working with sensitive employee or compensation data and the security and privacy practices that requires.

About You:

  • You like building products people depend on, and you care about the experience of whoever's on the other end — not just whether the pipeline ran.
  • You've worked with sensitive data and treat security, privacy, and compliance as part of your job rather than someone else's.
  • You've seen customer onboarding up close and know the ways cross-system data flows go wrong in practice.
  • You're comfortable in unfamiliar territory — reading a third-party API's docs, tracing a bad record back through a pipeline, and working out what actually happened.
  • You want a say in where the platform goes over the long term, and you're eager to grow into that as you learn the domain.
  • You are a strong communicator, collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical teams across levels and functions.
  • You assume positive intent, are humble and eager, expect the best from yourself, value partnership over perfection, and provide grace and understanding in stressful situations
  • You value a remote work environment and know that it requires greater intentionality on your part to build and maintain strong working relationships
  • You are based in Calgary and legally authorized to work in Alberta without need for additional visa support now or in the future.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at: $125,000 - $148,000 CAD per year in Canada / $140-160k USD in the United States. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success
  • 🏝 20 days annually in Canada. Flexible PTO in the US. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave
  • 🩺 Additional Private Medical coverage
  • 📍 Remote-First (within commuting distance of Calgary)

Role progression:

  • In the first 30 days: Focus on onboarding, mastering our core integration platforms and tools, and independently handling bug fixes and documentation updates. By the end of this period, you will have completed your first small-scale integration task.
  • In the first 60 days: Independently manage and optimize a portfolio of existing integrations, troubleshoot complex cross-system issues, and lead the build-out of new, standard integration workflows.
  • In the first 90 days: Design and implement advanced integration architectures, establish enterprise-level governance standards, and spearhead high-impact collaboration projects across engineering and customer success teams.

The Interview Overview:

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Software Engineer, Integrations position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  1. 30min phone call with a member of our Talent Team

Gestalte die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mit Daten
Seit dem Zusammenschluss mit LOGEX verantwortet Tiplu den gesamten DACH-Markt. Hier kommen zwei Welten zusammen: die analytische Tiefe von LOGEX in Kostenstrukturen im Krankenhaus, Portfoliosteuerung und Kostenträgerrechnung, Benchmarking und Portfoliosteuerung und die Nähe von Tiplu zu klinischen Daten und deren Verwendung in Lösungen primär für das Medizincontrolling.

Bei uns verbinden sich Finanz- und Medizindaten zu einem Gesamtbild des Krankenhauses: vom einzelnen Behandlungsfall über die Abteilung bis zur strategischen Entscheidung der Geschäftsführung.

Wir arbeiten mit kurzen Wegen, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und dem Anspruch, Software zu bauen, die im Krankenhaus wirklich ankommt. Du profitierst vom Rückhalt einer europäischen Gruppe und arbeitest gleichzeitig in einem Team, das den deutschsprachigen Markt kennt, versteht und prägt.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Product Consultant bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, unseren datengetriebenen Lösungen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen im Krankenhausumfeld.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Beratung unserer Kunden bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Deckungsbeitrags- und Kostenträgerrechnungen

  • Implementierung von Prozesskostenrechnungs- und Benchmarking-Modellen

  • Durchführung von Portfolioanalysen, Planungen und Simulationen mithilfe der LOGEX Software-Suite

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Datenarchitekturen für betriebswirtschaftliche Massendaten- und Echtzeitdatenverarbeitung

  • Entwicklung aussagekräftiger Kennzahlen, Reports und Dashboards für Chefärzt*innen, Klinikmanagement und Geschäftsführungen

  • Beratung von Krankenhäusern zu Themen wie Prozessoptimierung, Portfoliosteuerung und wirtschaftlichem Ressourceneinsatz

  • Analyse komplexer Datenbestände sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen

  • Präsentation von Projektergebnissen und strategischen Handlungsempfehlungen vor Führungskräften, Chefärzt*innen und Entscheidungsgremien

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium mit betriebswirtschaftlicher und / oder IT-Ausrichtung, (Gesundheits-/Krankenhausökonomie, Betriebswirtschaftslehre)

  • Fachkenntnisse bzw. erste Berufserfahrung im Krankenhaus / Krankenhauscontrolling wären vorteilhaft, konkrete Kenntnisse der Kostenträgerrechnung / InEK-Kalkulation wären ideal

  • Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse oder zumindest erste praktische Erfahrung in den Bereichen Data Warehouse und Business Intelligence

  • Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen im Bereich SQL, Tableau oder QlikSense

  • Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Du hast Freude daran, dich kontinuierlich mit unserer Unterstützung in neue Technologien und fachliche Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Eine ausgereifte Affinität zur IT ist ein Pluspunkt

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen mit spannenden Karrierechancen

  • Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit direktem Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des Gesundheitswesens

  • Spannende Projekte bei führenden Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitsdienstleistern

  • Ein internationales Umfeld mit über 450 Kolleg*innen in ganz Europa

  • Moderne Technologien und datengetriebene Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Remote-Arbeiten für eine gute Work-Life-Balance

  • Ein engagiertes Team mit hoher fachlicher Expertise und ausgeprägtem Teamgeist

Werde Teil von Tiplu - a LOGEX company.
Du möchtest mit Daten einen echten Unterschied im Gesundheitswesen machen und Krankenhäuser bei wichtigen strategischen Entscheidungen unterstützen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Kontaktieren Sie uns!

Sie können sich ganz einfach über den untenstehenden Button bewerben und Ihren Lebenslauf hochladen. Für weitere Informationen oder bei Fragen wenden Sie sich gerne an Wesley Schreuder unter .

Wir setzen uns für ein Arbeitsumfeld ein, das Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und Inklusion fördert. Wir sind überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor ist. Deshalb möchten wir einen Arbeitsplatz schaffen, an dem sich alle Menschen wertgeschätzt und respektiert fühlen – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Religion oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich alle qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

raw.description:
EdOps Finance Team Manager- Independent Schools Team

EdOps’ Finance Team Manager position is an ideal role for accounting or finance professionals interested in using their skills to manage a team of finance professionals and directly serve independent school clients in a leadership role within a mission-driven context. The Finance Team Manager position is designed for individuals with significant experience managing professionals. As the manager of a team of finance staff, the Finance Team Manager provides quality control to ensure work best meets the needs of schools. The manager is also responsible for staff support, developing staff technical and soft skill competencies, and guiding staff career paths.

Reports to the Director or Senior Finance Team Managers. Location flexible (this is a remote position). Part time arrangements possible for exceptional candidates.

Who we are:

EdOps is a Washington, DC-based B-Corp focused on minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance demands of running a school and supporting education leaders with data-driven insights to improve student outcomes. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. We work with all the schools that need us. Our growing team of 100+ professionals work with over 100 schools and school networks nationwide. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 99% annual client retention rate and rapid growth rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact, and we were recognized as a Washington Post Top Workplace. We are looking for education focused, finance and accounting loving, collaborative people to join our team.

What you will do:

  • As the front line manager of a team of analysts and finance specialists (generally teams of 2-5 but at least 2), deliver on all of the EdOps People Manager Expectations including:
  • Train and coach staff as part of standard training sessions and beyond, so that they meet and exceed expectations for their role and are developing towards their goals.
  • Guide and support staff’s career paths through EdOps via discussion, navigation and collaborative planning.
  • Develop and conduct Annual Reviews, Mid Year Deep Dives for direct reports with input from EdOps colleagues and clients.
  • Address underperformance and develop PIPs as necessary.
  • Decide on staff promotion timing (with approval of the Director).
  • Create and maintain a team work culture that is inclusive and fair.
  • Resolve staff issues as necessary.
  • Informing upwards on trends.
  • Create and maintain a team work culture that is inclusive and fair.
  • Ensure that their team’s client work meets EdOps quality standards:
  • Provide the necessary project management to ensure that EdOps work is completed on timely with general expected quality
  • Support in the accounting review of schools and implement team specific QC mechanisms to have reasonable certainty that work meets EdOps standards. Adapt QC processes and cadence as necessary for individuals on their team while ensuring staff are in compliance with EdOps’s standard approach to QC.
  • At times, problem solve or find solutions for the more complex parts of the work.
  • Serve as an outsourced controller for at least one school by overseeing all day-to-day full-cycle accounting and compliance aspects of the schools:
  • Close the books monthly/quarterly/annually and support the preparation of monthly financial statements.
  • Oversee federal, state, and local grants administration.
  • Serve as a school’s primary contact during annual financial audits and 990 preparation.
  • Support the annual budgeting process in partnership with School Finance Managers.
  • Liaise with a school’s state education authority (SEA) as needed.
  • Contribute to Edops’s continual improvement of our finance service line efficiency and accuracy. Gather information, notice trends, and make recommendations to Directors to improve product and processes, identify service/tools needed, and address issues.
  • Make recommendations, inform and collaborate with the Director of People Operations to optimize our people operations wide practices and approaches.
  • Play an active role in the ongoing recruitment process of new staff.
  • Some Managers, who will have a smaller team and/or staffed on fewer clients, can have specializations that encompass responsibilities not outlined here (e.g., overseeing changes to regional compliance, facilities accounting).

What you will accomplish:

By Year 1 you will have:

  • Sharpened your expertise in people management by leading a team of accounting and finance professionals.
  • Contributed to the development of the finance team’s operational changes.
  • Solved small, real problems for schools on a daily basis.
  • Independently managed the annual financial cycle for at least 1 school

By Year 3 you will have:

  • Contributed to EdOps continual improvement of our finance service line by collaborating on internal process improvements for the finance service line.
  • Possibly, specialized in an area of your own interest such as new hire onboarding and training, quality control, tool design and development, or liaising with state education agencies and/or authorizers to ensure new compliance requirements are disseminated to the whole team.
  • Continue to manage a team of accounting and finance professionals.
  • Continue to solve real problems, small and large, for schools every day.

Who you are:

  • Enjoy leading teams and helping them grow and navigate challenges they encounter in their work.
  • Accounting or finance professional who enjoys the work and is committed to delivering on the accuracy, clarity, and integrity that strong accounting and finance can bring to organizations.
  • Find meaning in applying your professional skills in support of mission-driven organizations.
  • Strong in independent problem solving. We are a very collaborative community that supports each other, but our Finance Team Managers are independent and solve new problems every day.
  • Energized by being in a customer service role. We are here first and foremost to serve our school clients.
  • Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Open to learning and growing in these areas together so that each of us can contribute to building a culture of equity and support our schools in advancing these values. Please see more on EdOps' commitment here.

What you need:

  • Experience managing teams of finance or accounting professionals.
  • Strong organization and time management skills. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities while meeting deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience with accounting systems (e.g. QuickBooks Online) and capacity to learn new systems.
  • Ability to write and clearly document processes and procedures.
  • Intermediate Excel skills.
  • Ability to interface professionally with clients.
  • Typically, Finance Team Managers have 10+ years of work or post-secondary educational experience, including 3+ years of management or supervisory experience.
  • Experience working with schools or non-profit organizations is a plus.
  • Audit experience is a plus.

What you get:

  • The chance to challenge and develop your management skills while using them to help our team be better.
  • Opportunity to work every day with colleagues who are committed to kids and supportive of each other’s efforts.
  • EdOps salaries are commensurate with relative experience and geographic location. The range for the Finance Team Manager position is $96,200-128,000/year.
  • Check out other perks of working at EdOps here. And some details on benefits here.

We know that a team from a wide range of backgrounds with different life experiences, identities, opinions, and talents makes us better able to innovate and deliver on our mission of supporting schools to improve student outcomes. Every day we work to build an inclusive company culture where everyone can be themselves at work and do their best work.

Apply:

If you are skilled in your field, excited by our mission, ready to learn, and looking for a place where you can be yourself, we want to hear from you!

What you can expect from the hiring process:

  • Application Review
  • First Review
  • Performance Task
  • Final Interviews (Behavioral, Technical, Values)
  • Reference Check
  • Offer
Salary: $96,000 – $128,000 / year

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic individual to join us as a Talent Manager.

Role Overview

The Talent Manager owns and grows relationships with an assigned talent roster and actively recruits new creators to Mythic Talent. You're the primary advocate, strategist, and long-term partner for your talent, making sure they feel supported, valued, and aligned with both their own goals and Mythic's broader vision.

Success is measured by talent retention and new talent signings. The right person is relationship-driven, highly organized, proactive, and deeply invested in creators' long-term success.

Key responsibilities

Talent relationship ownership

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner and main point of contact for assigned talent — their trusted representative and advocate inside Mythic
  • Build long-term relationships grounded in trust and transparency, aligned with each creator's career goals
  • Keep regular, proactive communication going to understand talent goals, needs, concerns, and feedback
  • Advocate for talent internally so their needs are clearly communicated and addressed across teams
  • Handle sensitive conversations, escalations, performance concerns, and strategic planning directly with talent

Deal oversight

  • Work closely with Sales, Campaign Management, and Brand Partners to ensure talent activations are executed flawlessly
  • Bring talent priorities and feedback back to internal teams to improve processes and offerings

Talent development & growth

  • Support long-term career goals, including audience growth, brand positioning, and diversifying revenue streams
  • Spot and recommend growth opportunities: platform expansion, content strategy, collaborations, and audience engagement
  • Help talent explore and launch merch, product, or IP-based opportunities with internal teams and external partners
  • Help talent weigh opportunities strategically, balancing short-term monetization against long-term brand equity
  • Stay on top of industry trends, platform changes, and emerging opportunities

Talent retention

  • Maintain high retention across your roster and manage long-term value to both the talent and Mythic
  • Run retention strategies: regular check-ins, career planning, and value-add initiatives
  • Track satisfaction and engagement, and get ahead of churn risks before they escalate
  • Partner with leadership to keep improving the talent experience

Talent acquisition & roster growth

  • Source, evaluate, and sign new talent aligned with Mythic's brand, values, and strategic priorities
  • Evaluate prospects on growth trajectory, professionalism, brand safety, and long-term earning potential
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective talent
  • Own the end-to-end signing process: relationship building, pitching Mythic's value proposition, and onboarding
  • Lead onboarding so new talent gets a smooth, welcoming, well-structured start
  • Track the creator landscape, emerging talent, and competitive representation activity

Reporting & accountability

  • Keep visibility into talent health, deal flow, and coordinator performance across your roster
  • Give department leadership regular updates on talent performance, pipeline growth, and signings
  • Uphold Mythic's professional standards, confidentiality, exclusivity policies, and ethical guidelines

Additional duties may be assigned as needed to meet organizational needs.

Expectations

  • Professionalism: Maintain a high level of integrity, confidentiality, and accountability when working with talents and external partners.
  • Adaptability: Be flexible and resourceful in responding to industry shifts, last-minute scheduling changes, or unexpected issues.
  • Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely communication to talents, teammates, and leadership.
  • Results Orientation: Meet or exceed performance targets, including revenue goals, client satisfaction, and talent retention.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Talent Management, or a related field or equivalent work experience
  • Experience:
    • At least 2 years of experience in talent management
    • Experience working with various tiers of talent or clients, including high-profile individuals

Skills

  • Strong project management, relationship-building, and communication skills
  • Ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in CRM or project management software, as well as standard office tools
  • Willingness to adapt to flexible schedules and quickly respond to real-time challenges

Physical Demands

  • Able to sit and/or stand for the duration of the workday
  • Able to use a keyboard, headset, and computer monitor for the workday

Must have access to a reliable computer and any other equipment necessary to perform the role. Mythic Talent does not provide equipment for this position, except where required by applicable law.

raw.description:
Leidos is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join our dynamic and exciting EPC Solutions Team. You'll design overhead and underground transmission systems for major developer and utility clients — real projects, real construction dates, real impact on how power moves across the country. And you won't be doing it alone in a corner: this team runs on close collaboration across engineering disciplines, with a PE mentor invested in helping you grow into the next stage of your career.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Design & Analysis — Model and analyze transmission structures using PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, and PLS-TOWER, applying NESC, ASCE, ACI, IEEE, and related standards
  • Project Development — Support projects from conceptual routing and engineering analysis through material procurement and construction-ready packages, through as-builts and project close-out
  • Cross-Discipline Collaboration — Work alongside designers and engineers from other disciplines, plus project management teams, to keep designs moving toward the field
  • Client Interface — Participate in client-facing project work, building the communication skills that set senior engineers apart
  • Technical Growth — Work under the direct guidance of a licensed PE, with increasing ownership of design decisions as your judgment develops

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform structure spotting and transmission line design in PLS-CADD to verify conductor clearances and loading under NESC or GO95
  • Design and analyze steel, wood, concrete, or fiberglass transmission structures using PLS-POLE, including structure selection and loading verification
  • Underbuild/joint-use or attachment analysis, when required
  • Perform foundation design or analysis for direct-embed and drilled-pier structures in MFAD or LPILE
  • Prepare construction packages, including creating the basis of design, plan and profiles, staking sheets, bill of materials, structure data sheets, alignment maps, stringing charts, steel packages, foundation drawings, etc.
  • Coordinate with the Construction prime on material procurement, material specs, and constructability
  • Perform conductor selection and EMF studies
  • Attend field walks and constructability reviews as needed
  • Support proposal/estimating efforts

What You Bring (Required Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil, Structural, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in electric utility transmission line design with Bachelor's degree OR 3 years of relevant combined experience with a Master's degree
  • Proficiency in both PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while staying plugged into a team
  • Candidates must be located in the United States to be considered

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with TOWER
  • EIT certification (or actively pursuing)
  • Exposure to FAD, Mathcad, AutoCAD or MicroStation, LPILE, or GIS tools
  • Familiarity with Bentley ProjectWise

Why This Team:

  • Mentorship that matters — direct PE supervision means real technical guidance, not just sign-offs
  • Room to grow — clear path toward independent design ownership, EIT/PE milestones, and eventually leading your own scopes
  • Genuine cross-training — early exposure to structural and construction considerations most engineers don't see until much later
  • Work that ships — your designs become physical infrastructure, not shelved deliverables

At Leidos, We pride ourselves on being a trusted and technology-focused solutions provider. Delivery Services Team is the go-to for utilities and mobile operators who need reliable power and telecommunication expertise. We've worked with over 50 investor-owned utilities, over 160 municipals/cooperatives, and we're continuing to expand our reach. Plus, we've got an amazing group of industry-leading construction partners who help us deliver meaningful Energy Delivery Solutions. Our recognition as an industry leader has been confirmed time and time again. Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked Leidos among the Top 10 T&D Firms and Top 10 Power Firms.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Bureau Veritas offers dynamic, exciting employment opportunities with an attractive salary/benefit package and an opportunity to play a vital role with a global organization. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are looking for an opportunity to become part of a stellar team of professionals, we invite you to apply online today.

Bureau Veritas is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, sexual orientation, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other non-job-related characteristics.

This position is responsible to ensure equal opportunity in employment in that all persons are treated equally and on the basis of merit, in decisions regarding selection, placement, promotions, training, work assignments, transfers and other personnel actions.

City: Remote

State: Texas

JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION: Development Services Coordinator
REPORTS TO: Director of Development Services

JOB SUMMARY:

The Development Services Coordinator provides administrative, project management, contract, client, and operational support across Bureau Veritas's Development Services Division. The position supports Short-Range Services, Long-Range Services, and Private Development, including Planning, Engineering, Public Works, Compliance and Resource Development, GIS, and Asset Management.

Reporting directly to the Division Director, the Coordinator serves as the primary operational support resource responsible for maintaining organized project records, tracking deadlines, facilitating communications, coordinating deliverables, supporting financial administration, and ensuring the efficient movement of projects from initiation through completion.

The position plays an important role in supporting municipal contracts and private development projects while facilitating coordination with Bureau Veritas's Commercial and Residential Building teams for plan review, permitting, and inspection services.

The Coordinator works closely with division leadership, branch managers, technical personnel, business development representatives, and corporate support departments to maintain consistent procedures, improve operational efficiency, and ensure a responsive client experience.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Project Management and Administrative Coordination
• Establish, organize, maintain, and close projects within Bureau Veritas project management and document management systems.
• Maintain accurate project records, including assigned personnel, scopes of work, schedules, milestones, deliverables, budgets, and client deadlines.
• Coordinate project intake, internal assignments, staff schedules, project meetings, and client communication.
• Develop and maintain project tracking reports, status summaries, action-item logs, meeting agendas, and meeting minutes.
• Monitor active project schedules and communicate approaching deadlines, incomplete assignments, and outstanding deliverables to appropriate personnel.
• Track development applications, subdivision and zoning reviews, public hearings, permit milestones, infrastructure inspections, regulatory compliance deadlines, and project closeout requirements.
• Assist technical staff and project managers with document preparation, distribution, and follow-up coordination.
• Support multiple municipal and private development projects simultaneously while maintaining consistent organization and accountability.

2. Client Relations and Communication

  • Serve as a central point of contact for routine client communications, scheduling, project status requests, and administrative inquiries.
    • Coordinate communication between municipal clients, private developers, consultants, technical staff, and division leadership.
    • Schedule and organize client meetings, project coordination calls, public meetings, and internal operational discussions.
    • Prepare routine correspondence, meeting summaries, project updates, and follow-up communications.
    • Maintain current municipal client contact information, organizational records, and contract assignments.
    • Assist with tracking client requests, service issues, and outstanding action items to ensure timely resolution.
    • Support consistent communication standards and professional client service across all division branches.
    3. Contract Administration, Proposals, and Financial Support
    • Maintain organized contract records, including executed agreements, scopes of services, amendments, task orders, purchase orders, authorizations, insurance requirements, and renewal dates.
    • Track contract milestones, expiration dates, renewal opportunities, and required administrative actions.
    • Assist with preparation of proposals, qualifications packages, fee schedules, scope documents, staffing plans, and supporting exhibits.
    • Coordinate proposal deadlines, required documentation, internal approvals, and final submissions.
    • Maintain records of project budgets, authorized contract amounts, billing milestones, and changes in project scope.
    • Coordinate with project managers and billing personnel to prepare invoice support documentation, including project activity summaries, time records, reimbursable expenses, and client billing information.
    • Assist with reconciliation of project tracking information against billing records and authorized scopes.
    • Monitor outstanding billing documentation and coordinate invoice-related follow-up with appropriate personnel.
    • Maintain dashboards identifying active contracts, pending proposals, prospective opportunities, project workload, and revenue-related activities.
    • Provide administrative support for monthly, quarterly, and annual operational reporting.
    4. Technical Project Delivery and Document Control
    • Coordinate the routing of applications, plans, reports, technical reviews, inspection documentation, and project correspondence among assigned professionals.
    • Maintain standardized electronic project files for Planning, Engineering, Public Works, Compliance, GIS, and Asset Management assignments.
    • Track review cycles, resubmittals, outstanding comments, approval milestones, and deliverable completion.
    • Support the preparation and distribution of technical review letters, staff reports, project summaries, meeting packets, and client deliverables.
    • Perform administrative quality-control checks to verify project names, dates, document versions, attachments, formatting, and distribution information.
    • Assist with coordination of required public notice and hearing procedures, including notification schedules, publication deadlines, mailing lists, agenda materials, and confirmation records.
    • Organize project documentation to support municipal recordkeeping, regulatory compliance, and contractual requirements.
    • Coordinate project closeout activities, including final documentation, outstanding deliverables, billing support, and file archiving.
    5. Building Division Coordination and Project Handoffs
    • Coordinate transitions from Development Services to Bureau Veritas's Commercial and Residential Building teams.
    • Maintain standardized project handoff procedures and documentation requirements.
    • Assemble project handoff packages containing approved scopes, client contacts, project descriptions, regulatory approvals, infrastructure status, and outstanding project conditions.
    • Coordinate communications between planning, engineering, inspection, public works, and building review personnel.
    • Track projects requiring subsequent commercial or residential plan review, building permitting, or inspection services.
    • Assist in identifying opportunities for additional Bureau Veritas services during project transitions.
    • Maintain records of completed handoffs and monitor outstanding coordination items to support uninterrupted client service.
    6. Division Operations and Process Improvement
    • Maintain standardized folder structures, file naming conventions, document templates, project tracking systems, and administrative procedures.
    • Assist in developing, documenting, and implementing standard operating procedures across Development Services branches.
    • Support implementation and maintenance of SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, project management platforms, CRM systems, and other operational tools.
    • Maintain division-wide dashboards for staffing assignments, project status, client activity, deadlines, and operational performance.
    • Identify administrative inefficiencies, missing information, workflow delays, and opportunities for process improvement.
    • Coordinate shared administrative resources and information among branch managers and technical teams.
    • Assist division leadership with operational planning, reporting, scheduling, and special projects.
    • Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of client records, contractual documents, and internal business information.
    7. Business Development and Marketing Support
    • Maintain municipal and private-sector client databases, contact lists, prospect records, and business development tracking information.
    • Assist with development of capability statements, marketing materials, qualifications packages, and proposal presentations.
    • Coordinate administrative aspects of conferences, professional events, client meetings, and business development activities.
    • Track prospective contracts, follow-up actions, proposal submissions, and client engagement activities.
    • Assist with compiling supporting information for service expansion, staffing plans, and division growth initiatives.
    • Coordinate with Bureau Veritas business development and marketing personnel to ensure consistent communication and presentation of Development Services capabilities.
    KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
    • Knowledge of administrative and project coordination practices within professional services, municipal government, engineering, planning, construction, or related environments.
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and overlapping deadlines.
    • Ability to maintain accurate project records, contract information, billing documentation, and operational reports.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
    • Working knowledge of SharePoint, electronic records management, and project tracking systems.
    • Ability to develop and maintain spreadsheets, project dashboards, status reports, and document control systems.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with municipal clients, developers, technical personnel, and corporate departments.
    • Knowledge of basic contract administration, proposal coordination, and project billing procedures.
    • Ability to identify discrepancies, missing documentation, overdue assignments, and potential coordination issues.
    • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation, project tracking, and administrative quality control.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting a geographically distributed team.
    • Ability to handle confidential business, contractual, financial, and client information appropriately.
    • Ability to adapt to new systems, procedures, and changing operational priorities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate degree or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Project Management, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
    • Equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and professional experience may be considered.
    • Three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in project coordination, administrative support, business operations, client relations, team coordination, or organizational management.

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Possesses valid Texas Class “C" license when hired.

Why Ethicrithm?

Ethicrithm Inc. is a Palantir partner serving clients across North America. We specialize in integrating and structuring enterprise data, developing AI-driven solutions, and implementing intelligent operating systems with Palantir Foundry and AIP. We deliver secure, scalable, and impactful solutions that optimize business operations and drive measurable returns on investment, impact and results. We’re building a high-performance team of humble, helpful, and client-oriented teammates.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you own the successful delivery and real-world impact of Palantir Foundry for our clients. Your role is to deeply understand clients’ most critical operational problems and translate those needs into workflows and capabilities that drive meaningful outcomes.

You work closely with client teams across the organization—from frontline operators to executive leaders—to understand how decisions are made, what the data reveals, and how Foundry can be applied to improve those decisions in practice. You guide deployments from early problem framing through execution, ensuring solutions are adopted, trusted, and impactful.

You excel in ambiguous, fastmoving environments, creating clarity by forming hypotheses, testing assumptions, and iterating quickly to move clients toward their highest value outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Scoping: Engage with stakeholders through workshops and interviews across the client’s business to deeply understand their business processes, friction points, strategic goals, and data landscape.
  • Solution Design: Develop capabilities that deliver impact in the client’s business by determining how Foundry can be implemented against business problems.
  • Deployment Governance: Oversee the governance framework for deployments, ensuring shared understanding of objectives, scope, timelines, and execution approach. Track progress, surface risks, and communicate value delivered throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Driving User Adoption: Drive user adoption through training, friction removal, and sustained partnership with end users.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build relationships with executives, operators, and technical leads; align teams on shared goals; and navigate competing priorities to keep delivery focused on outcomes.
  • Value Realization: Define and measure the impact of deployments and demonstrate the value delivered to clients.
  • Services Feedback: Surface insights from the field to provide tangible recommendations on Ethicrithm’s practices.
  • Field Engagement: Go onsite to meet with client operators, understand the critical questions they need to answer, and locate their highest-impact problems firsthand.
  • Data Identification: Identify the relevant datasets that matter most by deeply engaging with client workflows and understanding how data connects to the decisions clients are trying to improve.
  • Growth and Expansion: Scope out potential engagements in new industries and expanding geographies, helping to shape where Ethicrithm goes next.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Technical Aptitude: A strong understanding of software and data concepts. You can write code that works, architect solutions, and solve technical problems alongside Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs).
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically about client challenges and develop innovative solutions
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of business principles and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Project Management: Proven project management skills, including experience developing and executing project plans
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify and address potential roadblocks
  • Client-Facing Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with clients. Empathy and a desire to understand client needs
  • Ability to travel in Canada and the US (approx 5% travel) without the need for Visas or other documents requiring processing time

Preferred with flexibility for the exceptional candidates

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
  • Experience designing and delivering technical solutions
  • Deep experience working with data (analysis, modeling, data engineering)
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry / AIP
  • Experience with Python and/or TypeScript

Drive user growth by turning analytics into business impact

At Resmed, you’ll transform how we understand and grow our connected-device user base. As the User Data Growth Analytics Lead, you’ll lead the measurement framework that explains what drives user engagement, retention, and expansion—and how those dynamics connect directly to demand and revenue. In this role, you’ll help Resmed make smarter, faster decisions about how to grow value across millions of active users.

You’ll collaborate across Finance, Product, and Commercial teams to connect insights from our digital ecosystem, including myAir and AirView, with the financial performance that drives our continued growth. Your analysis will shape trusted metrics, forecasting models, and next-generation analytics products that help connect patient engagement to commercial outcomes.

You’ll bring a consumer-first lens to healthcare, building experimental approaches that move quickly from analysis to action. This is your chance to help Resmed evolve the way we measure and grow user outcomes—by teaching us new ways to think about engagement and retention.

What you’ll do

  • Define the analytics foundation - Own and evolve the measurement framework for our user base, shaping clear KPIs for engagement, retention, and experience enhancement across connected platforms.
  • Tell the story behind the data - Build cohort and lifecycle analyses to explain user behaviors, identify growth opportunities, and clarify what drives retention or churn.
  • Translate insight into financial impact - Link user dynamics to commercial performance, connecting engagement and retention metrics directly to demand and revenue outcomes.
  • Drive cross-functional visibility, insights, and accountability – Partner across Product, Marketing, Finance and Commercial teams to analyze business performance, identify drivers of growth and retention, and align actions to improve outcomes. Elevate actionable insights to leadership to inform strategic decisions, drive cross-functional accountability, and strengthen business performance.
  • Shape scalable data products - Collaborate with Data and Technology partners to improve data quality, streamline KPI governance, and develop reliable, curated datasets and dashboards that enable self-service analytics across teams.
  • Move fast, measure impact, and evolve - Discover opportunities in the data, test hypotheses, measure results, and quickly refine strategies based on what the insights reveal.
  • Build agile forecasts and size opportunities - Develop models to measure potential impacts of strategic efforts—estimating how movement in retention, resupply, or engagement metrics could translate into revenue uplift or cost efficiency.
  • Drive accountability through always-on measurement - Create visibility with regular tracking and interpretation of performance trends. Go beyond reporting, explaining why metrics shift and what actions should follow.
  • Champion thought leadership - Represent Retain & Expand analytics in leadership forums, act as a strategic partner in business planning, and guide discussions on how to measure success across Resmed’s evolving user base.

raw.title: Director, Clinical Operations
raw.excerpt: About LifeforceWe are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health.
raw.description:
About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

    Lifeforce is hiring a Director, Clinical Operations to run the operating engine behind our national proactive care delivery model. You'll own how clinicians get licensed, credentialed, onboarded, scheduled, supported, and reviewed for quality, and you'll make sure all of it holds up as we grow.

    And we're growing fast. Our network of 50+ physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants is expected to more than triple over the next 15 months, across a growing number of states. At the same time, we're opening physical longevity centers and the clinicians supporting those centers run through this role too. The systems that work for a network of 50 won't work at 200, and this role is the one that gets us there ahead of demand rather than behind it.

    This is primarily an operations leadership role, not a clinical one. Clinical standards and clinical judgment stay with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. You'll own the people, processes, systems, and data that let clinicians do their best work at scale. You'll report to the COO and lead four teams: Clinical Operations, Clinical Onboarding & Enablement, Credentialing & Licensing, and Clinical Quality Assurance. You'll start with a small team and build it out to about 15 people by the end of 2027.

Key Responsibilities

    Capacity & Scheduling

  • Own clinician capacity planning against member demand, state by state. Know where we'll be short a quarter before it happens.

  • Own clinician scheduling, including how appointments are assigned across telehealth, nurse services, and our centers, and how continuity of care is protected as the network grows. Work with Product and Engineering to build the tools for scheduling that the teams need.

  • Track utilization, panel concentration, and access (time to next appointment), and act when they drift.

    • Hire to Productive

  • Own the full clinician pipeline after the offer: licensure, credentialing, onboarding, training, and ramp to full schedule.

  • Set and hit targets for time to credentialed and time- to-productive, and fix the bottlenecks in between.

  • Build a licensure and DEA strategy that ensures compliance and keeps pace with growth.

    • Quality & Clinician Performance

  • Own the operations of the clinical QA program, so every clinician is reviewed on schedule and the results reach the people who need them. The Clinical QA Lead reports to you, with a dotted line to the Medical Director on clinical standards.

  • Build the operating process for clinician performance management with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. They own the clinical judgment; you own the cadence, data, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Make sure the review approach and the follow-up fit our independent contractor model.

    • SOPs, Systems & Change Management

  • Own the clinical SOP lifecycle: intake, drafting with clinical owners, approval, rollout, and retirement, with Guru as the system of record.

  • Run changes so clinicians hear about them once, clearly, and know what they need to do differently.

  • Own the clinical operations tool stack (Healthie, Rippit, Guru, and our scheduling and credentialing tools) and the vendors behind it.

    • Metrics & Reporting

  • Build and optimize the clinician and clinical operations scorecards: capacity, utilization, time-to-productive, credentialing status, quality, satisfaction, adherence, and clinician and member retention.

  • Partner with Data & Analytics to automate it, and use it to run the business and report up to the COO and executive team as well as across the clinical and clin ops orgs.

    • Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Hire, develop, and lead the managers and leads across your four teams, and set structure and spans as the teams grow.

  • Support the clinicians serving our franchise centers, and partner with the Director, Clinical Franchise Operations so telehealth and center operations share standards and systems.

  • Work closely with the Medical Director and Deputy Medical Directors, Recruiting, CX, Pharmacy Operations, and Product.

  • Own the clinical operations budget and headcount plan.

What Success Looks Like

    In your first 90 days: map how clinician ops actually runs today and set a baseline on the core metrics. Get the new Onboarding & Enablement Manager and Clinical QA Lead fully ramped. Publish a capacity plan by state through the end of 2027, and get clear visibility into where every clinician in the pipeline stands.

    In your first year: clinician capacity stays ahead of member demand in every state we serve. New clinicians move from offer to full schedule on a predictable, measured timeline. Every clinician is reviewed on schedule, SOPs are current and in one place, and the scorecard runs without manual pulls. Your four teams are built out with strong leaders, and the operation is ready for the next stage of growth.

Qualifications

    Required

  • 8+ years in healthcare operations, including 3+ years leading managers.

  • Experience in direct-to-consumer telehealth, or in longevity, concierge, or preventive medicine.

  • Has scaled a clinician network through fast growth at a telehealth company, a multi-site provider group, or a similar organization.

  • Hands-on experience with clinician capacity planning, scheduling, or workforce management.

  • Working knowledge of multi-state licensure and credentialing, and how they gate clinician supply.

  • Has built and run onboarding, QA, or SOP programs that held up as volume grew.

  • Comfortable with data: defines metrics, builds reporting with analytics partners, and uses it to make decisions.

  • Has earned credibility with physicians and advanced practice clinicians as a non-clinical leader, and knows where operations ends and clinical judgment begins.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

    • Preferred

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience

  • Experience in both strategy or consulting and hands-on operational roles

  • Experience with multi-site or franchise healthcare operations.

  • Experience running an independent contractor (1099) clinician model.

  • Experience with Healthie, Rippit (formerly MaestroQA), Guru, or similar tools.

  • Has introduced automation or AI tools into clinical operations workflows.

Traits for Success

  • Builds the system before it breaks, not after.

  • Comfortable holding clinicians and clinical leaders to operating standards without being a clinician.

  • Moves between strategy and the details of a broken workflow in the same day.

  • Pairs every problem with a recommendation.

  • Keeps the member and the clinician experience in view when making operating decisions.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment

  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment

  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

Manage accounts receivable for managed hotel properties, including guest and direct-bill ledgers, aging and collections, travel-agent commission activity, payment discrepancies and reconciliation between property management and payment systems.

Job Details

  • Work Setup: Work from home
  • Shift/Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila Time)
  • Holidays: U.S. corporate holiday calendar

Responsibilities

  • Review hotel guest ledgers, accounts receivable ledgers and direct-bill balances to identify unresolved items and collection risks.
  • Monitor receivable aging, follow up on outstanding balances and resolve account allocation and payment discrepancies, as well as apply payments received in the PMS against the proper folios.

  • Ability to investigate ledgers, payment applications and aging, explain discrepancies, and communicate with operating teams.
  • Solid Excel capability and experience with an ERP, AR or property accounting platform.
  • Strong organization, sound judgment and attention to confidential financial information.

Nice to Have

  • Hospitality or managed-property AR experience.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to be the founding member of Burq's Platform team — the function that owns our engineering foundations: infrastructure, security, CI/CD, and reliability.

Right now, our infrastructure runs on AWS with a combination of ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and Step Functions. We have a strong contractor advising us, but we need a full-time engineer who can own this domain, execute on a significant infrastructure roadmap, and make every product team faster as a result.

This is a high-leverage, high-ownership role. You will be designing and building the platform that Burq scales on for the next several years.

Infrastructure

  • Own and execute the AWS account split — separating production, staging, and development into clean isolated environments
  • Lead the Aurora DB production migration with support from our infrastructure advisor
  • Manage and evolve our ECS Fargate services, RDS clusters, ElastiCache, SQS queues, and ALB configuration
  • Own Terraform — infrastructure as code, not click-ops

Security & Access

  • Harden IAM — developer permission sets, production access controls, least-privilege enforcement
  • Audit and lock down public S3 buckets
  • Enable AWS Config and Security Hub across all accounts
  • Own SOC 2 Type 2 readiness maintenance in partnership with Sprinto
  • Coordinate external penetration test cadence

CI/CD & Developer Experience

  • Own and improve our GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines — build times, test reliability, deployment velocity
  • Build out PR stack environments so product teams can test independently
  • Drive the local development stack initiative — Docker Compose-based environments that replace shared preprod
  • Integrate AI-assisted testing into the CI pipeline

Observability & Reliability

  • Own CloudWatch dashboards spanning ALB, ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and target group health
  • Lead post-incident reviews and ensure every incident produces a runbook entry
  • Partner with product teams to distribute platform work as a standing sprint allocation — not a separate queue

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years focused on infrastructure and platform engineering
  • Deep AWS expertise — ECS, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, Lambda, account architecture
  • Terraform proficiency — you write infrastructure as code and know why it matters
  • Strong CI/CD background — GitHub Actions, deployment pipelines, environment management
  • Security-minded — you know how to harden systems without creating friction for product engineers
  • Experience with observability tooling — CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Investing in you 🙏

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical coverage
  • Access to educational resources and courses

raw.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
