raw.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager to produce the real-world experiences where traders, creators, partners, and builders meet MetaMask. You’ll lead production, help shape event strategy, and sharpen the creative execution.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the Experiential & Global Events team within MetaMask’s Creative Studio and report to the Director of Experiential Marketing. We concept, design, and produce the ways people meet MetaMask in real life across global conferences, community events, VIP experiences, co-branded activations, and more. Our calendar runs across the world with priorities across APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.

You’ll lead production, taking each event from brief to on-site to recap. You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. Your focus will be experiences for our most active users and co-branded work with brands and creators, alongside community events for the builders who create on MetaMask.

Our formats are expanding to include live trading competitions, viewing events, product launches, and private experiences for VIP traders and creator partners.

How You’ll Do It

  • Produce events and experiences end to end: venues, run of show, fabrication, AV, F&B, and staffing, working alongside our production agency partners.
  • Own timelines, workback plans, and budgets for multiple events running in parallel across regions.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage agencies, venues, and vendors in APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.
  • Run registration and guest management, from guest lists and approvals to VIP access and arrival.
  • Build programming for events and panels, including formats, session flow, and speaker coordination.
  • Keep the operational side tight: source-of-truth docs, trackers, internal team staffing, and on-the-ground comms during conference weeks. Build playbooks that make each event easier to run than the last, using AI tools to move faster.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across product, marketing, business development and more to turn briefs into event plans with clear audiences, objectives, and success metrics tied to product and business goals.
  • Help develop and refine concepts with the creative team. Bring a point of view on formats, venues, and cultural trends, and work with designers and copywriters on decks and creative deliverables.
  • Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.
  • Track post-event results, including attendance, registration data, and social reach and sentiment, and write recaps that show what worked and what to change.
  • Over time, help source and manage co-hosts and sponsors for our owned franchises.

We’re looking for someone with

  • 5+ years in event production, experiential marketing, or brand activations, ideally in fintech, crypto, consumer tech, esports, or entertainment.
  • Experience producing large-format or competitive live events, such as tournaments, launches, or live viewing events.
  • A track record of delivering multi-city or international events on time and on budget.
  • Experience managing agencies and vendors and negotiating contracts under tight deadlines.
  • Experience producing premium or invite-only experiences for high-value guests.
  • Strong initiative. You spot what needs to happen and do it before anyone asks, and you stay steady when the plan changes.
  • Strategic and creative judgment. You connect an event to a product or business goal, and you bring ideas that sharpen a concept.
  • A systems mindset. You turn one-off events into repeatable processes.
  • Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership. Partners, vendors, and colleagues want to work with you again.
  • Based in the US or EU, and willing to travel internationally up to 20% of the year, typically 1 to 2 weeks per quarter across several markets.
  • Curiosity about money, markets, and how people trade, save, and spend. Finance experience isn’t required, but interest is.

It’s a bonus to have

  • Experience in crypto, whether producing events for digital asset audiences or at global conferences such as Token2049, Korea Blockchain Week, EthCC, or Devcon.
  • Experience sourcing or managing event co-hosts and sponsors.
  • Relationships with brands, creators, or communities that could become MetaMask partners.
  • An existing network of production vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, and Luma.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. raw.description:
JOIN THE COME AND SEE TEAM

Controller

Colorado Springs, CO or Remote (U.S.) • Full-time • Finance

The greatest story ever told deserves financial stewardship worthy of it, and the people who steward it well deserve to be trusted with real ownership. If you find genuine satisfaction in a clean close, airtight controls, and numbers that tell the truth — we would love to meet you.

ABOUT US

Come and See is the faith-based nonprofit media ministry behind The Chosen. Our mission is inviting everyone to encounter Jesus through exceptional storytelling that brings the Bible to life. From funding production of the series to translating every season into 600 languages and making it freely available around the world, our Team Members work together as collaborators in the greatest mission on earth. And we are just getting started!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Controller, you will own the accounting operation behind our mission — the close, the controls, the audit, and the financial reporting our Board, auditors, and donors rely on. You will bring the technical judgment that stands behind our financial statements, turning the generosity entrusted to us into reporting that is accurate, timely, and built to last.

As Come and See has grown, so has the complexity of how we account for it — donor-restricted giving across four Pillars, production funding, translation and localization work across many languages and currencies, and a growing, distributed team. You will bring order and rigor to that complexity, freeing our CFO to focus on strategy and Board-level leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be close enough to the ledger to know when something is off, and senior enough to fix the process that caused it. When our CFO is away, you will hold the finance function.

We are also looking for someone as comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools to streamline financial operations as they are with traditional close processes and GAAP compliance — using AI copilots for reconciliations, variance analysis, and reporting, while maintaining the rigor and judgment only an experienced finance leader brings.

You will report to the Chief Financial Officer.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering reviewed financial statements under U.S. GAAP for not-for-profits (ASC 958) on an agreed timeline, with variance explanations.
  • Steward the ledger. Own the general ledger, chart of accounts, net asset classification, and functional expense allocation methodology.
  • Lead reporting and budgeting. Produce reporting packages for the CFO, executive team, and Board Finance/Audit Committee; lead the annual budget process and budget-to-actual reporting.
  • Own technical accounting. Handle contributions, grants, royalties, and rebates, including conditional vs. unconditional determinations; research complex or novel transactions and bring well-supported recommendations.
  • Keep donor and financial data in sync. Maintain the reconciliation between our donor CRM and the general ledger, and maintain project-level accounting so spend can be reported against the Pillar it serves.
  • Lead the audit. Serve as primary auditor contact for our annual external audit; evaluate and respond to proposed adjustments.
  • Design our controls. Build and enforce internal controls over financial reporting, including segregation of duties, banking access, payment approvals, and fraud prevention.
  • Own compliance. Maintain charitable solicitation, state tax, and multi-state registrations; monitor unrelated business income.
  • Authorize payroll. Serve as the final authorization point for each payroll cycle — reviewing the register prepared by People & Culture, resolving exceptions, and releasing payroll. You will authorize, not prepare.
  • Oversee AP and contractors. Own accounts payable, expense reimbursement, corporate cards, the vendor master file, and contractor payments, including 1099 reporting.
  • Lead and develop the team. Coach the accounting team, build cross-training, and serve as the CFO's primary back-up during absences.
  • Modernize how we work. Own our financial systems environment and lead automation — including AI-enabled tools — that reduces manual reconciliation and control risk.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting and an active CPA license.
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 5 years in a not-for-profit organization.
  • Experience leading and developing accounting staff.
  • Working depth in not-for-profit GAAP (ASC 958): net assets, functional expense allocation, and contribution revenue.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full-cycle monthly close and an annual external audit.
  • Experience designing internal controls in a lean organization, where segregation of duties must be engineered thoughtfully.
  • Multi-state payroll tax and contractor/1099 knowledge; fluency in a mid-market ERP and advanced Excel.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate financial analysis, draft reports, or automate repetitive accounting tasks, with sound judgment about where human review and controls remain essential.
  • A clear communicator with non-financial leaders, comfortable working in a remote, distributed team.
  • A personal faith in Jesus and alignment with our mission, values, and Statement of Faith.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or content production/distribution.
  • Prior Controller or Assistant Controller experience in a donor-funded organization.
  • Multi-currency and international payments experience.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled finance tools (automated reconciliation, AI-assisted forecasting, intelligent document processing).

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

  • Meaningful work. Your work directly protects and strengthens the financial foundation behind The Chosen's reach around the world.
  • Real trust. You won't just maintain the books — you'll shape the controls, systems, and processes that carry this mission forward.
  • Room to grow. Come and See is growing, and the complexity and scope of this role will grow with it.
  • Remote flexibility. Work from Colorado Springs or remotely from anywhere in the U.S., with occasional in-person gatherings.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary Range , $128,000 to $168,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications

FLSA Classification , Exempt

Benefits , Medical, dental, vision, retirement plan and match, HRA, Short and Long-term Disability, Group Life and Voluntary Life Insurance, generous and flexible holidays, and more.

OUR BELIEFS, CULTURE, AND COMMITMENT

At Come and See, every team member plays a vital role in a mission bigger than any one of us. We look for passion for the mission and a genuine capacity to represent our culture and Christian beliefs throughout the selection process for every role. Wherever we serve, we aim to uphold and reflect Jesus in how we live and work together.

While we unite around our mission, we know unity doesn't mean uniformity. Our calling is too great, and our mission is too important not to be intentional about strengthening our team with people from all backgrounds. We believe that varied perspectives — across race, ethnicity, life experience, age, and gender — enrich our ability to share the story of Jesus with the world and help everyone, everywhere, experience the authentic Jesus.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a cover letter telling us why this role and our mission resonate with you. Application deadline: October 31, 2026.

OUR COMMITTMENT

Come and See is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. As a religious organization, Come and See lawfully exercises its right under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and applicable state law to employ individuals who share its religious beliefs.

Come and See is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. If you need an accommodation during the application process, please contact

Salary: $128k - $164k annually

🧑‍💻 About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Strategy & Enablement Lead who can take what great selling looks like here, sharpen it, scale it, and keep evolving it as we grow. This is a role for someone who understands people deeply. You know how to build trust fast, uncover what actually matters, make a value proposition click, handle objections before they become roadblocks, and tell a story that people remember.

But you’re not just a great seller.

You know how to turn instinct into something teachable.

You can listen to a call and immediately hear what landed, what didn’t, and what should change. You can rewrite the deck, sharpen the talk track, rethink the follow-up, coach the AE, and then look at the data to see whether it worked.
You won’t carry an individual quota. Your impact will show up in the performance of the entire Partnerships team.

Reporting to the VP, Revenue, you’ll own how we approach, pitch, nurture, win, grow, and win back Creator relationships. Your closest business partner will be our Sales Manager, who owns day-to-day team leadership and performance. You’ll also work closely with RevOps, Marketing, Data, and teams across Makeship.

This is not a role where you sit on the sidelines and hand people frameworks.

You’ll be in sales calls. You’ll talk to Creators. You’ll coach AEs. You’ll challenge assumptions. You’ll test ideas. You’ll throw out what isn’t working. And when something starts working really well, you’ll figure out how to make the whole team better at it.

Makeship already has six years of learning, strong growth, and a lot that works. Your job is to understand why it works, make it better, and evolve it as we launch new products, enter new Creator verticals, and keep raising the bar.

We’re looking for a salesperson first.

Someone with exceptional EQ, strong instincts, competitive energy, and a genuine understanding of how language, trust, relationships, and timing influence a sale.

You may be a top-performing AE, a sales strategy or enablement lead, or the person other sellers naturally come to when they need help closing something difficult. You may have built playbooks, mentored teammates, or moved into sales leadership.

Your title matters less to us than the pattern.

You’ve sold. You’ve learned what works. You’ve developed your own judgment. And at some point, you realized you were just as excited about making the team better as you were about winning the deal yourself.

Creator economy experience is a major advantage. Selling to Creators is not traditional B2B sales. Relationships are built through Instagram, Discord, YouTube, calls, DMs, and communities as often as they are through formal meetings.
You need to be comfortable in that world; or, come from another fast-moving, relationship-led environment where you’ve learned how to sell without hiding behind a rigid corporate playbook.

We move quickly. We’re competitive. We’re curious. We challenge each other, laugh a lot, and care deeply about doing great work. You should be confident enough to work independently, humble enough to change your mind, and comfortable jumping from a strategic conversation straight into the weeds.

🚀 Your Key Responsibilities

Sales Storytelling & Methodology:

Own and continuously evolve how Makeship sells.

  • Turn Makeship’s value proposition, results, capabilities, and differentiators into a clear, memorable sales story.
  • Personally develop and improve sales decks, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, pitch approaches, objection handling, nurture messaging, follow-up strategies, and playbooks.
  • Help AEs and AMs understand not just what to say, but why it works and how to adapt the story to the Creator in front of them.
  • Build a methodology flexible enough for emerging Creators, established Creators, and different Creator verticals.
  • Adapt our approach as Makeship launches new products, enters new Creator verticals, or tests new ways of working with Creators.

Coaching & Enablement:

Make the team better at selling.

  • Work directly with AEs through live coaching, call reviews, workshops, pitch development, and ongoing feedback.
  • Own our sales enablement program, including onboarding, recurring training, playbooks, workshops, and certification.
  • Partner closely with the Sales Manager so the methodology becomes part of ongoing team coaching.
    Identify what our strongest sellers are doing differently and make those behaviours repeatable across the team.

Creator Growth & Relationship Strategy:

Help us sell beyond the first drop in the Creator's best interest.

  • Build frameworks that help AMs move from “we need another launch” to thoughtful Creator growth planning.
  • Help define how teams should think about timing, product progression, Creator milestones, fan moments, tentpoles, and larger programs.
  • Develop the questions, planning tools, and storytelling that help AMs build strategic roadmaps with Creators.
  • Create win-back approaches for Creators whose relationship with Makeship has lapsed.
    Help the team understand how a great fan experience should influence what we recommend to Creators.

Competitive Strategy:

Make sure our team knows why Makeship wins.

  • Stay close to competitors, their positioning, their offers, and changes in the Creator merchandise space.
  • Turn competitive insight into better discovery, positioning, talk tracks, objection handling, and sales plays.
  • Teach AEs and AMs how to recognize competitive threats, uncover weaknesses, and position Makeship naturally and confidently.
  • Help build a team that knows how to assess the landscape in real time rather than relying on a static battlecard.

Testing, Data & Continuous Improvement:

Keep learning what works.

  • Stay close to frontline conversations and use them to form hypotheses about what could make us better.
  • Use funnel and performance data to understand what’s improving, where momentum is breaking down, and what to test next.
  • Track signals including win rate, conversion, sales-cycle length, speed to first launch, repeat launches, expansion, and other measures of sales effectiveness.
  • Work with RevOps and Data to define the reporting and insights you need.
  • Test changes in messaging, follow-up, sequencing, pitch structure, and methodology, then keep what works and change what doesn’t.

Revenue Operations & Marketing Partnership:

Know what great selling needs, then help the right teams build it.

  • Partner with RevOps on the sequences, workflows, CRM support, alerts, and tools that reinforce the sales methodology.
  • Be comfortable working in HubSpot and hands-on enough to build or test simpler solutions yourself when it makes sense.
  • Bring forward new sales technology when you believe it can make the team more effective.
  • Partner with Marketing so Creator-facing content reinforces the same story our team is telling in the field.
  • Identify the content and assets the sales team needs — from proof points and case studies to videos and Creator education — and work with Marketing to bring them to life.
  • Bring frontline Creator insights back into the business so our broader messaging keeps getting stronger.

🧠 What You Bring

  • 7+ years of sales experience, including significant time in a quota-carrying role, with strong live selling instincts and a track record of building trust fast, uncovering motivation, and adapting quickly.
  • Evidence that you've made other sellers better through mentoring, coaching, sales leadership, or enablement.
  • The ability to turn a complex value proposition into a simple, memorable story, and to build the practical tools that help others tell it, such as talk tracks, pitch decks, discovery frameworks, objection handling, and follow-up strategies.
  • Experience in a startup, scale-up, or emerging category where the playbook was still being written, and a natural instinct to turn ambiguity into something clearer and more useful.
  • Strong competitive instincts and curiosity about why buyers choose one option over another.
  • Comfort interpreting sales funnel data and working in CRM and sales technology (ideally HubSpot) to improve performance.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach and the confidence to challenge an idea when you see a better one.

👀 Bonus

  • Experience selling to Creators, influencers, talent, communities, or other non-traditional business owners.
  • Experience in the Creator economy, gaming, merchandise, crowdfunding, fandom-led commerce, or another community-driven industry.
  • Experience adapting your sales approach across audience segments and verticals, from informal, relationship-led conversations to larger strategic accounts.
  • Previous experience as a sales leader, or building and evolving a sales enablement program in a high-growth startup.
  • Confidence speaking to groups, facilitating workshops, or representing a company externally.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Work remotely anywhere in Canada and/or access any of our hubs
  • Health and dental benefits from day 1
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation (including paid time off on your birthday)
  • An additional 1 week of paid time off during the winter holidays
  • Virtual & In-Person Social Events
  • Annual Paid Volunteer Day Off
  • 1:1 RRSP Matching Program Up to 3%
  • $500 Pre-Tax Annual Health & Wellness Allowance
  • $400 Pre-Tax Home Office Setup Allowance
  • $65 Pre-Tax Monthly Phone Allowance
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up Program
  • Education Assistance Program
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Tenured Rewards Program

Salary Band: $90-100K CAD base salary per annum, plus a variable of $30-40K CAD, for an OTE of $120-140K CAD. Individual compensation will depend on unique skills, experience, and qualifications.

raw.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Bybit EU is looking for the Head for Commercial / Business Developmentto lead our European commercial strategy, market expansion and revenue growth across regulated digital asset and financial services.
Reporting directly to the EU Group CEO, you will lead the European commercial organisation, including Country Managers and their respective in-country Business Development, KOL, VIP Relationship Management and Community teams. You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance and global Commercial teams to drive growth across European markets.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Growth

  • Define and execute the European commercial strategy aligned with business objectives, market opportunities and regulatory requirements.
  • Own commercial targets, revenue growth, trading volumes, customer acquisition and market expansion.
  • Identify strategic growth opportunities across retail, active trader, VIP and institutional customer segments.
  • Drive commercial performance through market-specific strategies, resource allocation and measurable KPIs.

Country Management & Market Expansion

  • Lead the European Country Management function, ensuring effective execution of commercial strategies across priority markets.
  • Define country-specific business plans, growth targets and market development priorities.
  • Oversee in-country commercial activities, including business development, partnerships, KOL engagement, VIP relationships and community management.
  • Monitor country performance, competitive positioning and market opportunities to optimise commercial results.

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Drive business development initiatives to expand Bybit EU's customer base, trading activity and market presence.
  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships with relevant fintech, crypto, trading and financial services ecosystems.
  • Identify new distribution opportunities, customer segments and revenue streams.
  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to develop market-relevant propositions and commercial campaigns.

KOL, Affiliate & Community Development

  • Lead European KOL, affiliate and community engagement strategies in collaboration with Marketing.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key influencers, trading communities and ecosystem partners.
  • Drive customer acquisition, engagement and trading activity through effective partner and community programmes.
  • Establish commercial performance targets, partnership frameworks and ROI measurement.

VIP & Key Account Management

  • Lead VIP Relationship Management across European markets, focusing on high-value traders and strategic customers.
  • Develop customer acquisition, retention and relationship strategies for VIP, professional and institutional segments.
  • Drive trading activity, customer loyalty and revenue growth through personalised relationship management.
  • Partner with Product, Trading and Customer Services to deliver competitive propositions and exceptional client experiences.

Commercial Performance & Governance

  • Own commercial budgets, sales forecasts, revenue reporting and performance management across European markets.
  • Establish KPIs covering customer acquisition, activation, trading volumes, retention, revenue and commercial efficiency.
  • Ensure commercial activities, partnerships and customer engagement comply with applicable European regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk and Legal to maintain appropriate governance over commercial activities and customer relationships.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Build and lead a high-performing European commercial organisation, including Country Managers, Business Development, KOL, VIP Relationship Management and Community teams.
  • Set clear objectives, performance targets and accountability across country and commercial functions.
  • Act as a key member of the European executive leadership team, contributing to business strategy and sustainable growth.
  • Collaborate with global and local stakeholders to align commercial initiatives with European market needs and regulatory requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in commercial leadership, business development, sales or market expansion, including significant executive experience in crypto, fintech, trading, brokerage or financial services.
  • Proven experience leading multi-country commercial organisations and delivering sustainable revenue growth across European markets.
  • Strong understanding of crypto trading, digital assets, derivatives and financial services customer segments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Country Managers, business development teams and international commercial operations.
  • Strong experience developing KOL, affiliate, community and strategic partnership networks within the crypto or trading ecosystem.
  • Proven track record in VIP relationship management, key account development and high-value customer acquisition and retention.
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset with experience managing revenue, trading volumes, customer acquisition, retention and profitability metrics.
  • Experience developing market entry strategies, commercial partnerships and country-specific growth plans.
  • Strong understanding of European markets, regulatory requirements and customer engagement within regulated financial services environments.
  • Proven ability to build high-performing international teams and manage complex stakeholder relationships.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, negotiation, leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Management or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Company Overview

Milo’s Tea Company is one of the fastest-growing beverage companies in the United States. Our culture and operations are built on the belief that we can make a difference in the world. That is why we put People First and strive to continually reduce our environmental impact on the planet. We leverage our world-class operations and decades-long distribution partnerships to grow the footprint of our core products and create new, innovative beverage products.

  • We are the #1 and fastest-growing brand in the Refrigerated Tea Category in the nation.
  • Our core mission: People and Planet First — doing good is good for business.
  • We are committed to unlocking the personal genius of every associate and have a strong focus on growth and learning.
  • Our company is women-led and strongly committed to Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging.
  • We pledge 1% of profits annually to charitable giving.
  • We are Platinum Certified in Zero Waste Manufacturing: recycling, reducing, and reusing 95% of waste at all facilities.

Why You Will Love Life at Milo's

You will collaborate with a group of passionate and high-performing people, where everyone feels empowered to do their best work and feels good about the work they are doing.


As a People First company, Milo’s is committed to the success and well-being of our associates, customers, and fans, no matter their gender, race, or creed. Some of the remarkable benefits offered include:


  • Competitive salary

Being a Culture Champion at Milo’s

  • Work effectively with others
  • Help our TEAm achieve safety, quality, and production goals
  • Interact positively, be self-aware, avoid negative commentary

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

As a People First company, Milo’s is committed to uplifting our associates, customers, and fans no matter their gender, race, or creed. We invest in Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging in all areas of our business ecosystem. We champion these efforts through partnerships, education, and events to support and celebrate our diverse workforce and networks.


If you require assistance or accommodation to participate in the job application process, please contact .

The B2B & EDI Implementation Lead oversees the technical and operational onboarding of business customers, leading trading partner integrations from requirements gathering through go-live. This role serves as the primary liaison between technical teams, trading partners, and internal stakeholders, coordinating testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure seamless electronic data exchange.


Responsibilities:

  • Defines and leads the EDI and B2B integration roadmap, aligning trading partner capabilities with Milo’s growth, channel expansion, and supply chain strategy.
  • Leads the full lifecycle of EDI and B2B trading partner onboardings, from requirements gathering and mapping through testing, certification, and go-live.
  • Develops and maintains detailed project plans, tracking milestones, deliverables, and partner readiness across multiple simultaneous implementations.
  • Establishes standards, governance, and best practices for partner onboarding, mapping, testing, and certification across the organization.
  • Coordinates and manages third party relationships
  • Serves as the primary liaison between trading partners and internal Milo's teams, including IT, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success, throughout the implementation process as the cross-functional implementation leader.
  • Translates business requirements into functional EDI maps and works with integration developers to implement them.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert and escalation point for production EDI issues affecting trading partners.
  • Maintains accurate records of partner profiles, mapping specifications, communication configurations, and testing results.
  • Identifies and drives improvements to onboarding processes, templates, and tooling to reduce implementation cycle times and error rates.
  • Develops reporting and monitors variances in both incoming and outgoing transactional data.
  • Develops and maintains internal knowledge base documentation for user training, product deployment activities, and partner-facing guides.
  • Uphold and lead participation in Corporate Responsibility initiatives, including Zero Waste and sustainability, social advocacy, and MMAD volunteering opportunities.
  • This position has food safety responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in EDI, B2B integration, or related IT implementation roles, including 2 or more years in a lead or project-focused capacity; or 2 or more years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Proven subject matter expertise in EDI standards, trading partner onboarding, and integration tools.
  • Proven vendor management experience and project management experience preferred.

  • Strong industry knowledge of ERP systems, with Sage X3 experience preferred.
  • Experience in informal or project-based people leadership strongly preferred.
  • Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, TrueCommerce, or SPS Commerce preferred.

Supervisory: This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Physical Demands: This job is sedentary. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with different abilities.

FLSA Status: Exempt

Game Engineer (remote, contract-to-hire, Latin America)

Location: Latin America preferred (remote)

Reports to: Director of Technical Production

Engagement type: Full-time contract (40 hours/week), 5–6 months, with the intent to convert to a long-term role

Language requirement: Professional or fluent in English; Spanish preferred

About Endless Access

Our vision is simple: the whole world, empowered.

Endless Access works to close the global digital divide by helping young people in underserved communities become creators of technology, not only consumers of it. Our learning programs teach a new generation to design and build their own games and digital projects using free, open-source tools, delivered through mentors, instructors, and partners around the world.

These learning programs center around our flagship game, Threadbare. Students develop their skills and ambitions as they transition from playing the game to helping build it. Threadbare is developed in the open, by our Games team and a growing community of contributors. As our programs reach more learners in more regions, we are growing the team that keeps the game stable, fun, and welcoming to the people learning to build it.

About the Role

Endless Access is seeking a mid-level Game Engineer, based in Latin America, to join our Games team and help build Threadbare, an open-source, community-built narrative adventure game made with the Godot engine. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will ship features, fix issues, and help keep the game stable, performant, and fun to play.

You will work closely with our senior game engineer as well as our creative director, producer, and contributor community. Most of your time will go to game development on the Threadbare roadmap. A smaller part of the role connects you with our learning programs, where you will guide learners who are building the game alongside us.

This is a 5–6 month contract, and we are hiring with the clear intent of finding someone we would want on the team long term.

If you enjoy working in an existing codebase, care about how changes feel to players, and like helping newer developers grow, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Game Development (60%)

  • Build and ship gameplay features, UI, and systems, from design spec to release.
  • Fix bugs and improve performance, stability, and load times.
  • Work with design and art to turn ideas into playable builds, and give feedback on feasibility and scope.
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and take part in code reviews with the team.
  • Estimate your work, flag risks early, and keep the team informed through planning and regular updates.
  • Contribute to the tools, pipelines, and documentation that make the team faster.

Learning and Community (40%)

  • Review code from learners in our game development programs and give clear, encouraging written feedback.
  • Collaborate with our Learning Experience team on tooling that supports our game development curriculum, as the roadmap allows.
  • Join occasional community events, such as game jams and livestreams.

Skills and Experience

Essential

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering, including hands-on work on shipped or live games.
  • Experience shipping or maintaining a released game or live product as part of a team, working alongside other engineers, designers, and artists.
  • Comfortable with Git-based workflows, code review, and working in an existing codebase.
  • Willingness to mentor early-career game developers by reviewing their code and giving written feedback.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially in a remote, asynchronous team.
  • Familiarity with open-source communities and contribution practices.
  • Able to work independently and to ask for help at the right time.
  • Professional or fluent English.

Desirable

  • Experience with the Godot engine (GDScript)
  • Accessibility or inclusive design experience in games.
  • Experience with learning or educational games.
  • Familiarity with analytics, live ops, or build and CI pipelines.
  • Spanish ability.
  • An interest in our mission to expand access to technology.

How We Work

Endless Access is a fully distributed, global nonprofit. Most of the team works remotely and asynchronously across many countries, and this role is no exception: it is fully remote and based in Latin America, collaborating daily with teammates and contributors across multiple time zones, much of it in writing, in code review, and over video. We are looking for someone who thrives in a self-directed, cross-cultural environment, and who communicates clearly and openly in writing.

Not Sure You Meet 100% of the Requirements?

Studies show that women and people from underrepresented backgrounds often hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed qualification. Building a truly inclusive digital future means bringing together diverse perspectives and experiences; if you are excited about this role and our mission to expand access to technology, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you do not check every box. Your perspective could be exactly what we need.

Endless is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who share our passion for games, education, and creating opportunities for underserved learners. Endless provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

raw.description:
About the Role

Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager on our Product Marketing team, you'll turn complex, behavioral-AI-driven security into stories buyers instantly understand and remember, and you'll make sure Abnormal is positioned clearly and distinctly to win in the market. You'll build strategic messaging, partner with Sales Enablement and Marketing across every stage of the buyer's journey, and serve as a go-to subject matter expert on the email security market for customers and analysts.

You'll be doing this during one of the more exciting stretches in the company's history: we're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more products to launch, more narrative to shape, and more impact to make than you would at a mature market leader.

You're a strategic marketer with real technical curiosity and a gift for explaining cybersecurity concepts to buyers without losing the nuance. You write compelling, external-facing content, thrive in fast-paced environments with frequent launches, and influence stakeholders at every level. You listen closely, empathize with customers, and are driven by business impact and the success of our customers and partners.

What You Will Do

  • Develop compelling, differentiated product messaging and positioning that makes Abnormal's approach impossible to confuse with anyone else's.
  • Lead internal and external product launches across sales enablement, press, digital, and other channels.
  • Partner with Marketing teams to drive demand and pipeline through acquisition and upsell messaging aligned to the buyer's journey.
  • Own end-to-end launch strategies for incremental updates and feature releases, not just the big moments.
  • Create and maintain product content, including collateral, thought leadership, solution presentations, website content, videos, and blogs.
  • Conduct customer research to understand what buyers need and let it sharpen the messaging.
  • Enable sales teams and channel partners on product value and joint solutions.
  • Represent Abnormal as a speaker in external forums.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years experience producing written content for buyers, ideally within cybersecurity, with samples available.
  • Experience managing product launches in high-velocity environments.
  • Strong technical curiosity and the ability to explain complex concepts to buyers clearly.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A strategic mindset, with the ability to execute independently and efficiently.
  • Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders across organizational levels.
  • Strong listening skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Passion for Abnormal's mission and a commitment to customer and partner success.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

$122,400—$176,000 USD

raw.description:
Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/15/26 Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a CDO-L Study Lead Engineer with a Secret security clearance to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote.

Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced CDO-L Study Lead Engineer to support the Department of the Air Force (DAF) in advancing its enterprise Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities. This position will lead a focused, technically grounded study effort under Task Order 0003, System Enhancement Studies, with a primary focus on extending secure ICAM capabilities into Contested, Degraded, and Operationally Limited (CDO-L) environments. The ideal candidate is a technically seasoned engineer and collaborative leader with deep experience in Defense ICAM architectures, Zero Trust frameworks, and disconnected/edge identity solutions who can translate complex operational requirements into actionable architectures and implementation roadmaps.

  • This study will run 120 days. All personnel assigned to CDO-L study activities must hold a final Secret security clearance.

The CDO-L Study Lead Engineer will serve as the primary technical authority for Study 1 of the DAF ICAM System Enhancement Studies effort, leading the analysis, architecture development, and documentation required to produce a decision-ready Technical Study Report within 45 calendar days of Task Order award. The Lead Engineer will coordinate closely with the Program Manager, Systems Architecture Team, Licensing/Cost Analyst, and Government stakeholders to ensure all study outputs are technically sound, operationally grounded, and fully traceable to Performance Work Statement (PWS) Section 4.1 requirements.

Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Lead the structured review of Government-provided CDO-L requirements published at the DoD Enterprise ICAM IL5 and IL6 DDIL reference site, cataloging each requirement by operational condition (denied, degraded, intermittent, and limited bandwidth) and mapping them against existing DAF ICAM solution components including Okta Universal Directory (UD), Okta Identity Provider (IdP), and SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ).
  • Conduct a gap analysis between current DAF ICAM capabilities and CDO-L operational demands to serve as the foundation for all architectural recommendations.
  • Evaluate existing approved ICAM solutions across comparable Federal Defense programs and assess their applicability to DAF CDO-L requirements, prioritizing solutions that extend existing approved capabilities rather than introducing net-new vendor stacks.
  • Lead the architectural analysis of options for on-premises replication or caching of identity and access data at disconnected nodes, evaluating a tiered edge identity broker model across three operational states: Connected, Degraded/Limited Bandwidth, and Denied.
  • Assess and document synchronization schedules, minimum connectivity requirements, degraded-mode operating parameters, and cache staleness thresholds for each operational state.
  • Evaluate specific DAF ICAM-aligned edge components including Okta Access Gateway (OAG) and Tactical Identity Bridge Appliance (TIBA) for their suitability in extending ICAM operations to the tactical edge.
  • Assess how existing SailPoint IIQ governance workflows can be mirrored at the edge to maintain entitlement integrity during disconnected operations.
  • Document tradeoffs between full replication, selective caching, and read-only policy mirroring, and provide a recommended approach with clear technical rationale grounded in DAF operational requirements.
  • Develop recommendations for emergency "break-glass" access provisioning in fully offline or denied-state conditions, including governance controls, immutable local audit logging, and automated revocation and re-synchronization workflows.
  • Evaluate approaches for PKI certificate validation in CDO-L conditions, including Certificate Revocation List (CRL) caching and local Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) stapling at edge nodes to sustain Common Access Card (CAC)-based authentication.
  • Analyze how endpoint security telemetry collected locally during a disconnected period integrates with the identity layer and how the edge identity broker can autonomously enforce access revocation when device security posture degrades.
  • Develop a formal methodology for attribute transfer and synchronization between enterprise NIPRNet and SIPRNet environments and disconnected nodes upon reconnection, addressing conflict resolution, synchronization priorities, audit log consolidation, reconciliation validation, and failure/fallback procedures.
  • Coordinate with the Licensing/Cost Analyst to produce a structured identification of all software components required for the recommended CDO-L architecture, including licensing structure, edge deployment constraints, classified-network restrictions, and interoperability considerations.
  • Coordinate with the Program Manager and Licensing/Cost Analyst to develop a detailed, phased implementation roadmap and ROM cost estimate covering development, licensing, hardware, integration, testing, and deployment.
  • Consolidate all study outputs into the CDO-L Technical Study Report (CDRL B010), ensuring each section maps directly to a PWS Section 4.1 requirement and includes a draft Performance Work Statement suitable for a subsequent implementation Task Order.
  • Verify that all assigned personnel hold the required security clearances prior to engagement and notify the Government immediately of any clearance status changes.
  • Present study findings to Government Program Manager and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) as required throughout the study period.

Education and Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field from an accredited college or university.
  • 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, enterprise architecture, or identity and access management within Defense or Federal government IT environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or analyzing identity and access management architectures in disconnected, air-gapped, or operationally constrained network environments.
  • Experience with the DoD Authority to Operate (ATO) process and security accreditation requirements for Defense information systems.
  • Active Secret security clearance (final adjudication required prior to assignment).

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Defense ICAM, enterprise identity architecture, or related cybersecurity engineering disciplines.
  • Experience supporting DISA-aligned programs or DAF/Air Force ICAM initiatives.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Deep technical knowledge of enterprise Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) platforms, with specific expertise in Okta (Universal Directory, Identity Provider, Access Gateway, Workflows) and SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ).
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles and their application to tactical edge and disconnected identity environments.
  • Experience designing identity federation, replication, and caching architectures for disconnected or intermittently connected operational environments.
  • Proficiency in PKI-based authentication concepts, including Certificate Revocation Lists (CRL), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and Common Access Card (CAC) authentication.
  • Knowledge of Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) policy frameworks and their implementation within Okta and SailPoint platforms.
  • Familiarity with NIPRNet and SIPRNet network architecture, classification requirements, and cross-domain constraints.
  • Ability to perform and document structured gap analyses, architectural tradeoff assessments, and comparative technology evaluations.
  • Experience developing phased implementation roadmaps with clearly defined entry/exit criteria, dependencies, and realistic Government review and accreditation timelines.
  • Strong technical writing skills with the ability to produce formal study reports, architectural documentation, and draft Performance Work Statements suitable for Government use.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional technical teams including architects, engineers, cost analysts, and program managers.
  • Exceptional communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the ability to present complex technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical Government stakeholders.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

Desired Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience with Okta Access Gateway (OAG) and/or Tactical Identity Bridge Appliance (TIBA) in edge deployment contexts.
  • Familiarity with DoD Enterprise ICAM IL5/IL6 DDIL requirements and related DoD ICAM policy frameworks.
  • Knowledge of emergency "break-glass" access provisioning governance and associated audit/logging requirements in classified environments.
  • Experience integrating endpoint security telemetry with identity and access management platforms for continuous posture-based access enforcement.
  • Familiarity with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems and audit log consolidation in Defense environments.
  • Knowledge of Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and their application to identity platform components.
  • Experience developing Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) cost estimates for complex, multi-phase Defense IT implementation programs.
  • Okta Certified Professional, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, or equivalent identity platform certification.
  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience supporting DAF, Air Force, or Space Force IT modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and their application within hybrid Agile/Waterfall Government program environments.

raw.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Belgium Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

We are seeking an accomplished Java Full Stack Developer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems that operate at significant scale and across multiple business domains. At Arrived, our mission is to bring real estate investing online.

Overview of the Work / What You Will Do:

As the Head of Investments, you will co-lead investment strategy and execution within Arrived. You’ll manage and grow our portfolio ($400M+ AUM in equity and credit products across 65,000+ investors) and our Investments team (investment leaders, sourcing, acquisition, asset management, and due diligence). You’ll design innovative new investment products alongside our Product and Finance teams. Your leadership can directly influence how millions of people invest in real estate through Arrived.

How You Will Contribute:

Set and Scale the Investment Strategy

  • Manage and optimize our investment strategy and portfolios across real estate equity, credit, and hybrid products.
  • Develop and maintain investment theses, portfolio construction frameworks, risk frameworks, and underwriting standards to achieve desired return targets.
  • Create new, innovative, and alpha-generating products for Arrived’s investors. Continuously evaluate markets, asset types, and capital structures to position Arrived investment offerings for long-term performance.

Lead Sourcing & Underwriting

Build and Manage Diversified Portfolios

  • Lead the process for performance monitoring, asset optimization, value creation, refinancing, and dispositions.

Grow and Develop the Investments Team

  • Recruit, mentor, and scale a high-performing team spanning acquisitions, underwriting, research, and asset management.
  • Implement best practices, systems, and tools that enable efficiency and accuracy at scale.

Stakeholder in Product Innovation

  • Partner with Product, Finance, Legal, and Engineering to launch new investment products across equity and credit.
  • Identify new geographies, partnerships, and asset classes that expand access for investors.

Ensure Operational & Regulatory Excellence

  • Maintain robust asset management models, performance tracking, and continuous improvement processes.

Represent Arrived Externally

  • Serve as an external thought leader for Arrived’s investment platform.
  • Contribute market insights and educational content that strengthen investor understanding and confidence.

Compensation

This role has a salary + bonus structure of $250 - $300K OTE. In addition. all team members receive an initial equity grant in the form of stock options commensurate with their role for a total of $450-500K Total Comp.

What We're Looking For

We’re searching for a leader who combines institutional investment expertise with a builder mentality—someone who brings rigor to the investment process while thriving in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

  • 15+ years of real estate investment experience, with exposure to both equity and credit strategies.

  • Strong leadership experience building and scaling high-performing investment teams.
  • Exceptional communication skills—capable of distilling complex financial concepts for investors and internal teams.
  • A bias for action, comfort operating with ambiguity, and excitement for building something new.

raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

raw.description:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.
Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

As the Director of Learning & Development on Ro's Care Delivery team, you will own the learning strategy and programs supporting hundreds of clinical and non-clinical patient-facing team members. You will ensure our teams have the knowledge, skills, and resources to deliver high-quality patient care at scale, from onboarding and new program launches to ongoing development, performance improvement, and retraining.

You will build the systems, processes, and infrastructure that enable Learning & Development to operate effectively as our business evolves. This includes establishing how we identify and prioritize learning needs, develop and maintain content, scale learning across teams, and measure whether learning translates into the expected behaviors and performance outcomes. You will also own the evaluation and adoption of learning technologies and tools, ensuring the team is equipped to operate efficiently and stays at the forefront of adult learning practices, emerging technologies, and innovative approaches to learning. You will partner closely with Clinical, Operations, Quality & Safety, Product, and other cross-functional leaders to ensure learning investments address the right problems and drive measurable impact.

You are a strategic and operational leader who knows how to build a scalable learning function in a fast-moving, complex environment. You bring strong judgment about when training is the right solution, a data-driven approach to improving frontline performance, and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team. You are a complexity buster - able to distill the most complex clinical or technical concepts to acceptable learning content. You are equally comfortable setting long-term direction, establishing practical systems and processes, and driving execution through your team and cross-functional partners.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the learning strategy

  • Own the end-to-end learning strategy for hundreds of clinical and non-clinical patient-facing team members, spanning onboarding, new programs and launches, ongoing learning, and performance-based retraining.

  • Establish priorities and learning approaches that support business objectives, operational readiness, and high-quality patient care.

  • Build scalable learning systems and processes

  • Establish how learning needs are identified, evaluated, prioritized, and addressed. Create efficient processes for intake, content development, cross-team reuse, maintenance, and governance.

  • Determine when formal training is needed versus more targeted interventions, and select the tools and technologies required to deliver learning effectively at scale.

  • Measure learning effectiveness and drive performance improvement

  • Establish how we assess knowledge acquisition, skill proficiency, and on-the-job application. Partner with Quality, Operations, and frontline leaders to use performance data and frontline feedback to identify capability gaps, diagnose root causes, and implement targeted learning interventions.

  • Build feedback loops that continuously improve learning programs and frontline performance.

  • Build and lead a Learning Center of Excellence

  • Build and develop a high-performing team spanning training and knowledge management. Establish clear roles, accountability, and ways of working across the Learning CoE, frontline teams, and subject matter experts

  • Partner with Product, Quality, and Data partners to use Learning as a way to achieve quality, safety, and patient experience goals

  • Create a consistent, scalable approach to delivering accurate, relevant, and effective learning and knowledge resources across Care Delivery

  • Ensure the team stays at the forefront of adult learning technology and best practices and continuously evolves how learning is designed, delivered, and measured.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, training, or enablement, including experience leading learning programs and teams at scale; experience in healthcare, clinical operations, or another complex, regulated environment preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute a learning strategy that supports multiple functions, audiences, and business priorities.
  • Experience building or scaling a centralized learning function, including establishing operating models, intake and prioritization processes, content governance, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning, instructional design, learning needs analysis, assessment, and performance consulting, with the judgment to distinguish training needs from process, tooling, knowledge management, or other operational gaps.
  • Demonstrated ability to measure learning effectiveness and connect learning outcomes to observable behaviors, quality measures, and operational performance.
  • Experience evaluating, implementing, and optimizing learning technologies, including learning management systems, content development tools, knowledge management platforms, and learning analytics.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including building teams, developing talent, setting clear expectations, and driving accountability.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and partner effectively with clinical, operational, technical, and quality teams.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution, navigate ambiguity, and make sound prioritization decisions in a fast-paced environment.

We’ve Got You Covered:

  • Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth reimbursements

  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits

  • Pet insurance

  • Student loan refinancing

  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

The target base salary for this position ranges from $161,100-$202,000, in addition to a competitive equity and benefits package (as applicable). When determining compensation, we carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.
Ro recognizes the power of in-person collaboration, while supporting the flexibility to work anywhere in the United States. For our Ro’ers in the tri-state (NY) area, you will join us at HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays. For those outside of the tri-state area, you will be able to join in-person collaborations throughout the year (i.e., during team on-sites).
At Ro, we believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths — and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, training and promotion, termination, and any other terms and conditions of employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, familial status, age, disability and/or any other legally protected classification protected by federal, state, or local law.
Ro is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our application and interview process. If you require a reasonable accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact us at .

raw.description:
Es un ingeniero de requisitos de sistemas a nivel intermedio, especializado en el subsistema de Infotainment. Actúa como el enlace crucial entre los Ingenieros de Diseño y Liberación (DREs) y los Arquitectos de Sistemas. Su función principal es traducir las necesidades técnicas y regulatorias en requisitos claros, específicos y gestionables para el diseño, desarrollo, validación y liberación de los componentes eléctricos y electrónicos del vehículo.

Utilizando metodologías de ingeniería de requisitos (Requirement Engineering) para elicitar, analizar, documentar y mantener los requisitos del sistema. Se apoya en herramientas especializadas como IBM DOORS para la gestión de requisitos, IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) para el control de flujos de trabajo, y JIRA para el seguimiento de incidencias. Colabora en el diseño y desarrollo, participa en el ciclo de vida de liberación de software (SDLC) y aplica análisis como DFMEA para asegurar la calidad y fiabilidad del sistema de infotainment, incluyendo la integración de tecnologías como Apple CarPlay y Android Auto.

Requirements

Ingeniería de Requisitos (Requirement Engineering): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia en definición, gestión y elicitación de requisitos).

Gestión de Requisitos con IBM DOORS: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Control de Flujos de Trabajo con IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC): Nivel Intermedio (2-3 años de experiencia).

Seguimiento de Incidencias con JIRA: Nivel Intermedio (2-3 años de experiencia).

Ciclo de Vida de Liberación de Software (SDLC): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Diagnóstico y Resolución de Problemas (HW/SW): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Metodología de Ingeniería de Sistemas: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Protocolos de Comunicación Vehicular (CAN, LIN): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Conocimiento en Sistemas Embebidos: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Análisis DFMEA: Nivel Básico-Intermedio (1-5 años de experiencia).
