Position: GHL Support Virtual Assistant

Schedule: 7:00 AM–3:00 PM PST

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Pay: $5–$7 USD/hour DOE

About the Role

We are looking for a GHL Support VA who can provide first-level technical support to clients using GoHighLevel (GHL).

This role is similar to working in a call center or technical support environment, but you will be working remotely from home. You will take incoming support calls from clients who may not be very tech-savvy and help troubleshoot their GHL issues in real time.

What You'll Do

  • Answer incoming client support calls and clearly understand the issue.
  • Troubleshoot common GHL issues while on the call.
  • Assist clients with issues such as: - Text messages not being sent
    - Appointment confirmations or reminders being sent incorrectly

    - Workflow or automation issues

    - Appointment scheduling problems

    - Clients having difficulty navigating or using GHL

  • Walk clients through basic GHL functions and provide clear instructions.
  • Troubleshoot workflows and identify what may be causing an issue.
  • Determine when an issue cannot be resolved during the call.
  • Document unresolved issues and pass them to the Back-End Support Team for further investigation.
  • Maintain professional, patient, and clear communication with clients throughout each call.

Requirements

  • Mid-level GoHighLevel (GHL) experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot and understand GHL workflows and automations
  • Strong, clear spoken English — this is a client-facing phone support role
  • Previous call center, BPO, customer support, technical support, or phone support experience required
  • Comfortable handling multiple types of client issues over the phone
  • Patient and able to explain technical concepts to non-technical users
  • Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can think through a problem while talking to the client, not just someone who knows how to use GHL.

You should be comfortable saying, "Let me check that for you," investigating the issue, trying a solution, and determining whether it can be resolved on the call or needs to be escalated to the back-end team.

If you have GHL experience + strong phone support skills + good troubleshooting ability, we'd like to hear from you!

Salary: $5 - $7 USD/hour DOE

Job Description:

Are you looking to join an entrepreneurial firm which is one of the fastest growing in the US - one where you will be the "go to" high net worth tax expert?


Are you inspired to lead a practice, lead people and make a difference for your clients?


If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a High Net Worth Tax Managing Director! Our private wealth practice recognizes the unique challenges of wealthy individuals and privately held business owners. We help company executives, business owners, affluent families and family offices, estates and trusts in managing, preserving and transitioning wealth. Our consulting professionals provide comprehensive strategic income, trust, estate and gift tax, succession planning, valuation and international tax services.


You will work side-by-side with firm leadership and will be a valued mentor and coach to a group of talented staff. BT has the ability to provide you with an amazing ownership experience working with some of the most entrepreneurial partners in our field.


What you will do:

  • Lead compliance and consulting services to high-net-worth individuals, multi-generational affluent families, family offices and their private businesses and/or investment entities:

    • Lead multiple engagements that deliver proactive tax planning and strategic consulting including federal, estate, gift, charitable planning and generation skipping tax
    • Advise and make recommendations to clients on business succession planning
    • Build on technical competence by keeping up-to-date on trends, developments and technical authorities - applying them to complex situations
  • Manage client engagement staffing, billings/collections, and ensure client profitability targets are met
  • Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with the goal of acquiring new clients, projects, and revenue
  • Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
  • Support the growth and development of team members through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals
  • Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance

  • CPA or JD required
  • Experience as a leader in a public accounting firm in the Tax space
  • Eight (8)+ years’ experience in tax planning and consulting for wealthy individuals, family members and their trusts, investment entities, and private businesses. This includes strong experience in personal taxation, trust taxation, estate & gift taxation, charitable taxation, with exposure to flow through entities, partnership taxation and corporate taxation
  • Four (4)+ years supervisory experience, mentoring and counseling associates
  • Ability to lead and supervise others, provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning in order to stay current regarding applicable strategies, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of projects.
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S., without sponsorship, highly preferred.
  • Ability to travel as needed for client engagements.

    The California pay rate range is $201,810 to $382,600.

raw.title: Head of Business Development & Sales
raw.excerpt: About Five JarsFive Jars is a US-based digital product and engineering company with a distributed team across the United States and Europe.
raw.description:
About Five Jars

Five Jars is a US-based digital product and engineering company with a distributed team across the United States and Europe.

For nearly ten years, we have designed, built, integrated, and supported complex digital platforms for nonprofit organizations, membership-based organizations, cultural institutions, healthcare organizations, and other mid-market clients.

Our experience includes:

  • digital platforms and customer-facing products;
  • CMS-based ecosystems;
  • custom integrations;
  • portals and self-service experiences;
  • web and mobile applications;
  • managed support and platform development;
  • our own SaaS products, Screen Pulse and Deyra.

We are now evolving our commercial direction. While web development remains part of our business, we intend to place greater emphasis on digital products, integrations, platforms, automation, managed services, and recurring product revenue.

We are looking for a hands-on commercial leader who can own this transition from the business development and sales side.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build and Own Lead Generation

Develop and execute a practical lead-generation strategy across Five Jars’ service and product directions.

Responsibilities include:

  • defining and refining ideal customer profiles, buyer roles, target-account criteria, and priority markets;
  • researching new industries, market segments, accounts, partners, and commercial opportunities;
  • building targeted account lists and identifying relevant decision-makers;
  • personally executing targeted outbound activities during the initial stage of the role;
  • developing personalized outreach through email, LinkedIn, referrals, industry communities, events, and other appropriate channels;
  • responding to and qualifying inbound leads;
  • reactivating previous leads, stalled opportunities, former clients, and existing relationships;
  • identifying expansion opportunities within the existing client base;
  • developing referral, technology, agency, and industry partnerships;
  • working with the company’s marketing resource to improve landing pages, case studies, campaigns, sales materials, and inbound conversion;
  • testing different messages, offers, industries, buyer segments, and acquisition channels;
  • tracking channel performance from initial contact through qualified opportunity and revenue;
  • identifying why previous lead-generation activities did or did not work;
  • discontinuing low-performing activities rather than optimizing for outreach volume;
  • establishing a repeatable lead-generation process that can later be delegated or scaled through additional hires or external resources.

The objective is to create a consistent flow of qualified opportunities – not simply contact lists, email volume, booked meetings, or other activity metrics.

2. Own the Full Sales Cycle

Take responsibility for opportunities from initial contact through contract signature.

This includes:

  • responding to inbound leads;
  • generating and researching targeted outbound opportunities;
  • qualifying leads against agreed ICP and commercial criteria;
  • running discovery calls;
  • identifying business goals, problems, stakeholders, budget, timeline, and decision process;
  • shaping the commercial solution;
  • preparing proposals, estimates, presentations, and follow-up materials;
  • handling objections and negotiations;
  • maintaining momentum and clear next steps;
  • progressing opportunities through to close.

You will be expected to independently close standardized and lower-complexity opportunities without requiring a founder to participate in every call.

3. Rebuild the Business Development and Sales Process

Review the existing commercial process and identify where opportunities are being lost.

Responsibilities include:

  • auditing recent leads, proposals, and lost opportunities;
  • conducting win/loss analysis;
  • identifying weaknesses in qualification, discovery, positioning, pricing, proposals, follow-up, or trust-building;
  • defining clear sales stages and exit criteria;
  • establishing practical lead qualification rules;
  • improving CRM data quality and forecasting;
  • creating reusable discovery, proposal, follow-up, and presentation templates;
  • defining appropriate sales KPIs;
  • ensuring that qualified opportunities are consistently progressed.

The objective is not to introduce unnecessary sales bureaucracy. The objective is to create a process that is visible, manageable, and repeatable.

4. Help Transform Five Jars’ Go-to-Market Direction

Work with company leadership to refine what Five Jars sells and how those services are presented to the market.

This includes:

  • analyzing demand across existing and adjacent markets;
  • identifying commercially attractive project types;
  • helping shift positioning away from technology-specific messaging such as Drupal or WordPress;
  • developing offers around products, integrations, digital platforms, automation, and managed services;
  • helping package services into clearer and easier-to-buy engagements;
  • evaluating pricing, scope, commercial structure, and differentiation;
  • testing new service propositions with real prospects;
  • recommending which verticals and opportunities Five Jars should prioritize or avoid.

5. Develop Revenue Channels

Build a balanced commercial pipeline using channels appropriate for a specialized software and digital product company.

Potential channels include:

  • inbound lead conversion;
  • expansion of existing accounts;
  • reactivation of previous leads and opportunities;
  • targeted account-based outreach;
  • strategic partnerships;
  • referrals;
  • technology ecosystems;
  • industry events and conferences;
  • selective outbound campaigns;
  • product-led entry opportunities.

The goal is not simply to maximize outreach volume. The goal is to identify channels that generate qualified opportunities and can become repeatable.

6. Develop Existing Accounts

Work with current Five Jars clients to identify additional opportunities, including:

  • integrations;
  • platform modernization;
  • new digital products;
  • automation;
  • AI-enabled functionality;
  • mobile or self-service experiences;
  • accessibility and performance improvements;
  • ongoing managed services;
  • Screen Pulse or Deyra adoption.

This should be done as consultative account development, not aggressive upselling.

7. Sell Five Jars Products

Own or support the commercial development of Screen Pulse and Deyra.

Responsibilities include:

  • understanding the products and target customers;
  • running product discovery and demonstrations;
  • qualifying product opportunities;
  • preparing commercial proposals;
  • independently closing straightforward product deals;
  • identifying opportunities to bundle products with Five Jars services;
  • collecting market feedback;
  • helping refine pricing, packaging, positioning, and target segments;
  • distinguishing real customer demand from speculative product ideas.

Product sales are part of the role, but not expected to operate as a completely separate sales organization from day one.

8. Build the Future Commercial Team

Initially, this is a hands-on individual contributor position.

As the commercial process becomes repeatable, you will be expected to:

  • identify which additional sales or marketing capabilities are genuinely needed;
  • define future roles and responsibilities;
  • participate in hiring;
  • onboard and manage commercial team members;
  • establish performance expectations;
  • create a structure that does not depend indefinitely on the founders.

Hiring a team is not the first objective. The first objective is proving a working commercial model.

Required Experience

Must Have

  • Proven experience owning the complete B2B sales cycle for custom software development, digital products, systems integration, digital agencies, or related professional services.
  • Experience personally generating, qualifying, progressing, and closing opportunities.
  • Experience selling services to clients in the United States.
  • Demonstrable history of closing mid-market service or technology deals, not only low-cost SaaS subscriptions.
  • Strong experience running business-focused discovery calls.
  • Ability to translate client problems into a clear commercial solution.
  • Experience preparing proposals, statements of work, estimates, presentations, and follow-up materials.
  • Experience responding to RFPs.
  • Experience handling objections, negotiations, and complex decision processes.
  • Ability to work with technical teams and understand software delivery sufficiently to sell it credibly.
  • Experience improving or building sales processes in an environment where they were incomplete or ineffective.
  • Ability to work independently without requiring daily management from founders.
  • (If candidate is not English-native speaker) Strong written and spoken English, C1–C2.
  • Strong organizational discipline and CRM usage.
  • Ability to work hands-on before building or managing a team.
  • Comfortable working in an organization with limited marketing and sales resources.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling both professional services and software products.
  • Experience selling digital product development, integrations, portals, platforms, SaaS, or managed services.
  • Experience creating or rebuilding a business development function.
  • Existing relationships or experience in nonprofit, membership, healthcare, fitness, cultural, education, or association markets.
  • Experience with HubSpot.
  • Experience developing referral and technology partnerships.
  • Familiarity with CMS, CRM, API, cloud, and integration projects.
  • Experience with account-based and targeted outbound sales.

We Offer

  • Full-time remote work.
  • Contract in the first year; employment with access to all company benefits afterwards.
  • Fixed compensation plus performance-based commission.
  • Significant ownership of the commercial function.
  • Direct access to company leadership.
  • Opportunity to influence the company’s future direction.
  • Support for professional development and relevant industry events.

raw.description:
Why ADN? Join the American Data Network family and become part of an established, purpose-driven healthcare quality organization with more than 30 years of experience. At ADN, our work supports hospitals and healthcare clients in improving quality, patient safety, and clinical outcomes. We value integrity, accuracy, collaboration, and professionalism, and we are looking for experienced abstractors who take pride in producing high-quality work.

Position Summary: American Data Network is seeking experienced NCDR TVT Registry Abstractors to support accurate and timely cardiovascular registry abstraction for assigned healthcare clients. This role is ideal for candidates with recent, hands-on TVT abstraction experience who can independently review clinical documentation, apply registry specifications, and meet assigned deadlines with a high level of accuracy.

This is not a general data entry position. Candidates must have direct healthcare registry, clinical chart review, quality reporting, or data abstraction experience specific to NCDR TVT.

Position Details: ADN hires both contractors and full-time employees for Data Abstraction roles. Contractors must be available for a minimum of 15 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews patient medical records and abstracts data for the NCDR TVT Registry.
  • Applies registry specifications, definitions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and abstraction guidelines accurately and consistently.
  • Interprets clinical documentation related to cardiology procedures, diagnoses, treatments, outcomes, complications, and related quality measures.
  • Enters accurate and complete data into assigned registry platforms, EHRs, vendor tools, or other data collection systems.
  • Maintains a high level of abstraction accuracy, completeness, and attention to detail.
  • Meets assigned productivity expectations, weekly progress goals, and internal and client deadlines.
  • Participates in quality assurance activities, including feedback, correction, validation, and IRR reviews.
  • Communicates professionally with account leads, team members, and client contacts when clarification is needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality and complies with ADN, client, HIPAA, and data security requirements.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • At least 2 years of recent NCDR TVT Registry abstraction experience.
  • Ability to independently abstract TVT cases using registry specifications and clinical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare quality reporting, registry abstraction, clinical documentation review, and medical record interpretation.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Comfort working in multiple EHRs, registry platforms, vendor tools, and data collection systems as assigned.
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.
  • Contractors must have high-speed secure internet, a PC or laptop, and at least two monitors.

Preferred:

  • Experience using the NCDR application, NCDR reports, and/or other related data collection tools.
  • Experience with IRR, QA review, audit validation, and/or abstraction accuracy review.

Screening & Onboarding: Qualified candidates will complete an initial phone screen and a TVT-specific abstraction assessment. The assessment is designed to evaluate understanding of registry specifications, abstraction judgment, accuracy, and completion speed.

ADN does not provide basic TVT abstraction training, so candidates should already have the registry experience needed for the role. After hire, ADN provides onboarding to ADN processes, client systems, EHR access, documentation tendencies, and other client-specific workflows.

Why This Role May Be a Good Fit: This position may be a strong fit for experienced TVT abstractors who enjoy independent work, flexible scheduling, registry-based chart review, healthcare quality reporting, and contributing to meaningful work that supports hospitals and patient care. ADN offers a knowledgeable and supportive team environment, multiple registry opportunities, and potential growth into lead or expanded quality roles for strong performers.

raw.description:
Drive user growth by turning analytics into business impact

At Resmed, you’ll transform how we understand and grow our connected-device user base. As the User Data Growth Analytics Lead, you’ll lead the measurement framework that explains what drives user engagement, retention, and expansion—and how those dynamics connect directly to demand and revenue. In this role, you’ll help Resmed make smarter, faster decisions about how to grow value across millions of active users.

You’ll collaborate across Finance, Product, and Commercial teams to connect insights from our digital ecosystem, including myAir and AirView, with the financial performance that drives our continued growth. Your analysis will shape trusted metrics, forecasting models, and next-generation analytics products that help connect patient engagement to commercial outcomes.

You’ll bring a consumer-first lens to healthcare, building experimental approaches that move quickly from analysis to action. This is your chance to help Resmed evolve the way we measure and grow user outcomes—by teaching us new ways to think about engagement and retention.

What you’ll do

  • Define the analytics foundation - Own and evolve the measurement framework for our user base, shaping clear KPIs for engagement, retention, and experience enhancement across connected platforms.
  • Tell the story behind the data - Build cohort and lifecycle analyses to explain user behaviors, identify growth opportunities, and clarify what drives retention or churn.
  • Translate insight into financial impact - Link user dynamics to commercial performance, connecting engagement and retention metrics directly to demand and revenue outcomes.
  • Drive cross-functional visibility, insights, and accountability – Partner across Product, Marketing, Finance and Commercial teams to analyze business performance, identify drivers of growth and retention, and align actions to improve outcomes. Elevate actionable insights to leadership to inform strategic decisions, drive cross-functional accountability, and strengthen business performance.
  • Shape scalable data products - Collaborate with Data and Technology partners to improve data quality, streamline KPI governance, and develop reliable, curated datasets and dashboards that enable self-service analytics across teams.
  • Move fast, measure impact, and evolve - Discover opportunities in the data, test hypotheses, measure results, and quickly refine strategies based on what the insights reveal.
  • Build agile forecasts and size opportunities - Develop models to measure potential impacts of strategic efforts—estimating how movement in retention, resupply, or engagement metrics could translate into revenue uplift or cost efficiency.
  • Drive accountability through always-on measurement - Create visibility with regular tracking and interpretation of performance trends. Go beyond reporting, explaining why metrics shift and what actions should follow.
  • Champion thought leadership - Represent Retain & Expand analytics in leadership forums, act as a strategic partner in business planning, and guide discussions on how to measure success across Resmed’s evolving user base.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, growth, or user analytics, including leadership of complex analytical programs or teams
  • Expertise with large longitudinal datasets, lifecycle and retention analysis, and driver-based forecasting
  • Advanced SQL and analytical skills, with proficiency in Power BI/Tableau, Excel, Python, or similar tools
  • Strong business and financial acumen, capable of translating behavioral data into forecast impact
  • Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and influence decision-making through clear, data-driven narratives
  • Comfort working in ambiguity, curious mindset, and collaborative style that turns analytics into outcomes

Nice to have

raw.title: Director, Clinical Operations
raw.excerpt: About LifeforceWe are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health.
raw.description:
About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

    Lifeforce is hiring a Director, Clinical Operations to run the operating engine behind our national proactive care delivery model. You'll own how clinicians get licensed, credentialed, onboarded, scheduled, supported, and reviewed for quality, and you'll make sure all of it holds up as we grow.

    And we're growing fast. Our network of 50+ physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants is expected to more than triple over the next 15 months, across a growing number of states. At the same time, we're opening physical longevity centers and the clinicians supporting those centers run through this role too. The systems that work for a network of 50 won't work at 200, and this role is the one that gets us there ahead of demand rather than behind it.

    This is primarily an operations leadership role, not a clinical one. Clinical standards and clinical judgment stay with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. You'll own the people, processes, systems, and data that let clinicians do their best work at scale. You'll report to the COO and lead four teams: Clinical Operations, Clinical Onboarding & Enablement, Credentialing & Licensing, and Clinical Quality Assurance. You'll start with a small team and build it out to about 15 people by the end of 2027.

Key Responsibilities

    Capacity & Scheduling

  • Own clinician capacity planning against member demand, state by state. Know where we'll be short a quarter before it happens.

  • Own clinician scheduling, including how appointments are assigned across telehealth, nurse services, and our centers, and how continuity of care is protected as the network grows. Work with Product and Engineering to build the tools for scheduling that the teams need.

  • Track utilization, panel concentration, and access (time to next appointment), and act when they drift.

    • Hire to Productive

  • Own the full clinician pipeline after the offer: licensure, credentialing, onboarding, training, and ramp to full schedule.

  • Set and hit targets for time to credentialed and time- to-productive, and fix the bottlenecks in between.

  • Build a licensure and DEA strategy that ensures compliance and keeps pace with growth.

    • Quality & Clinician Performance

  • Own the operations of the clinical QA program, so every clinician is reviewed on schedule and the results reach the people who need them. The Clinical QA Lead reports to you, with a dotted line to the Medical Director on clinical standards.

  • Build the operating process for clinician performance management with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. They own the clinical judgment; you own the cadence, data, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Make sure the review approach and the follow-up fit our independent contractor model.

    • SOPs, Systems & Change Management

  • Own the clinical SOP lifecycle: intake, drafting with clinical owners, approval, rollout, and retirement, with Guru as the system of record.

  • Run changes so clinicians hear about them once, clearly, and know what they need to do differently.

  • Own the clinical operations tool stack (Healthie, Rippit, Guru, and our scheduling and credentialing tools) and the vendors behind it.

    • Metrics & Reporting

  • Build and optimize the clinician and clinical operations scorecards: capacity, utilization, time-to-productive, credentialing status, quality, satisfaction, adherence, and clinician and member retention.

  • Partner with Data & Analytics to automate it, and use it to run the business and report up to the COO and executive team as well as across the clinical and clin ops orgs.

    • Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Hire, develop, and lead the managers and leads across your four teams, and set structure and spans as the teams grow.

  • Support the clinicians serving our franchise centers, and partner with the Director, Clinical Franchise Operations so telehealth and center operations share standards and systems.

  • Work closely with the Medical Director and Deputy Medical Directors, Recruiting, CX, Pharmacy Operations, and Product.

  • Own the clinical operations budget and headcount plan.

What Success Looks Like

    In your first 90 days: map how clinician ops actually runs today and set a baseline on the core metrics. Get the new Onboarding & Enablement Manager and Clinical QA Lead fully ramped. Publish a capacity plan by state through the end of 2027, and get clear visibility into where every clinician in the pipeline stands.

    In your first year: clinician capacity stays ahead of member demand in every state we serve. New clinicians move from offer to full schedule on a predictable, measured timeline. Every clinician is reviewed on schedule, SOPs are current and in one place, and the scorecard runs without manual pulls. Your four teams are built out with strong leaders, and the operation is ready for the next stage of growth.

Qualifications

    Required

  • 8+ years in healthcare operations, including 3+ years leading managers.

  • Experience in direct-to-consumer telehealth, or in longevity, concierge, or preventive medicine.

  • Has scaled a clinician network through fast growth at a telehealth company, a multi-site provider group, or a similar organization.

  • Hands-on experience with clinician capacity planning, scheduling, or workforce management.

  • Working knowledge of multi-state licensure and credentialing, and how they gate clinician supply.

  • Has built and run onboarding, QA, or SOP programs that held up as volume grew.

  • Comfortable with data: defines metrics, builds reporting with analytics partners, and uses it to make decisions.

  • Has earned credibility with physicians and advanced practice clinicians as a non-clinical leader, and knows where operations ends and clinical judgment begins.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

    • Preferred

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience

  • Experience in both strategy or consulting and hands-on operational roles

  • Experience with multi-site or franchise healthcare operations.

  • Experience running an independent contractor (1099) clinician model.

  • Experience with Healthie, Rippit (formerly MaestroQA), Guru, or similar tools.

  • Has introduced automation or AI tools into clinical operations workflows.

Traits for Success

  • Builds the system before it breaks, not after.

  • Comfortable holding clinicians and clinical leaders to operating standards without being a clinician.

  • Moves between strategy and the details of a broken workflow in the same day.

  • Pairs every problem with a recommendation.

  • Keeps the member and the clinician experience in view when making operating decisions.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment

  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment

  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

Manage accounts receivable for managed hotel properties, including guest and direct-bill ledgers, aging and collections, travel-agent commission activity, payment discrepancies and reconciliation between property management and payment systems.

  • Shift/Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila Time)

Responsibilities

  • Review hotel guest ledgers, accounts receivable ledgers and direct-bill balances to identify unresolved items and collection risks.
  • Monitor receivable aging, follow up on outstanding balances and resolve account allocation and payment discrepancies, as well as apply payments received in the PMS against the proper folios.

  • Solid Excel capability and experience with an ERP, AR or property accounting platform.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to be the founding member of Burq's Platform team — the function that owns our engineering foundations: infrastructure, security, CI/CD, and reliability.

Right now, our infrastructure runs on AWS with a combination of ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and Step Functions. We have a strong contractor advising us, but we need a full-time engineer who can own this domain, execute on a significant infrastructure roadmap, and make every product team faster as a result.

This is a high-leverage, high-ownership role. You will be designing and building the platform that Burq scales on for the next several years.

Infrastructure

  • Own and execute the AWS account split — separating production, staging, and development into clean isolated environments
  • Lead the Aurora DB production migration with support from our infrastructure advisor
  • Manage and evolve our ECS Fargate services, RDS clusters, ElastiCache, SQS queues, and ALB configuration
  • Own Terraform — infrastructure as code, not click-ops

Security & Access

  • Harden IAM — developer permission sets, production access controls, least-privilege enforcement
  • Audit and lock down public S3 buckets
  • Enable AWS Config and Security Hub across all accounts
  • Own SOC 2 Type 2 readiness maintenance in partnership with Sprinto
  • Coordinate external penetration test cadence

CI/CD & Developer Experience

  • Own and improve our GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines — build times, test reliability, deployment velocity
  • Build out PR stack environments so product teams can test independently
  • Drive the local development stack initiative — Docker Compose-based environments that replace shared preprod
  • Integrate AI-assisted testing into the CI pipeline

Observability & Reliability

  • Own CloudWatch dashboards spanning ALB, ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and target group health
  • Lead post-incident reviews and ensure every incident produces a runbook entry
  • Partner with product teams to distribute platform work as a standing sprint allocation — not a separate queue

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years focused on infrastructure and platform engineering
  • Deep AWS expertise — ECS, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, Lambda, account architecture
  • Terraform proficiency — you write infrastructure as code and know why it matters
  • Strong CI/CD background — GitHub Actions, deployment pipelines, environment management
  • Security-minded — you know how to harden systems without creating friction for product engineers
  • Experience with observability tooling — CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Investing in you 🙏

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical coverage
  • Access to educational resources and courses

raw.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager to produce the real-world experiences where traders, creators, partners, and builders meet MetaMask. You’ll lead production, help shape event strategy, and sharpen the creative execution.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the Experiential & Global Events team within MetaMask’s Creative Studio and report to the Director of Experiential Marketing. We concept, design, and produce the ways people meet MetaMask in real life across global conferences, community events, VIP experiences, co-branded activations, and more. Our calendar runs across the world with priorities across APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.

You’ll lead production, taking each event from brief to on-site to recap. You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. Your focus will be experiences for our most active users and co-branded work with brands and creators, alongside community events for the builders who create on MetaMask.

Our formats are expanding to include live trading competitions, viewing events, product launches, and private experiences for VIP traders and creator partners.

How You’ll Do It

  • Produce events and experiences end to end: venues, run of show, fabrication, AV, F&B, and staffing, working alongside our production agency partners.
  • Own timelines, workback plans, and budgets for multiple events running in parallel across regions.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage agencies, venues, and vendors in APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.
  • Run registration and guest management, from guest lists and approvals to VIP access and arrival.
  • Build programming for events and panels, including formats, session flow, and speaker coordination.
  • Keep the operational side tight: source-of-truth docs, trackers, internal team staffing, and on-the-ground comms during conference weeks. Build playbooks that make each event easier to run than the last, using AI tools to move faster.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across product, marketing, business development and more to turn briefs into event plans with clear audiences, objectives, and success metrics tied to product and business goals.
  • Help develop and refine concepts with the creative team. Bring a point of view on formats, venues, and cultural trends, and work with designers and copywriters on decks and creative deliverables.
  • Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.
  • Track post-event results, including attendance, registration data, and social reach and sentiment, and write recaps that show what worked and what to change.
  • Over time, help source and manage co-hosts and sponsors for our owned franchises.

We’re looking for someone with

  • 5+ years in event production, experiential marketing, or brand activations, ideally in fintech, crypto, consumer tech, esports, or entertainment.
  • Experience producing large-format or competitive live events, such as tournaments, launches, or live viewing events.
  • A track record of delivering multi-city or international events on time and on budget.
  • Experience managing agencies and vendors and negotiating contracts under tight deadlines.
  • Experience producing premium or invite-only experiences for high-value guests.
  • Strong initiative. You spot what needs to happen and do it before anyone asks, and you stay steady when the plan changes.
  • Strategic and creative judgment. You connect an event to a product or business goal, and you bring ideas that sharpen a concept.
  • A systems mindset. You turn one-off events into repeatable processes.
  • Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership. Partners, vendors, and colleagues want to work with you again.
  • Based in the US or EU, and willing to travel internationally up to 20% of the year, typically 1 to 2 weeks per quarter across several markets.
  • Curiosity about money, markets, and how people trade, save, and spend. Finance experience isn’t required, but interest is.

It’s a bonus to have

  • Experience in crypto, whether producing events for digital asset audiences or at global conferences such as Token2049, Korea Blockchain Week, EthCC, or Devcon.
  • Experience sourcing or managing event co-hosts and sponsors.
  • Relationships with brands, creators, or communities that could become MetaMask partners.
  • An existing network of production vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, and Luma.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$101,000—$141,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. raw.description:
EP Wealth Advisors (EPWA) is a wealth management advisory firm with over $49.1 billion as of June 30, 2026, serving predominately high net worth individuals. EPWA fosters an inclusive environment that offers opportunities for our associates to learn, grow and enhance their skills to take on new challenges to progress in their professional careers.

Role Overview

EP Wealth Advisors is seeking a hands-on Senior Agentforce Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered advisor and client experiences on Salesforce. This role goes beyond traditional Salesforce administration and will design, build, test, deploy, and support production-grade AI agents and the workflows, integrations, custom actions, controls, and data connections that enable them.

You will work across Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, Agentforce, Data 360, APIs, and EP Wealth's broader technology ecosystem, partnering closely with Product, Salesforce Engineering, AI & Data Platforms, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, business process owners, and strategic vendors. The ideal candidate combines strong declarative Salesforce skills with the engineering depth to build secure, reliable, measurable agentic workflows in a regulated wealth-management environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agentforce Engineering

    • Design, build, test, deploy, and support Salesforce Agentforce agents, including instructions, actions, decision logic, prompt templates, guardrails, escalation paths, and human handoffs.
    • Translate business processes into reusable agent capabilities and multi-step workflows, selecting the right combination of declarative configuration, Flow, Apex, and custom actions.
    • Build agents focused on advisor and client outcomes - reducing operational friction, improving accuracy and data quality, increasing capacity, and enabling more timely and personalized interactions.
    • Continuously refine agent behavior based on production results, user feedback, business outcomes, and evolving Salesforce capabilities.

    Integration & Workflow Engineering

    • Design and implement secure integrations between Agentforce, Salesforce, and approved enterprise systems using REST APIs, Salesforce integration capabilities, middleware, and other approved patterns.
    • Develop custom Agentforce actions and supporting Apex or integration logic when standard platform capabilities are insufficient.
    • Engineer resilient end-to-end workflows with appropriate authentication, validation, exception handling, retries, transaction integrity, and human intervention for sensitive or transactional processes.
    • Partner with Salesforce and platform engineering teams on reusable integration patterns that support agentic workflows across EP Wealth's technology ecosystem.

    Data & Grounding

    • Partner with the AI & Data Platforms team to define data requirements and configure Data 360, retrieval, grounding, permissions, and Salesforce-side access patterns for agent use.
    • Ensure agents use trusted, appropriately authorized data sources and that data quality, identity, freshness, and source-of-truth requirements are understood before deployment.
    • Support Salesforce data processes and connectivity while avoiding duplicative data pipelines; partner with data engineering and governance teams where enterprise data products or upstream remediation are required.

    Agent Testing, Quality & Production Operations

    • Establish repeatable testing and evaluation practices for agents, including expected behavior, edge cases, ambiguous requests, missing data, permission boundaries, downstream failures, escalation, and human handoff.
    • Build and maintain regression test coverage as prompts, actions, workflows, models, integrations, and underlying data change; partner with Product and business teams on production acceptance criteria.
    • Monitor agent logs and execution behavior for reliability, action failures, response quality, performance, and user experience, and use the findings to drive ongoing improvement.
    • Troubleshoot production issues across prompts, Agentforce configuration, Flow, Apex, permissions, integrations, grounding, and data; follow disciplined source-control, deployment, release-validation, and technical-documentation practices.

    Governance, Security & Compliance

    • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Data Governance to ensure Agentforce solutions meet EP Wealth standards for data access, privacy, authorization, auditability, records, and human oversight.
    • Design explicit guardrails, approval steps, escalation paths, and controls for higher-risk use cases, particularly workflows that take actions or interact with sensitive client information.
    • Ensure agent interactions, data access, decisions, and actions can be appropriately logged, monitored, reviewed, and audited.

    Product & Business Partnership

    • Partner with Product Managers, business process owners, advisors, operations teams, and technology partners to shape high-value AI use cases and translate business requirements into technically feasible agent designs.
    • Participate in discovery, solution design, demos, user validation, and iterative feedback throughout the product lifecycle rather than treating Agentforce as a stand-alone technical implementation.
    • Define and track meaningful success measures - including adoption, quality, advisor capacity, operational efficiency, client experience, and business outcomes - and use them to prioritize improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

    • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce platform engineering, development, or advanced configuration experience, ideally in Financial Services Cloud or another complex enterprise Salesforce environment.
    • Hands-on experience building Agentforce agents or comparable Salesforce AI, conversational AI, intelligent workflow, or bot solutions.
    • Strong Salesforce Flow experience, including record-triggered and screen flows, process automation, validation rules, and complex business-process design.
    • Working proficiency with Apex, including the ability to build or modify custom actions and integration logic when declarative capabilities are insufficient.
    • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating Salesforce with external enterprise systems; familiarity with middleware and event/integration patterns is valuable.
    • Strong understanding of Salesforce object models, security, permissions, sharing, data architecture, and production troubleshooting.
    • Working knowledge of Agentforce concepts including instructions, actions, prompt templates, grounding, escalation, human handoff, and agent performance monitoring.
    • Experience with Data 360 or similar approaches for enterprise data unification and AI grounding, with an understanding of data quality and governed access requirements.
    • Experience with source control and release tooling such as Git/GitHub, Gearset, or comparable platforms, along with software testing, regression testing, and production validation practices.
    • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Data, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Operations, and business teams in an Agile or iterative delivery model.

    Nice to Have

    Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Platform Developer, Admin/Advanced Admin; MuleSoft or other enterprise integration experience; familiarity with OmniStudio, AI/LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, or agent observability; and experience in Wealth Management, Financial Services, or another regulated industry.

What We Offer

You will also have the chance to make an impact on the industry and open source communities.

As a Software Engineer on our Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be at the forefront of developing the infrastructure platform that supports all teams across Airbnb. Your primary focus will be on operations and delivery of components such as our developer APIs and CLIs, Kubernetes infrastructure, autoscaling and capacity management tools, and cloud infrastructure automation. With a global user base, our team's core values emphasize reliability, scalability, efficiency, and high availability.

A Typical Day:

  • Deliver secure, efficient, mature, and highly available frameworks and platforms that simplify infrastructure complexity.
  • Optimize and enhance existing systems and services to boost performance and operational efficiency.
  • Improve system availability by implementing industry best practices in distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with a diverse team of talented infrastructure engineers to establish a solid foundation for Airbnb’s technological growth in the coming decade.

Your Expertise:

Kubernetes. You live and breathe Kubernetes. You have operated it at scale. You can talk in detail about it and have a proven track record of operating it at scale.

  • 10+ years of experience years of industry experience with a BS/Masters and 2+ years with a PhD, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and solid production debugging skills.
  • A passion for efficiency, availability, reliability, and overall system quality.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb Payments, Inc. (a subsidiary of Airbnb, Inc.) is a registered entity. Approved remote states include: Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is excluded. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: . How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$212,000—$265,000 USD

You’ll design innovative new investment products alongside our Product and Finance teams. Your leadership can directly influence how millions of people invest in real estate through Arrived.

How You Will Contribute:

Set and Scale the Investment Strategy

  • Manage and optimize our investment strategy and portfolios across real estate equity, credit, and hybrid products.
  • Develop and maintain investment theses, portfolio construction frameworks, risk frameworks, and underwriting standards to achieve desired return targets.

Build and Manage Diversified Portfolios

  • Lead the process for performance monitoring, asset optimization, value creation, refinancing, and dispositions.

Grow and Develop the Investments Team

  • Recruit, mentor, and scale a high-performing team spanning acquisitions, underwriting, research, and asset management.

Stakeholder in Product Innovation

raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

raw.description:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.
Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

As the Director of Learning & Development on Ro's Care Delivery team, you will own the learning strategy and programs supporting hundreds of clinical and non-clinical patient-facing team members. You will ensure our teams have the knowledge, skills, and resources to deliver high-quality patient care at scale, from onboarding and new program launches to ongoing development, performance improvement, and retraining.

You will build the systems, processes, and infrastructure that enable Learning & Development to operate effectively as our business evolves. This includes establishing how we identify and prioritize learning needs, develop and maintain content, scale learning across teams, and measure whether learning translates into the expected behaviors and performance outcomes. You will also own the evaluation and adoption of learning technologies and tools, ensuring the team is equipped to operate efficiently and stays at the forefront of adult learning practices, emerging technologies, and innovative approaches to learning. You will partner closely with Clinical, Operations, Quality & Safety, Product, and other cross-functional leaders to ensure learning investments address the right problems and drive measurable impact.

You are a strategic and operational leader who knows how to build a scalable learning function in a fast-moving, complex environment. You bring strong judgment about when training is the right solution, a data-driven approach to improving frontline performance, and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team. You are a complexity buster - able to distill the most complex clinical or technical concepts to acceptable learning content. You are equally comfortable setting long-term direction, establishing practical systems and processes, and driving execution through your team and cross-functional partners.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the learning strategy

  • Own the end-to-end learning strategy for hundreds of clinical and non-clinical patient-facing team members, spanning onboarding, new programs and launches, ongoing learning, and performance-based retraining.

  • Establish priorities and learning approaches that support business objectives, operational readiness, and high-quality patient care.

  • Build scalable learning systems and processes

  • Establish how learning needs are identified, evaluated, prioritized, and addressed. Create efficient processes for intake, content development, cross-team reuse, maintenance, and governance.

  • Determine when formal training is needed versus more targeted interventions, and select the tools and technologies required to deliver learning effectively at scale.

  • Measure learning effectiveness and drive performance improvement

  • Establish how we assess knowledge acquisition, skill proficiency, and on-the-job application. Partner with Quality, Operations, and frontline leaders to use performance data and frontline feedback to identify capability gaps, diagnose root causes, and implement targeted learning interventions.

  • Build feedback loops that continuously improve learning programs and frontline performance.

  • Build and lead a Learning Center of Excellence

  • Build and develop a high-performing team spanning training and knowledge management. Establish clear roles, accountability, and ways of working across the Learning CoE, frontline teams, and subject matter experts

  • Partner with Product, Quality, and Data partners to use Learning as a way to achieve quality, safety, and patient experience goals

  • Create a consistent, scalable approach to delivering accurate, relevant, and effective learning and knowledge resources across Care Delivery

  • Ensure the team stays at the forefront of adult learning technology and best practices and continuously evolves how learning is designed, delivered, and measured.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, training, or enablement, including experience leading learning programs and teams at scale; experience in healthcare, clinical operations, or another complex, regulated environment preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute a learning strategy that supports multiple functions, audiences, and business priorities.
  • Experience building or scaling a centralized learning function, including establishing operating models, intake and prioritization processes, content governance, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning, instructional design, learning needs analysis, assessment, and performance consulting, with the judgment to distinguish training needs from process, tooling, knowledge management, or other operational gaps.
  • Demonstrated ability to measure learning effectiveness and connect learning outcomes to observable behaviors, quality measures, and operational performance.
  • Experience evaluating, implementing, and optimizing learning technologies, including learning management systems, content development tools, knowledge management platforms, and learning analytics.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including building teams, developing talent, setting clear expectations, and driving accountability.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and partner effectively with clinical, operational, technical, and quality teams.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution, navigate ambiguity, and make sound prioritization decisions in a fast-paced environment.

We’ve Got You Covered:

  • Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth reimbursements

  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits

  • Pet insurance

  • Student loan refinancing

  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

The target base salary for this position ranges from $161,100-$202,000, in addition to a competitive equity and benefits package (as applicable). When determining compensation, we carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.
Ro recognizes the power of in-person collaboration, while supporting the flexibility to work anywhere in the United States. For our Ro’ers in the tri-state (NY) area, you will join us at HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays. For those outside of the tri-state area, you will be able to join in-person collaborations throughout the year (i.e., during team on-sites).
At Ro, we believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths — and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. Es un ingeniero de requisitos de sistemas a nivel intermedio, especializado en el subsistema de Infotainment. Actúa como el enlace crucial entre los Ingenieros de Diseño y Liberación (DREs) y los Arquitectos de Sistemas. Su función principal es traducir las necesidades técnicas y regulatorias en requisitos claros, específicos y gestionables para el diseño, desarrollo, validación y liberación de los componentes eléctricos y electrónicos del vehículo.

Utilizando metodologías de ingeniería de requisitos (Requirement Engineering) para elicitar, analizar, documentar y mantener los requisitos del sistema. Se apoya en herramientas especializadas como IBM DOORS para la gestión de requisitos, IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) para el control de flujos de trabajo, y JIRA para el seguimiento de incidencias. Colabora en el diseño y desarrollo, participa en el ciclo de vida de liberación de software (SDLC) y aplica análisis como DFMEA para asegurar la calidad y fiabilidad del sistema de infotainment, incluyendo la integración de tecnologías como Apple CarPlay y Android Auto.

Ingeniería de Requisitos (Requirement Engineering): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia en definición, gestión y elicitación de requisitos).

Gestión de Requisitos con IBM DOORS: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).

Control de Flujos de Trabajo con IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC): Nivel Intermedio (2-3 años de experiencia).

Seguimiento de Incidencias con JIRA: Nivel Intermedio (2-3 años de experiencia).

Análisis DFMEA: Nivel Básico-Intermedio (1-5 años de experiencia).

raw.description:
Who are we, and why should you join us?
ADHDAdvisor.org is on a mission to remove the conventional barriers to ADHD diagnosis and treatment and make mental health care more accessible to everyone, no matter where they live. Our telehealth platform——was founded to integrate technology, clinical expertise, and progressive approaches to emotional wellness.
What are we looking for?
We’re looking for Virginia licensed Physicians to join our provider network. You can focus on providing clinical expertise while we take care of everything else. Virginia license and DEA required.
Who Should Apply?
  • Physicians looking for an easy, all-in-one technology platform for telehealth.
  • Physicians who are experienced in prescribing stimulant and non stimulant medication when necessary and following federal and state laws.
  • Physicians who want to focus 100% on clinical work – not on acquiring clients, billing, support, or operations. (We handle all of that!)

What Will You Do?

  • Provide holistic mental healthcare to your patients including diagnostic and medication management.
  • Develop and implement treatment plans tailored to your patient's needs and follow the best practices and clinical guidelines.
  • Collaborate with our team of mental health professionals to ensure that your patients receive comprehensive, coordinated care.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records following legal and ethical standards.
  • Help shape our treatment philosophy and contribute to developing clinical policies and procedures.

Requirements

  • Active and unrestricted license in Virginia (required).
  • Active Virginia DEA license (required).
  • Currently carry (or be willing to obtain) independent malpractice liability insurance.
  • Experience diagnosing and treating adult ADHD (ages 18+).
  • Experience prescribing medication, preferably on a telehealth platform.
  • A private and professional environment for conducting sessions.
  • Excellent written communication.
  • Reliable Internet connection.
  • Currently residing in the US.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule: You’re always in control of your schedule and appointment times.
  • Location: We are fully remote – you can work anywhere in the US.
  • License reimbursement: We pay for your license in states where we face a high demand.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We handle operations and ongoing client support.
  • Visibility: We regularly work with leading mental health online publications (Forbes, Ver Well Mind, etc.) to feature articles or case studies written by our team members

Hourly Pay: $150-$200
  • Diagnosis + Medication Management (45 minutes): $112.50-$150
  • Medication Management (30 minutes): $75.00-$100
  • Medication Management Follow-Up (15 minutes): $37.50-$50

raw.description:
Talent Acquisition (80%): Sourcing to Learning & Development Handoff

Build and maintain a candidate pipeline (Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter/Premium, networking, job fairs).

Conduct candidate interviews and evaluate fit for the open role. Document interview notes promptly in a centralized location.

Extend the offer letter; coordinate background check and I-9/E-Verify. Create employee record in HRIS

Onboarding Prep. Confirm start date, schedule, and systems access ahead of day one.

Handoff to L&D. New hire transitions to Learning & Development for orientation, compliance training, and ongoing development.

Offboarding. Close employee record in HRIS, send offboarding email

Sourcing & Filling the Gap

When the candidate pipeline runs thin for an open role, use sourcing (Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter/Premium, networking, job fairs) to fill the gap. Sourcing effort will shift based on open roles, seasonality, and business need.

Recruiting Operations (20%): Keeping Hiring Moving Across the Portfolio

This is the operational side of recruiting: the coordination, follow-up, and communication that keep hiring moving across all six portfolio entities. The Talent Acquisition Specialist is the link between People Operations and each entity's hiring leaders, making sure every open role has a clear owner, a next step, and a date.

Focus Area. What It Looks Like.

Portfolio Liaison

Serve as the connection point between People Operations and the hiring leaders at each of D5's six portfolio entities. Know every open role, its priority, its timeline, and who owns the hiring decision.

Anticipate Needs

Look ahead for each entity: seasonal ramps, backfills, new locations, and upcoming departures. Line up postings, sourcing, interview slots, and hiring manager availability before the need becomes urgent.

Follow-Up & Momentum

Own the follow-up so nothing stalls. Follow up promptly on hiring manager feedback, interview decisions, offer approvals, and new hire paperwork, and escalate early when something is stuck.

Status Updates

Provide consistent, regular status updates to the Sr. Director, People Operations and each entity's leadership on open roles, candidate progress, upcoming start dates, and anything that's stuck.

Hiring Syncs

Coordinate regular hiring check-ins with GMs and entity leaders, capture next steps, and make sure they get closed out.

Interview Documentation

Document interview notes and hiring manager feedback for every candidate and keep them organized in a centralized location, so hiring decisions are well documented and easy to reference.

HRIS Support

Help build out and support the HRIS as our recruiting process takes shape, with the goal of streamlining how candidates, notes, and communication are managed. Support hiring managers in using it and recommend improvements along the way.

How This Role Operates

This role calls for phenomenal proactive and anticipatory follow-through. Don't wait to be asked: see what's coming, act ahead of it, and close the loop. Hiring leaders at every entity should always know where their roles stand, and the Sr. Director, People Operations should never be surprised by a stalled requisition, a missed follow-up, or a delayed start date.

Consistency matters as much as speed: predictable updates, follow-ups without reminders, and open items tracked until resolved.

Building Alongside Us

This is a newer function, and many recruiting processes and tools are still being built. This role fits someone open to joining a new team, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to build alongside the Sr. Director, People Operations, bringing ideas and helping shape how recruiting works as we grow.

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $6/hr

100% Remote
