raw.description:
Background: Center for Civilians in Conflict (CIVIC) is an international nonprofit with offices around the world working to improve protection for civilians caught in conflict zones. Our mission is to work with armed actors and civilians in conflict to develop and implement solutions to prevent, mitigate, and respond to civilian harm. We are advocates who believe that no civilian caught in conflict should be ignored, and advisors who provide practical solutions to prevent and respond to civilian harm. Learn more at civiliansinconflict.org.

CIVIC and Human Rights Activists in Iran (HRA) are undertaking communications and advocacy campaign to amplify awareness of the human costs of the US war in Iran by telling compelling, human-centered stories about civilian harm.

Project Description & Scope of Work: To support the development of content amplifying these stories, CIVIC is seeking to recruit a Multimedia Production and Content Creation Consultant. The consultant will work closely with CIVIC and HRA to design documented testimonies, evidence, and advocacy messages into engaging visual and multimedia content for public dissemination. This will include the production of professional, high-resolution videos suitable for social media platforms, as well as graphics, carousel, and animated videos as required.

Based on documentation collected and curated by HRA, the consultant will collaborate with CIVIC to develop a creative storytelling approach, including visual style, format selection, and audience engagement strategies. The consultant will spearhead the production process, including visual design, video editing, motion graphics, subtitling, sound design, integration of photographs, video footage, interviews, and other source materials as relevant. The consultant will also consult on storyboarding and script development.

All products must adhere to conflict-sensitive and trauma-informed communications principles, ensuring that storytelling approaches do not expose contributors, affected communities, or partners to undue risk. The consultant will work iteratively with CIVIC and HRA throughout the process, incorporating feedback and revisions to ensure that final products align with project objectives, advocacy priorities, and ethical storytelling standards.

The consultant must preserve the factual and contextual integrity of testimonies and source materials. Any substantive editing, reconstruction, use of generative AI, synthetic imagery or audio, or alteration of documentary materials must receive prior written approval from CIVIC and must not misrepresent the experiences or statements of contributors.

Where publication may create protection, privacy, or security risks, the consultant should work with CIVIC and HRA to apply appropriate mitigation measures, including anonymization, blurring, voice alteration, removal of identifying information or metadata, and secure handling and transfer of source files.

Under the supervision of the US Director, the consultant will undertake the following activities:

  • Develop compelling multimedia content (including graphics and videos) amplifying the experiences of Iranian civilians during the US-Israel-Iran war;
  • Consult with the CIVIC and HRA teams on storyboarding and script development;
  • Brainstorm innovative concepts to shape raw materials from the ground into engaging, high-impact content.
  • Produce and deliver edited videos (approximately 1-3 minutes in length) adapted to the formats agreed upon by the CIVIC and HRA teams and the consultant;
  • Edit photos (selection and color correction) and videos (editing, color correction, color integration and subtitles);
  • Propose creative formats tailored for various platforms, ensuring all outputs strictly align with CIVIC’s tone of voice and branding.
  • Ensure that the free and informed consent of the persons filmed or photographed is obtained and properly archived internally, and that CIVIC's principles of confidentiality, data protection and ethics are strictly adhered to;
  • Ensure compliance with the visibility and visual identity requirements of CIVIC; and
  • Consult with CIVIC and HRA teams in the design and implementation of a tailored dissemination strategy.

Deliverables

  • A set of edited high-resolution graphics (3-5) and 30-90 second 3-4 videos (exact number and format to be agreed upon with CIVIC and HRA teams); ready for use on digital platforms, including social media, presentations and donor reports;
  • Raw files (photos and videos) to be sent to the designated focal point and properly archived in line with CIVIC's standard;
  • Complete captions and corresponding contextual notes; and
  • Signed consent forms, where required.

Duration and terms

  • Duration: 3 months (subject to extension based on delivery timeline)
  • Level of effort: Varied, as required
  • Location: Remote
    from United States, the Netherlands, Belgium, or Kenya, with work authorization in operating location, a commitment to align with US team time zones when needed, and stable internet connection for video calls and transferring large files.

Qualifications and experience

    • Minimum three (3) years of professional experience in photography and videography, graphic design, social media content creation, and/or communications;
    • Strong command of video and photo editing software, including the Adobe Creative Cloud suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition, Lightroom, and Photoshop).
    • Proven experience working with non-profits or on development and/or humanitarian projects;
    • Strong portfolio demonstrating relevant work, particularly in humanitarian and sensitive contexts;
    • Strong knowledge of ethical storytelling practices, informed consent and protection principles;
    • Ability to work in sensitive and conflict-affected environments; and
    • Fluency in English; knowledge of Farsi is an asset.
  • Intellectual property and confidentiality: All materials produced as part of this consultancy will be the exclusive property of CIVIC. Any use of the materials for personal purposes (including in a portfolio) will require prior written authorization from CIVIC. The consultant must strictly comply with the confidentiality, backup, and data protection requirements applicable throughout the duration of the assignment.
  • Equipment: The consultant must have their own professional equipment (e.g., camera, audio equipment, and editing and graphic design software (Adobe Creative Cloud suite).

Payment terms

  • Total budget available is up to USD 16,000. Applicants should submit a financial proposal detailing their proposed costs within this budget ceiling.
  • Payment made after satisfactory delivery and validation of deliverables by CIVIC;
  • Travel expenses, if any, must be approved in advance and will be subject to a separate agreement.

Application process

Interested candidates must submit by November 2, 2026:

  • Up-to-date CV;
  • Portfolio of relevant digital content produced, including a list of any notable publications, organizations, or projects supported;
  • Financial proposal detailing proposed costs within the USD 16,000 budget ceiling.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

CIVIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. CIVIC does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, personal appearance, matriculation, family responsibilities, political affiliation, source of income, place of residence or business, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Note to Recruiters and Placement Agencies: CIVIC does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and does not pay placement fees for candidates submitted by agencies other than its approved partners.

Salary: Up to USD $16,000 (total consultancy contract, 3 months)

  • Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years experience in customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.
  • Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.

This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or C-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be required to both deviate from established procedure and often build entirely new processes or practices to ensure we best serve customers.

Strongly Preferred:

Compensation: Up to $125,000 base salary + bonus

About Us

raw.excerpt: About Us:Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit.
raw.description:
About Us:

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit. We conduct rigorous economics research to advance access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the Lab are Achyuta Adhvaryu - Professor of Economics and Director of 21st Century India Center at the School of Global Policy and Strategy, UC San Diego (), Anant Ahuja - Head of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd., and Anant Nyshadham - Assistant Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan ().

About the role

Research Managers (RMs) are integral to the success of our randomized evaluations. Working closely with the research team at GBL and collaborating economists and researchers across U.S. universities, the RM will support all key activities to grow our U.S. project portfolio. The RM will support all stages of the research process across two U.S.-based projects, along with other key activities to develop more projects in the U.S. Here is a quick description of the two active projects in the U.S.:

  • AI-assisted job search and matching: Research on using algorithmic matching to connect low-income jobseekers to local vacancies — widening the scope of job search across sectors and improving matching to jobs in which candidates may have no prior experience. This research builds on our prior work on AI-directed job search, which you can read about here.
  • Cash incentives and continuity of care: Research investigating the effects of small cash incentives on continuity of care among the unsheltered population in the Los Angeles region.

To acclimatize yourself with our work, you can explore our website and LinkedIn.

Compensation: $80,000–$100,000 annually, subject to the candidate’s experience, skills, and fit for the role.
Type of Employment: Fixed Term Employment

Duration: 1 year

Location: This is a remote position. Team members are based in Philadelphia, PA (with an office space) and Ann Arbor, MI, and relocation to either location is an option for candidates who are interested.
- Please note, the candidate must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead grant writing and prepare reports for funding agencies
  • Mentor Research Assistants and other research staff; assist with hiring and training Research Assistants and other research staff
  • Assist with Research Assistant responsibilities as needed (literature reviews, survey instrument design, data cleaning, survey planning, data quality monitoring, fieldwork supervision, etc.)
  • Ensure projects follow GBL standards and protocols, including IRB approval, coding standards, and analysis procedures
  • Anticipate and identify risks or threats to research design/projects, propose solutions, and escalate to researchers as needed
  • Maintain clear communication and alignment between researchers, GBL staff, and implementation partners; clarify expectations and troubleshoot challenges
  • Ensure the project has sufficient material and human resources
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation — codebooks, field protocols, and project logs — to academic standards of transparency and reproducibility
  • Coordinate with administrative and finance teams on participant payments and study-related costs
  • Prepare policy memos, research briefs, and communications content (blogs, articles) on ongoing and completed studies
  • Represent GBL at meetings with external stakeholders (e.g., delivering presentations)

Who are you?

  • Master's or doctoral degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field (or Bachelors degree with 4+ years of relevant work experience)
  • Ability to work in a team, manage multiple projects on the ground and be self-motivated
  • Experience managing Randomized Controlled Trials
  • Extensive experience conducting social science or economic field research (supervising data collection, survey design and implementation, data management, etc.)
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including proficiency in statistical software such as Stata or R, and experience with financial reporting and management
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel/spreadsheet applications
  • Strong familiarity with data science principles and AI coding platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex/GPT), among others.
  • Detail-oriented with strong written and oral communication skills
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites
  • Experience in grant writing for existing and new projects

Additional Requirements:

What should you be comfortable with?

  • A dynamic environment with competing priorities
  • Working in a team with shared responsibilities
  • Independently coordinating with coworkers to accomplish goals
  • Being resourceful in new environments and scenarios
  • Problem-solving in high-pressure environments
  • Adapting your approach, being focused on the problem and not being stuck to one idea or way of solving a problem

How to apply?

Share the following documents with your application form:

  • Curriculum vitae (CV)
  • A cover letter describing your background, interest in economics research, familiarity with relevant statistical software, and any experience as a research assistant and/or manager or on independent projects.
  • Please include the names and email addresses of two references in your cover letter.

Deadline to Apply:

On rolling basis

The process:

We are glad you’re interested in applying for this role!

After each step, we decide whether to invite you to the next one. The screening process takes approximately 4–6 weeks from the application deadline and includes the following stages:

  1. CV screening
  2. Data test
  3. First-round interview
  4. Second-round interview

Depending on the candidate pool, we may add any additional interviews to make a well thought through decision.

Our commitment to diversity:

GBL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a young and growing company making us the ideal ground for team members to experiment, take on dynamic roles, and grow with us. We focus on happiness, output, and quality of work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Salary: $80,000–$100,000 annually, subject to the candidate’s experience, skills, and fit for the role.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Examiner with deep expertise in Medi-Cal Managed Care claims adjudication. Experience with Medicare and Commercial claims is required, but this role is primarily focused on supporting and serving as a subject matter expert for Medi-Cal business.

About Us

All Care To You is a Management Service Organization providing our clients with healthcare administrative support. We provide services to Independent Physician Associations, TPAs, and Fiscal Intermediary clients. ACTY is a modern growing company which encourages diverse perspectives. We celebrate curiosity, initiative, drive and a passion for making a difference. We support a culture focused on teamwork, support, and inclusion. Our company is fully remote and offers a flexible work environment as well as schedules. ACTY offers 100% employer paid medical, vision, dental, and life coverage for our employees. We also offer paid holiday, sick time, and vacation time as well as a 401k plan. Additional employee paid coverage options available.

Job Purpose

The Claims Examiner III (Medi-Cal Managed Care) is responsible for the accurate processing, adjustment, adjudication, and release of complex hospital, ancillary, and professional claims with a primary focus on Medi-Cal managed care claims. This role requires extensive knowledge of California Medi-Cal regulations, delegated IPA and capitated hospital arrangements, provider disputes, and claims payment requirements.

The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert in Medi-Cal claims processing and is also experienced in Medicare and Commercial lines of business. This individual will identify claim processing issues, perform root cause analysis, recommend operational improvements, support compliance initiatives, and ensure adherence to CMS, DHCS, DMHC, and applicable state regulations. The Claims Examiner III must consistently meet production and quality standards while serving as a resource to other team members.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Process, adjust, and adjudicate professional, institutional, and complex claims with a primary focus on Medi-Cal Managed Care, while supporting Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Medi-Cal claims processing, reimbursement methodologies, delegated risk arrangements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Review and apply provider contracts, benefit plans, divisions of financial responsibility, authorizations, and reimbursement methodologies to ensure accurate claim adjudication.
  • Validate diagnosis and procedure codes and ensure claims are processed in accordance with DHCS, DMHC, CMS, AB 1455, AB 1324, and other applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve complex claims issues, payment discrepancies, provider disputes, grievances, escalations, and claims processing errors.
  • Process claim adjustments, voids, reopenings, reconsiderations, overpayment recoveries, and underpayment corrections in accordance with departmental guidelines.
  • Generate and document provider communications, including acknowledgement, development, denial, resolution, and notification letters as required.
  • Collaborate with Customer Service, Provider Relations, Configuration, Compliance, and other departments to resolve claims and payment issues.
  • Create and utilize Crystal and SQL reports to support inventory management, operational efficiency, and regulatory turnaround time compliance.
  • Identify claims payment errors, system configuration issues, and process improvement opportunities; provide recommendations for corrective action.
  • Participate in internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, workflow improvement initiatives, and special projects.
  • Meet established productivity and quality standards while maintaining accurate documentation within EZ-Cap and related systems.
  • May assist with training, mentoring, check run preparation, and other departmental needs as assigned.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, and confidentiality requirements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of claims adjudication experience with significant experience processing Medi-Cal managed care claims.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience processing Medicare and Commercial claims.
  • Experience using EZ-Cap required.
  • Extensive knowledge of California Medi-Cal, Medicare, and Commercial reimbursement methodologies.
  • Thorough understanding of DHCS, DMHC, CMS, and applicable state and federal claims regulations.
  • Experience with delegated IPA, Medical Group, and capitated provider arrangements.
  • Demonstrated experience resolving Provider Disputes (PDRs), claims appeals, grievances, and escalated claims issues.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • AB 1455 Claims Settlement Practices
  • AB 1324 Requirements
  • Knox-Keene regulations
  • Timely filing requirements
  • Coordination of Benefits (COB)
  • Claims payment and regulatory turnaround requirements
  • Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, DRG, APC, ASC, and other reimbursement methodologies.
  • Proficient in outpatient PPS, inpatient DRG, interim rate payment methodologies, and other reimbursement structures applicable to Medi-Cal, Medicare, and Commercial products.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and claims research skills

Working conditions

  • This job may require flexible work hours due to the nature of the responsibilities.

Physical requirements

  • This job is not considered physically demanding, therefore there are no physical requirements.
Salary: $28.00 - $35.00 hourly ($75,000 Annually)

You are responsible for leading discovery, designing integration architecture, and delivering scalable NetSuite and Celigo solutions that work in real operational environments. You work directly with client stakeholders, internal developers, and project managers to define scope, architect solutions, and guide implementation. Lead client discovery sessions to gather business and integration requirements. Design end-to-end integration architectures between NetSuite and external systems (eCommerce, CRM, 3PL, WMS, POS, marketplaces, etc.).

Translate functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and data mappings.

Guide and review development work including SuiteScript, RESTlets, and integration components.

Advise clients on best practices related to Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory, and Financial workflows.

Identify risks, edge cases, and data integrity issues early in the project lifecycle. Support testing, validation, and go-live planning.

Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders.

Ensure solutions follow Hairball delivery standards and scalable design principles.

Who You Are

NetSuite-Savvy: 3+ years of experience working with NetSuite in a technical or techno-functional capacity. Strong understanding of core ERP processes and how they connect operationally.

Integration-Focused: Experience designing or implementing integrations between SaaS platforms. Familiar with REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML data structures, and system-to-system communication.

Architectural Thinker: You see dependencies, data flows, and long-term implications — not just immediate fixes.

Client-Facing Operator: Comfortable leading working sessions with executives and operational teams. You can challenge assumptions and guide conversations toward practical solutions.

Technically Grounded: Working knowledge of SuiteScript, RESTlets, or web services — you may not write every line of code, but you understand what’s required to build it. Structured and Decisive: Able to manage multiple workstreams, document requirements clearly, and drive decisions forward.

Background in eCommerce integrations (Shopify, Amazon, marketplaces). Experience in consulting or implementation environments. NetSuite certifications are a plus, but real-world delivery experience matters more. Experience mentoring junior consultants or reviewing technical work.

Why Hairball?

Ownership: You lead solution design, not just documentation.

Complex Work: Real integration challenges across ERP, eCommerce, and operational systems.

Senior Team: Work alongside experienced operators who understand scale and system architecture.

Remote Flexibility: Distributed, high-performance team.

Growth: Opportunity to grow into Senior Consultant or Solutions Architect as Hairball scales.

Location

Global (LATAM preferred). US Eastern Time Zone overlap required.

Apply Now

If you understand NetSuite, integrations, and how business processes actually run — and you’re ready to lead solution design instead of just supporting it — we’d like to talk. Join Hairball and help build systems that scale without breaking.

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

As Country Manager, you will spearhead business growth, oversee regional operations, and cultivate key strategic relationships within the EU cryptocurrency market. Ideal candidates possess hands-on marketing expertise, a strong track record of partnering with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), prior crypto management experience, and fluency in English alongside additional EU languages. Strong knowledge of EU crypto regulatory frameworks is a distinct advantage.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the strategic business plan for the EU market, driving expansion, user acquisition, and revenue growth.
  • Lead and manage all local operations, including marketing campaigns, industry events, and strategic partnership developments.
  • Elevate brand awareness and user engagement through targeted marketing initiatives, social media, and community events.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, local financial institutions, and ecosystem partners.
  • Navigate and ensure compliance with evolving EU regulatory frameworks (MiCA/MiCAR, MiFID, EMI).
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and regional regulatory developments to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional global teams—including Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance—to align local initiatives with core company objectives.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and support to the regional team, fostering a high-performance culture of innovation and collaboration.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; MBA is a strong plus.
  • 10+ years of proven leadership experience in marketing, business development, or general management within tech/fintech.
  • Prior experience as a Country Manager or senior leader within the cryptocurrency industry is highly desirable.
  • In-depth understanding of the EU crypto market, consumer behavior, and financial regulatory landscapes (MiCA, MiFID, EMI).
  • Established professional network within the DACH/EU crypto and fintech ecosystems.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on driving clear, measurable business outcomes.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and adapt to dynamic market changes.
  • Fluency in English and at least one additional European language (e.g., German, French, Spanish, Italian).

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

raw.description:
About the Role

In this role, you will partner with Product Operations leadership and cross-functional teams to translate strategic priorities into scalable practices, enablement programs, operating rhythms, and measurable improvements. You will define and lead workstreams and initiatives, turning strategy into actionable plans, driving complex cross-functional efforts, and delivering the tools, communications, insights, analyses, and operational practices needed to support adoption, move work forward, and achieve measurable impact.

Day to day, you'll...

  • Partner with Product Operations leadership and Product, Design, and Engineering teams to drive operating model improvements, transformation initiatives, and adoption of new ways of working
  • Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, coordinating cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution
  • Operationalize and continuously improve product practices, tools, processes, and operating rhythms through documentation, feedback, and measurement
  • Lead change and adoption efforts by developing communications, training, enablement resources, and success measures that help teams embrace new practices
  • Coordinate initiatives across stakeholders, managing timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and follow-up actions
  • Use Lean, Agile, and DevOps principles to identify improvement opportunities and help teams work more effectively and deliver value faster
  • Design and deliver enablement programs, including onboarding, training, workshops, playbooks, templates, office hours, and communities of practice
  • Develop reporting, dashboards, and decision-ready materials that track objectives, progress, outcomes, dependencies, risks, and key business metrics
  • Support continuous discovery, analytics, experimentation, and AI enablement by driving adoption of approved practices, standards, tools, and governance requirements
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration by leading working sessions, clarifying ownership, documenting decisions, and supporting implementation of initiatives across product teams

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, Product Management, Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or a related discipline
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs and initiatives while translating strategy into execution through planning, operational improvement, and change adoption
  • Working knowledge of modern product practices, including discovery, experimentation, product analytics, Agile, and Lean methodologies
  • Experience with portfolio management, prioritization, dependency management, product management tools, and product operating rhythms
  • Experience enabling AI-supported workflows and responsible AI adoption
  • Strong communication, facilitation, executive storytelling, and stakeholder influence skills, including the ability to drive outcomes without formal authority
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and insights to inform decisions, measure outcomes, and drive continuous improvement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Big 4 consulting environment
  • Experience facilitating PI Planning, quarterly planning, portfolio reviews, or other multi-team planning processes
  • Experience developing enablement programs, training, coaching, or communities of practice
  • Experience with product analytics, experimentation, and dashboards
  • Experience operating in a large, matrixed, enterprise environment

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.
Pay Range Information

The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit.

raw.description:
We're looking for an highly organised Video Production Coordinator to own the day-to-day running of our video pipeline, from booking VIP guests through to publishing and promotion.

Key responsibilities

Video management and workflow

• Upload, allocate and track videos through editing, review and publication.
• Brief and coordinate our team of editors, freelancers and, where applicable, junior team members.
• Maintain an organised video archive with consistent naming conventions, tagging and version control.
• Identify and implement improvements to production workflows and tools.

AI-assisted content creation

• Use approved AI tools to draft titles, subheaders, descriptions and promotional copy, and refine the output to meet brand voice and editorial standards.
• Take responsibility for the accuracy of all published text, especially guest names, job titles, company names and factual claims.
• Help shape best practice for how the team uses AI tools, including what content can and cannot be entered into them.

YouTube hosting, promotion and reporting

• Manage YouTube channel publishing: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, chapters, playlists, end screens and captions.
• Write promotional copy for YouTube, social media and newsletters.
• Track performance (views, watch time, retention, engagement) and produce regular reports with recommendations for improving reach.

Proofing and quality control

• Act as the final quality checkpoint before publication: proof drafts for spelling, on-screen graphics, audio issues, branding and accuracy.
• Manage feedback and approval rounds with internal stakeholders and guests.

Post-campaign client reporting

• Prepare post-campaign performance reports for clients, covering metrics such as views, watch time, audience retention, engagement, click-throughs and reach across YouTube, social and newsletter channels.
• Present results clearly and professionally, with a short summary of key outcomes, highlights and recommendations for future campaigns.
• Share reports with clients on schedule, and answer follow-up questions about the results.
• Keep report templates consistent and on-brand, and improve them over time based on client feedback.

About you

• 2–5 years' experience in client and team administration and coordination.
• Comfortable pulling data from analytics platforms (e.g. YouTube Studio) and turning it into clear, client-ready reports using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets or presentation software.

• Hands-on experience using AI writing tools in a professional content setting.
• Excellent written English and meticulous attention to detail.
• Confident, calm and diplomatic, able to guide senior people through technical setup and handle last-minute changes with ease.
• Able to manage competing priorities and multiple stakeholders without close supervision.
• Discreet with confidential and embargoed information.
• Video editing basic knowledge, YouTube SEO knowledge, experience coordinating, or a background in B2B media or publishing is a plus, but not required

About us

Key Media is a fast-growing global B2B media company, and we’re looking for a sharp, creative and detail-oriented Video Editor. In this hands-on role, you’ll be responsible for editing B2B video content - including executive interviews, panel discussions, and podcasts - that align with our editorial and commercial objectives.

Life at Key Media: Where every story matters

Join us in our mission to inform, connect, educate, and inspire business people around the world. At Key Media, we're proud to be the home of trusted B2B media brands, where excellence is recognized and celebrated every day.

Perks and benefits: Because we value you

  • ComprehensiveHMO coveragewith no waiting period, ensuring your health and well-being.
  • Family coverageoptions after two years of dedicated service.
  • Great salary package (above market rates)
  • Extra vacation timeas a token of appreciation for your hard work and commitment.
  • Access to ourEmployee Assistance Programfor confidential counseling services.
  • Continuouslearning opportunitiesthrough our E-learning support with LinkedIn learning.
  • Employee recognitionprograms, including quarterly awards, vouchers, and travel incentives.
  • 100%remote arrangement; work where it suits you best.
  • Great culture(98% employees think we are a ‘great place to work’)

About Key Media

At Key Media, your next role comes withglobal exposure. With teams acrossAustralia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, the US, the UK, and Europe, we give you the chance to grow your career while collaborating with colleagues from around the world. From cross-border teamwork to supporting major live events, you'll be part of something international, fast-moving, and meaningful.

We’re a thriving B2B media company creating award-winning content and events across industries like legal, HR, insurance, finance, education, property, and more. With over 350 talented team members, we connect professionals through digital platforms, in-person events, and print, always delivering high-impact work that informs, celebrates, and brings business communities together.

People stay at Key Media for one big reason: the culture. We call it orange energy. We're collaborative, full of energy, and kind. We offer the flexibility to work hybrid or fully remote, plus regular socials, DEI initiatives, and a sense of belonging. We give people the freedom to take ownership, share ideas, and grow their careers quickly. If you want to do great work, be yourself, and explore global opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about culture in this short video about life at Key Media

raw.description:
About Us

Buddle was founded to address the growing demand for reliable and efficient staffing solutions across diverse industries globally. Our mission is to seamlessly connect businesses with skilled professionals, fostering long-term partnerships that benefit both parties. At Buddle, we prioritise trust, value, and sustainability in every staffing solution we provide.

About the Role

As an Application Support Analyst, you’ll help keep business-critical applications and services running smoothly by monitoring systems, investigating technical issues, and providing timely, effective support across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments.

You’ll work as part of a distributed support team providing 24/7 coverage, collaborating with colleagues across locations to investigate incidents, resolve technical issues, and ensure effective handovers between shifts.

This is a hands-on technical role suited to someone who enjoys problem-solving, can work independently, and is comfortable supporting live production environments where reliability, clear communication and timely incident resolution matter.

Key Responsibilities

Application Support and Incident Management

  • Monitor applications, systems and alerts to identify potential issues and service disruptions.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve application and system incidents, escalating complex issues when needed.
  • Lead or support P1 and other high-priority incidents, ensuring clear ownership, timely action and appropriate escalation.
  • Analyse application logs, system behaviour and error messages to identify root causes and support effective resolution.
  • Work with engineering and specialist teams to resolve complex technical issues and restore services as quickly as possible.

Systems and Technical Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot issues across Linux-based systems, web applications, databases and cloud environments.
  • Use SQL queries and log analysis to investigate application behaviour, data issues and system errors.
  • Support applications running across on-premises, cloud and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Use monitoring, IT service management and remote monitoring tools to track incidents, identify recurring issues and maintain service visibility.

Service Delivery and Continuous Improvement

  • Follow established incident, problem and change management processes to maintain service quality and reliability.
  • Provide clear and timely updates to relevant stakeholders on incident progress, impact and resolution.
  • Maintain accurate incident records, technical documentation and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis, incident reviews and improvement initiatives to help prevent recurring issues.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across locations, ensuring clear shift handovers and continuity of support within a 24/7 operation.

Other Responsibilities

  • Ensure incidents and service requests are handled promptly and effectively in line with agreed SLAs and internal service expectations.
  • Maintain accurate records of technical activities, incidents, system changes and resolutions.
  • Follow established incident management, change management and operational support procedures.
  • Adhere to documented operating procedures, maintenance instructions and technical guidelines.
  • Support operational readiness and service continuity through system monitoring and other required activities.
  • Maintain a strong focus on system reliability, service quality and customer experience.
  • Participate in training, product familiarisation and knowledge-sharing activities to support ongoing development and team effectiveness.

About You

You’re a methodical and proactive problem-solver who can investigate technical issues, work through complex information and communicate findings clearly. You’re comfortable taking ownership of incidents within your level of responsibility, working independently when needed, and collaborating with others to resolve issues effectively.

Essential Experience and Skills

  • Experience in application support, technical support, production support or a similar IT support role.
  • Practical experience supporting Linux environments and troubleshooting web applications.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and cloud-based environments.
  • Experience using SQL to investigate application or data-related issues.
  • Ability to analyse complex logs, system alerts and error messages to identify and troubleshoot problems.
  • Understanding of monitoring tools, IT service management systems and incident management processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting issues across on-premises, cloud or hybrid environments.
  • Ability to handle incidents according to their priority, including supporting critical incidents and escalating issues appropriately.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication skills, particularly when documenting technical issues and updating stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Agile and DevOps ways of working.
  • Willingness to work within a 24/7 support operation, including the required shift schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Experience providing out-of-hours, overnight or shift-based technical support.
  • Experience supporting production workloads in AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Exposure to business-critical, high-availability or regulated systems.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals and infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Experience contributing to root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and service improvement initiatives.

Finer Details

Working Pattern:

Remote / Home-Based

4 days on / 4 days off

12-hour overnight shifts

Shift hours: 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM

The role provides support for business-critical applications and systems requiring 24/7 operational coverage.
Training and onboarding will follow a structured schedule before transitioning to the regular 4-on, 4-off overnight shift pattern.
Occasional participation in training, technical workshops, product familiarisation, or other client activities may be required.

Salary: PHP 70,000 - 100,000
